units.id: mission:Deep Archaeology 1|name|16|0
units.english: Deep Archaeology
units.italian: Archeologia nel Deep

units.id: mission:Deep Archaeology 1|description|17|0
units.english: Drop this archaeologist off on <destination>, before making a trip to Midgard in the Deep to collect some samples.
units.italian: Lascia questo archeologo su <destination>, prima di fare un viaggio su Midgard, nel Deep, per raccogliere dei campioni.

units.id: mission:Deep Archaeology 1|As you are walking through the spaceport, a man in an expensive suit approaches you. "Pardon me, Captain," he says. "I wonder if you would be willing to talk privately about a very lucrative job opportunity."|30|0
units.english: As you are walking through the spaceport, a man in an expensive suit approaches you. "Pardon me, Captain," he says. "I wonder if you would be willing to talk privately about a very lucrative job opportunity."
units.italian: Mentre attraversi lo spazioporto, un uomo in un abito costoso ti si avvicina. "Mi scusi, capitano," dice. "Mi chiedevo se sarebbe disposto a parlare in privato di un'opportunità di lavoro molto redditizia."

units.id: mission:Deep Archaeology 1|	"Is this something illegal?"|32|0
units.english: "Is this something illegal?"
units.italian: "Si tratta di qualcosa di illegale?"

units.id: mission:Deep Archaeology 1|	"Sure, let's return to my ship and talk there."|33|0
units.english: "Sure, let's return to my ship and talk there."
units.italian: "Certo, torniamo sulla mia nave e parliamo lì."

units.id: mission:Deep Archaeology 1|	"Not illegal," he says, "but it could help to uncover a secret with enormous ramifications. A secret that certain people do not want known."|35|0
units.english: "Not illegal," he says, "but it could help to uncover a secret with enormous ramifications. A secret that certain people do not want known."
units.italian: "Non illegale," dice, "ma potrebbe aiutare a scoprire un segreto dalle enormi conseguenze. Un segreto che certa gente non vuole che si conosca."

units.id: mission:Deep Archaeology 1|	"Okay," you say, "let's return to my ship, and I'll hear you out."|36|0
units.english: "Okay," you say, "let's return to my ship, and I'll hear you out."
units.italian: "Va bene," dici, "torniamo sulla mia nave e ti ascolto."

units.id: mission:Deep Archaeology 1|	You lead him back to your ship. "I'm an archaeologist," he explains, "studying the early history of the space era. And in particular, a set of persistent folk tales about contact with alien species. Many of these tales have to do with the region of the galaxy we call the Deep. I need someone to travel to Midgard and retrieve some samples from an ancient site there."|38|0
units.english: You lead him back to your ship. "I'm an archaeologist," he explains, "studying the early history of the space era. And in particular, a set of persistent folk tales about contact with alien species. Many of these tales have to do with the region of the galaxy we call the Deep. I need someone to travel to Midgard and retrieve some samples from an ancient site there."
units.italian: Lo accompagni sulla tua nave. "Sono un archeologo," spiega, "e studio la storia antica dell'era spaziale. In particolare, una serie di leggende ricorrenti sui contatti con specie aliene. Molte di queste leggende riguardano la regione della galassia che chiamiamo il Deep. Ho bisogno di qualcuno che vada su Midgard a recuperare dei campioni da un sito antico."

units.id: mission:Deep Archaeology 1|	"Why can't you travel there yourself?"|40|0
units.english: "Why can't you travel there yourself?"
units.italian: "Perché non ci vai tu?"

units.id: mission:Deep Archaeology 1|	"What sort of samples? Will this get me in trouble?"|41|0
units.english: "What sort of samples? Will this get me in trouble?"
units.italian: "Che tipo di campioni? Mi metterò nei guai?"

units.id: mission:Deep Archaeology 1|	"Well, let's just say I've made myself somewhat unpopular in the Deep," he says. "Asking too many questions. If I were seen walking around on Midgard, they would probably ask me to leave immediately."|43|0
units.english: "Well, let's just say I've made myself somewhat unpopular in the Deep," he says. "Asking too many questions. If I were seen walking around on Midgard, they would probably ask me to leave immediately."
units.italian: "Beh, diciamo che mi sono reso un po' impopolare nel Deep," dice. "Troppe domande. Se mi vedessero camminare per Midgard, probabilmente mi chiederebbero di andarmene subito."

units.id: mission:Deep Archaeology 1|	You say, "And, is the work you're asking me to do going to make me equally unpopular?"|44|0
units.english: You say, "And, is the work you're asking me to do going to make me equally unpopular?"
units.italian: Dici: "E il lavoro che mi stai chiedendo mi renderà altrettanto impopolare?"

units.id: mission:Deep Archaeology 1|	"Not if you are circumspect," he says. "I need two samples from a certain village. One is simple: wood from a living or recently deceased tree. Any tree will do."|46|0
units.english: "Not if you are circumspect," he says. "I need two samples from a certain village. One is simple: wood from a living or recently deceased tree. Any tree will do."
units.italian: "Non se sei discreto," dice. "Mi servono due campioni da un certo villaggio. Uno è semplice: legno di un albero vivo o morto da poco. Va bene qualsiasi albero."

units.id: mission:Deep Archaeology 1|	He pauses for a minute, then continues. "The other is more... sensitive. There is a historical site on Midgard, an ancient church. Not something they publish in the official tourist guides, mind you. I need a small sample of the wood that the church is built with. A small splinter would suffice."|47|0
units.english: He pauses for a minute, then continues. "The other is more... sensitive. There is a historical site on Midgard, an ancient church. Not something they publish in the official tourist guides, mind you. I need a small sample of the wood that the church is built with. A small splinter would suffice."
units.italian: Si ferma un minuto, poi continua. "L'altro è più... delicato. Su Midgard c'è un sito storico, una chiesa antica. Non una di quelle che pubblicano nelle guide turistiche ufficiali, sia chiaro. Mi serve un piccolo campione del legno con cui è costruita la chiesa. Basterebbe una piccola scheggia."

units.id: mission:Deep Archaeology 1|	"Sure, if it's in the interest of science, I can do that."|49|0
units.english: "Sure, if it's in the interest of science, I can do that."
units.italian: "Certo, se è per la scienza, posso farlo."

units.id: mission:Deep Archaeology 1|	"You're asking me to vandalize a historical site?"|51|0
units.english: "You're asking me to vandalize a historical site?"
units.italian: "Mi stai chiedendo di vandalizzare un sito storico?"

units.id: mission:Deep Archaeology 1|	"I need only the tiniest of samples," he says, "maybe a splinter of wood that is already peeling off, or from a place where the wood is worn and cracked. And what we discover from that sample could be of immense importance."|52|0
units.english: "I need only the tiniest of samples," he says, "maybe a splinter of wood that is already peeling off, or from a place where the wood is worn and cracked. And what we discover from that sample could be of immense importance."
units.italian: "Mi serve solo il più piccolo dei campioni," dice, "magari una scheggia di legno che si sta già staccando, o da un punto in cui il legno è consumato e crepato. E quello che scopriremo da quel campione potrebbe essere di immensa importanza."

units.id: mission:Deep Archaeology 1|	"Sorry, that sounds a bit too shady to me."|54|0
units.english: "Sorry, that sounds a bit too shady to me."
units.italian: "Mi dispiace, mi sembra un po' troppo losco."

units.id: mission:Deep Archaeology 1|	"Okay, I'm willing to do that."|56|0
units.english: "Okay, I'm willing to do that."
units.italian: "Va bene, sono disposto a farlo."

units.id: mission:Deep Archaeology 1|	"Thank you," he says. "Trust me, this could give us some very important information. I'll need you to drop me off on Vinci first, to meet with some scientists. We can then meet up back on Vinci once you have the samples."|58|0
units.english: "Thank you," he says. "Trust me, this could give us some very important information. I'll need you to drop me off on Vinci first, to meet with some scientists. We can then meet up back on Vinci once you have the samples."
units.italian: "Grazie," dice. "Fidati, potrebbe darci informazioni molto importanti. Prima devo chiederti di lasciarmi su Vinci, per incontrare alcuni scienziati. Poi ci ritroveremo su Vinci quando avrai i campioni."

units.id: mission:Deep Archaeology 1|dialog|61|0
units.english: You land on <planet>, but realize that your escort carrying the archaeologist hasn't entered the system yet. Better depart and wait for it.
units.italian: Atterri su <planet>, ma ti rendi conto che la tua scorta con l'archeologo non è ancora entrata nel sistema. Meglio partire e aspettarla.

units.id: mission:Deep Archaeology 2|name|67|0
units.english: Deep Archaeology
units.italian: Archeologia nel Deep

units.id: mission:Deep Archaeology 2|description|68|0
units.english: Travel to <destination> and take wood fiber samples from an ancient church and from the trees that grow nearby.
units.italian: Viaggia verso <destination> e prendi campioni di fibra di legno da una chiesa antica e dagli alberi che crescono lì intorno.

units.id: mission:Deep Archaeology 2|You drop off the archaeologist (who still has not told you his name) on <origin>. "Remember," he says, "I only need a tiny splinter. Just make sure it really is from the building and not anything more recent."|76|0
units.english: You drop off the archaeologist (who still has not told you his name) on <origin>. "Remember," he says, "I only need a tiny splinter. Just make sure it really is from the building and not anything more recent."
units.italian: Lasci l'archeologo (che non ti ha ancora detto il suo nome) su <origin>. "Ricorda," dice, "mi serve solo una piccola scheggia. Assicurati che venga davvero dall'edificio e non da qualcosa di più recente."

units.id: mission:Deep Archaeology 3|name|83|0
units.english: Deep Archaeology
units.italian: Archeologia nel Deep

units.id: mission:Deep Archaeology 3|description|84|0
units.english: Return to <destination> with the wood samples that you retrieved from the church on <origin>.
units.italian: Torna su <destination> con i campioni di legno che hai prelevato dalla chiesa su <origin>.

units.id: mission:Deep Archaeology 3|Following the map that the archaeologist gave you, you make your way to a small village in the mountains on <origin>, with two envelopes in your pocket for samples. As you approach the church, you break a dead twig off one of the trees along the path, put it into the first envelope, and pocket it. One sample collected, one more to go.|92|0
units.english: Following the map that the archaeologist gave you, you make your way to a small village in the mountains on <origin>, with two envelopes in your pocket for samples. As you approach the church, you break a dead twig off one of the trees along the path, put it into the first envelope, and pocket it. One sample collected, one more to go.
units.italian: Seguendo la mappa che ti ha dato l'archeologo, raggiungi un piccolo villaggio tra le montagne di <origin>, con due buste in tasca per i campioni. Mentre ti avvicini alla chiesa, stacchi un rametto secco da uno degli alberi lungo il sentiero, lo metti nella prima busta e la infili in tasca. Un campione raccolto, ne manca uno.

units.id: mission:Deep Archaeology 3|	The church itself is unlike any building you have seen before, clearly very ancient, built of roughly hewn wood, old and weathered. Surprisingly, the front doors are open, and you hear music coming from inside.|93|0
units.english: The church itself is unlike any building you have seen before, clearly very ancient, built of roughly hewn wood, old and weathered. Surprisingly, the front doors are open, and you hear music coming from inside.
units.italian: La chiesa in sé non somiglia a nessun edificio che tu abbia mai visto: chiaramente antichissima, costruita con legno tagliato grossolanamente, vecchio e consumato dalle intemperie. Sorprendentemente, le porte principali sono aperte, e da dentro arriva della musica.

units.id: mission:Deep Archaeology 3|	(Walk into the church.)|95|0
units.english: (Walk into the church.)
units.italian: (Entra nella chiesa.)

units.id: mission:Deep Archaeology 3|	(Take a sample from the outside.)|97|0
units.english: (Take a sample from the outside.)
units.italian: (Prendi un campione dall'esterno.)

units.id: mission:Deep Archaeology 3|	(Give up on this mission and leave, before I get into trouble.)|98|0
units.english: (Give up on this mission and leave, before I get into trouble.)
units.italian: (Rinuncia a questa missione e vattene, prima che mi metta nei guai.)

units.id: mission:Deep Archaeology 3|	You walk around the outside of the building until you find one corner where the wood has been recently scuffed, and a few hairs of it are hanging loose. You carefully pick the splinters off and put them in the second envelope. Then, you return to your ship. Although you see no one following you, you can't shake the feeling that you are being watched.|100|0
units.english: You walk around the outside of the building until you find one corner where the wood has been recently scuffed, and a few hairs of it are hanging loose. You carefully pick the splinters off and put them in the second envelope. Then, you return to your ship. Although you see no one following you, you can't shake the feeling that you are being watched.
units.italian: Giri intorno all'edificio finché non trovi un angolo in cui il legno è stato scalfito di recente e qualche scheggia pende staccata. Stacchi con cura le schegge e le metti nella seconda busta. Poi torni alla tua nave. Anche se non vedi nessuno seguirti, non riesci a scuoterti di dosso la sensazione di essere osservato.

units.id: mission:Deep Archaeology 3|	This church must still be used for services: candles are lit up front, and a man in a white surplice is playing the organ. A few people sit in the pews with their heads bowed. Trying to be as unobtrusive as possible, you join them, and look around at the ornately carved pillars and wood panels. The air in here smells of incense and musty wood.|103|0
units.english: This church must still be used for services: candles are lit up front, and a man in a white surplice is playing the organ. A few people sit in the pews with their heads bowed. Trying to be as unobtrusive as possible, you join them, and look around at the ornately carved pillars and wood panels. The air in here smells of incense and musty wood.
units.italian: Questa chiesa deve essere ancora usata per le funzioni: ci sono candele accese davanti e un uomo in cotta bianca suona l'organo. Qualche persona siede sulle panche a capo chino. Cercando di essere il meno appariscente possibile, ti unisci a loro e ti guardi intorno tra colonne e pannelli di legno finemente intagliati. L'aria qui dentro sa di incenso e di legno ammuffito.

units.id: mission:Deep Archaeology 3|	(Take a sample.)|105|0
units.english: (Take a sample.)
units.italian: (Prendi un campione.)

units.id: mission:Deep Archaeology 3|	(Give up on this mission, and leave.)|106|0
units.english: (Give up on this mission, and leave.)
units.italian: (Rinuncia a questa missione e vattene.)

units.id: mission:Deep Archaeology 3|	Pretending to pray, you kneel on the ground, take your pocket knife, and shave the tiniest sliver off the bottom corner of the pew in front of you. It leaves a small white scar in the dark weathered wood of the pew. You pocket the sample, wait a few more minutes, and then leave and walk back to the spaceport. Although you see no one following you, you cannot shake the feeling that you are being watched.|108|0
units.english: Pretending to pray, you kneel on the ground, take your pocket knife, and shave the tiniest sliver off the bottom corner of the pew in front of you. It leaves a small white scar in the dark weathered wood of the pew. You pocket the sample, wait a few more minutes, and then leave and walk back to the spaceport. Although you see no one following you, you cannot shake the feeling that you are being watched.
units.italian: Fingendo di pregare, ti inginocchi, prendi il temperino e raschi la scheggia più sottile dall'angolo inferiore della panca davanti a te. Resta una piccola cicatrice chiara nel legno scuro e consumato. Metti il campione in tasca, aspetti ancora qualche minuto, poi esci e torni allo spazioporto. Anche se non vedi nessuno seguirti, non riesci a scuoterti di dosso la sensazione di essere osservato.

units.id: mission:Deep Archaeology 3|log|136|0
units.english: Agreed to take a piece of wood from a church on Midgard for an archaeologist. Carbon dating suggests that the church was built many centuries before the discovery of the hyperdrive.
units.italian: Hai accettato di prendere un pezzo di legno da una chiesa su Midgard per un archeologo. La datazione al carbonio suggerisce che la chiesa fu costruita molti secoli prima della scoperta dell'iperpropulsore.

units.id: mission:Deep Archaeology 3|You return to the lab where you dropped off the anonymous archaeologist. Soon after you arrive, he appears and eagerly collects the two samples, giving you a payment of <payment> for your troubles. "But please," he says, "stick around long enough to learn the results." He hands the two envelopes to a lab technologist, and says, "Here you go, John, take a look and let us know what you find."|138|0
units.english: You return to the lab where you dropped off the anonymous archaeologist. Soon after you arrive, he appears and eagerly collects the two samples, giving you a payment of <payment> for your troubles. "But please," he says, "stick around long enough to learn the results." He hands the two envelopes to a lab technologist, and says, "Here you go, John, take a look and let us know what you find."
units.italian: Torni al laboratorio dove hai lasciato l'archeologo anonimo. Poco dopo il tuo arrivo, compare e prende con entusiasmo i due campioni, dandoti un compenso di <payment> per il disturbo. "Ma per favore," dice, "resta abbastanza da sapere i risultati." Consegna le due buste a un tecnico di laboratorio e dice: "Ecco, John, dai un'occhiata e facci sapere cosa trovi."

units.id: mission:Deep Archaeology 3|	After the lab tech leaves, he explains, "You see, the ratio of Carbon 12 to Carbon 14 varies from world to world, so accurate dating can only be done if you have a control sample to compare against. Only a handful of archaeological studies have been done in the Deep, and those were sloppy - they used the standard tables of Earth's carbon ratios instead of determining the local concentrations."|139|0
units.english: After the lab tech leaves, he explains, "You see, the ratio of Carbon 12 to Carbon 14 varies from world to world, so accurate dating can only be done if you have a control sample to compare against. Only a handful of archaeological studies have been done in the Deep, and those were sloppy - they used the standard tables of Earth's carbon ratios instead of determining the local concentrations."
units.italian: Dopo che il tecnico se n'è andato, spiega: "Vedi, il rapporto tra carbonio 12 e carbonio 14 varia da mondo a mondo, quindi una datazione accurata si può fare solo se hai un campione di controllo con cui confrontarla. Nel Deep sono stati fatti solo pochi studi archeologici, e sono stati fatti male: usavano le tabelle standard dei rapporti di carbonio terrestri invece di determinare le concentrazioni locali."

units.id: mission:Deep Archaeology 3|	(Wait and see what the results are.)|141|0
units.english: (Wait and see what the results are.)
units.italian: (Aspetta e vedi quali sono i risultati.)

units.id: mission:Deep Archaeology 3|	About thirty minutes later, John reappears, looking somewhat shaken. "Where did you get those samples?" he asks.|142|0
units.english: About thirty minutes later, John reappears, looking somewhat shaken. "Where did you get those samples?" he asks.
units.italian: Una trentina di minuti dopo, John ricompare, visibilmente scosso. "Dove hai preso quei campioni?" chiede.

units.id: mission:Deep Archaeology 3|	"Never mind that," says the archaeologist. "What are your results?"|143|0
units.english: "Never mind that," says the archaeologist. "What are your results?"
units.italian: "Non importa," dice l'archeologo. "Quali sono i tuoi risultati?"

units.id: mission:Deep Archaeology 3|	"The second sample is infused with some sort of oil or tar," he says. "A varnish. And therefore it is from furniture or a building. A man-made artifact. The control sample has an isotopic ratio different from Earth, so unless you're playing games with me, these samples are not from Earth."|144|0
units.english: "The second sample is infused with some sort of oil or tar," he says. "A varnish. And therefore it is from furniture or a building. A man-made artifact. The control sample has an isotopic ratio different from Earth, so unless you're playing games with me, these samples are not from Earth."
units.italian: "Il secondo campione è impregnato di una specie di olio o catrame," dice. "Una vernice. Quindi viene da un mobile o da un edificio. Un manufatto. Il campione di controllo ha un rapporto isotopico diverso da quello terrestre, quindi, a meno che tu non mi stia prendendo in giro, questi campioni non vengono dalla Terra."

units.id: mission:Deep Archaeology 3|	"Go on," says the archaeologist.|145|0
units.english: "Go on," says the archaeologist.
units.italian: "Continua," dice l'archeologo.

units.id: mission:Deep Archaeology 3|	"However," says the lab tech, "again assuming the two samples are from the same planet, the second sample is between fifteen hundred and twenty-five hundred years old. Which means it predates the discovery of the hyperdrive by, at minimum, five centuries. So again I ask you, where did you get these samples?" His voice is raised.|146|0
units.english: "However," says the lab tech, "again assuming the two samples are from the same planet, the second sample is between fifteen hundred and twenty-five hundred years old. Which means it predates the discovery of the hyperdrive by, at minimum, five centuries. So again I ask you, where did you get these samples?" His voice is raised.
units.italian: "Però," dice il tecnico, "sempre supponendo che i due campioni vengano dallo stesso pianeta, il secondo ha tra millecinquecento e duemilacinquecento anni. Il che significa che precede la scoperta dell'iperpropulsore di almeno cinque secoli. Quindi te lo chiedo di nuovo: dove hai preso questi campioni?" Ha la voce alzata.

units.id: mission:Deep Archaeology 3|	"Intriguing, isn't it?" says the archaeologist. "Captain <last>, if you'd like to help us get to the bottom of this, make sure you've got space for us and some equipment, and meet us in the spaceport."|147|0
units.english: "Intriguing, isn't it?" says the archaeologist. "Captain <last>, if you'd like to help us get to the bottom of this, make sure you've got space for us and some equipment, and meet us in the spaceport."
units.italian: "Intrigante, vero?" dice l'archeologo. "Capitano <last>, se vuoi aiutarci a vederci chiaro, assicurati di avere spazio per noi e per un po' di attrezzatura, e incontraci allo spazioporto."

units.id: mission:Deep Archaeology 4|name|152|0
units.english: Deep Archaeology
units.italian: Archeologia nel Deep

units.id: mission:Deep Archaeology 4|description|153|0
units.english: Return to <destination> with some specialized equipment for subterranean mapping.
units.italian: Torna su <destination> con un'attrezzatura specializzata per la mappatura del sottosuolo.

units.id: mission:Deep Archaeology 4|log|162|0
units.english: An archaeologist who is famous for using dubious methods: he has been banned from Quarg space for trying to collect an alloy sample from their ringworld, and is rumored to have also been involved in a scheme involving dinosaur fossils and an illegal genetic resequencer. He is currently based on Vinci, on the edge of the Paradise sector.
units.italian: Un archeologo famoso per i metodi discutibili: è stato bandito dallo spazio Quarg per aver cercato di prelevare un campione di lega dal loro ringworld, e si dice che sia stato coinvolto anche in un affare di fossili di dinosauro e un risequenziatore genetico illegale. Al momento si trova su Vinci, ai margini del settore Paradise.

units.id: mission:Deep Archaeology 4|You find John the lab tech in one of the spaceport bars, along with the archaeologist, who says, "I suppose I should introduce myself. Albert Foster. You may have heard of me." Indeed, you have: he made headlines about a decade ago by being driven out of Quarg space after trying unsuccessfully to collect an alloy sample from their ringworld.|164|0
units.english: You find John the lab tech in one of the spaceport bars, along with the archaeologist, who says, "I suppose I should introduce myself. Albert Foster. You may have heard of me." Indeed, you have: he made headlines about a decade ago by being driven out of Quarg space after trying unsuccessfully to collect an alloy sample from their ringworld.
units.italian: Trovi John il tecnico in uno dei bar dello spazioporto, insieme all'archeologo, che dice: "Suppongo di dovermi presentare. Albert Foster. Forse hai sentito parlare di me." In effetti sì: una decina d'anni fa è finito sui giornali perché fu cacciato dallo spazio Quarg dopo aver tentato senza successo di prelevare un campione di lega dal loro ringworld.

units.id: mission:Deep Archaeology 4|	"We've purchased some equipment for gravitational field mapping," he says, "in addition to a very sensitive radar array. We're hoping to map the area around the church, see if there are signs of any ancient settlements. Are you willing to help us?"|165|0
units.english: "We've purchased some equipment for gravitational field mapping," he says, "in addition to a very sensitive radar array. We're hoping to map the area around the church, see if there are signs of any ancient settlements. Are you willing to help us?"
units.italian: "Abbiamo comprato un'attrezzatura per la mappatura dei campi gravitazionali," dice, "oltre a un radar molto sensibile. Speriamo di mappare la zona intorno alla chiesa e vedere se ci sono segni di insediamenti antichi. Sei disposto ad aiutarci?"

units.id: mission:Deep Archaeology 4|	"Sure, I'd love to help solve this mystery."|167|0
units.english: "Sure, I'd love to help solve this mystery."
units.italian: "Certo, mi piacerebbe aiutare a risolvere questo mistero."

units.id: mission:Deep Archaeology 4|	"Sorry, I can't. I'm worried we're going to make people in the Deep angry."|168|0
units.english: "Sorry, I can't. I'm worried we're going to make people in the Deep angry."
units.italian: "Mi dispiace, non posso. Temo che faremmo arrabbiare la gente del Deep."

units.id: mission:Deep Archaeology 4|	"Excellent," says Albert. "We just need to do a flyover of <planet>, and see what our radar turns up."|170|0
units.english: "Excellent," says Albert. "We just need to do a flyover of <planet>, and see what our radar turns up."
units.italian: "Eccellente," dice Albert. "Dobbiamo solo sorvolare <planet> e vedere cosa salta fuori dal radar."

units.id: mission:Deep Archaeology 4|dialog|173|0
units.english: You land on <planet>, but realize that your escort carrying Albert, John, and the mapping equipment hasn't entered the system yet. Better depart and wait for it.
units.italian: Atterri su <planet>, ma ti rendi conto che la tua scorta con Albert, John e l'attrezzatura di mappatura non è ancora entrata nel sistema. Meglio partire e aspettarla.

units.id: mission:Deep Archaeology 5|name|179|0
units.english: Deep Archaeology
units.italian: Archeologia nel Deep

units.id: mission:Deep Archaeology 5|description|180|0
units.english: Evade the ships that are chasing you and return to <destination>.
units.italian: Eludi le navi che ti inseguono e torna su <destination>.

units.id: mission:Deep Archaeology 5|You cruise high above the surface of <origin> as John calibrates his instruments. "Sorry it's taking so long," he says, "there's some sort of glitch in the gravitational sensors, messing up my measurements."|190|0
units.english: You cruise high above the surface of <origin> as John calibrates his instruments. "Sorry it's taking so long," he says, "there's some sort of glitch in the gravitational sensors, messing up my measurements."
units.italian: Sorvoli la superficie di <origin> mentre John calibra i suoi strumenti. "Scusa se ci vuole così tanto," dice, "c'è una specie di glitch nei sensori gravitazionali che mi manda all'aria le misure."

units.id: mission:Deep Archaeology 5|	"What sort of glitch?" asks Albert.|191|0
units.english: "What sort of glitch?" asks Albert.
units.italian: "Che tipo di glitch?" chiede Albert.

units.id: mission:Deep Archaeology 5|	"Just a sensor artifact," he says, "some sort of echo. No, wait..." He trails off and starts turning dials on the instrument, then turns very pale.|192|0
units.english: "Just a sensor artifact," he says, "some sort of echo. No, wait..." He trails off and starts turning dials on the instrument, then turns very pale.
units.italian: "Solo un artefatto del sensore," dice, "una specie di eco. No, aspetta..." Si interrompe e comincia a girare le manopole dello strumento, poi sbianca.

units.id: mission:Deep Archaeology 5|	Albert looks over his shoulder at the monitor, but clearly doesn't understand what he's looking at. "What is it?" he asks.|193|0
units.english: Albert looks over his shoulder at the monitor, but clearly doesn't understand what he's looking at. "What is it?" he asks.
units.italian: Albert si sporge sulla sua spalla per guardare il monitor, ma chiaramente non capisce cosa sta vedendo. "Che cos'è?" chiede.

units.id: mission:Deep Archaeology 5|	"It's not a sensor glitch," says John. "It's an artificial singularity."|194|0
units.english: "It's not a sensor glitch," says John. "It's an artificial singularity."
units.italian: "Non è un glitch del sensore," dice John. "È una singolarità artificiale."

units.id: mission:Deep Archaeology 5|	"Some sort of illegal research?"|196|0
units.english: "Some sort of illegal research?"
units.italian: "Qualche tipo di ricerca illegale?"

units.id: mission:Deep Archaeology 5|	"A what?"|198|0
units.english: "A what?"
units.italian: "Una che?"

units.id: mission:Deep Archaeology 5|	"No, not illegal," says Albert. "No need to make laws against them, for the simple reason that no one knows how to make them. That's alien technology, very advanced."|201|0
units.english: "No, not illegal," says Albert. "No need to make laws against them, for the simple reason that no one knows how to make them. That's alien technology, very advanced."
units.italian: "No, non illegale," dice Albert. "Non c'è bisogno di farne una legge contro, per il semplice motivo che nessuno sa come costruirle. È tecnologia aliena, molto avanzata."

units.id: mission:Deep Archaeology 5|	"A miniature black hole," says John. "An alien power source. Far more sophisticated than anything human beings have ever created. That is, unless someone in the Deep has found a way to reverse engineer alien technology."|204|0
units.english: "A miniature black hole," says John. "An alien power source. Far more sophisticated than anything human beings have ever created. That is, unless someone in the Deep has found a way to reverse engineer alien technology."
units.italian: "Un buco nero in miniatura," dice John. "Una fonte di energia aliena. Molto più sofisticata di qualsiasi cosa gli esseri umani abbiano mai creato. A meno che qualcuno nel Deep non abbia trovato il modo di decodificare tecnologia aliena."

units.id: mission:Deep Archaeology 5|	Suddenly, a warning light flashes on your ship's radar. Three ships have taken off from the planet's surface and are headed straight towards you. "Let's get out of here," says Albert. "Head back to <planet>!"|206|0
units.english: Suddenly, a warning light flashes on your ship's radar. Three ships have taken off from the planet's surface and are headed straight towards you. "Let's get out of here," says Albert. "Head back to <planet>!"
units.italian: Improvvisamente sul radar della nave si accende una spia d'allarme. Tre navi sono decollate dalla superficie del pianeta e puntano dritte verso di te. "Andiamocene da qui," dice Albert. "Torna su <planet>!"

units.id: mission:Deep Archaeology 5|dialog|247|0
units.english: You land on <planet>, but realize that your escort carrying Albert, John, and the mapping equipment hasn't entered the system yet. Better depart and wait for it.
units.italian: Atterri su <planet>, ma ti rendi conto che la tua scorta con Albert, John e l'attrezzatura di mappatura non è ancora entrata nel sistema. Meglio partire e aspettarla.

units.id: mission:Deep Archaeology 5|log|250|0
units.english: Returned to Midgard with Albert Foster, the archaeologist, to map the area around the church. The instruments discovered what looked like an artificial singularity. Got chased away by Deep ships before being able to look closer.
units.italian: Sei tornato su Midgard con l'archeologo Albert Foster per mappare la zona intorno alla chiesa. Gli strumenti hanno rilevato quello che sembrava una singolarità artificiale. Siete stati cacciati dalle navi del Deep prima di poter guardare più da vicino.

units.id: mission:Deep Archaeology 5|You breathe a sigh of relief as you land safely in the spaceport on <planet>. "Okay, what was that all about?" you ask.|252|0
units.english: You breathe a sigh of relief as you land safely in the spaceport on <planet>. "Okay, what was that all about?" you ask.
units.italian: Tiri un sospiro di sollievo quando atterri sano e salvo allo spazioporto di <planet>. "Bene, che cosa è successo là fuori?" chiedi.

units.id: mission:Deep Archaeology 5|	"I honestly don't know," says Albert. "I can tell you what I suspect, though. The history books don't actually say when the Deep was first settled. The first documented expedition to the Deep was in the 24th century, and they found several human colonies already established in the region, claiming to date back to the very dawn of space flight. But I think the first settlers were brought there long before that. Brought there on alien ships."|253|0
units.english: "I honestly don't know," says Albert. "I can tell you what I suspect, though. The history books don't actually say when the Deep was first settled. The first documented expedition to the Deep was in the 24th century, and they found several human colonies already established in the region, claiming to date back to the very dawn of space flight. But I think the first settlers were brought there long before that. Brought there on alien ships."
units.italian: "Sinceramente non lo so," dice Albert. "Posso dirti cosa sospetto, però. I libri di storia non dicono quando il Deep sia stato popolato per la prima volta. La prima spedizione documentata nel Deep è del XXIV secolo, e trovarono già diverse colonie umane nella regione, che dicevano di risalire agli albori del volo spaziale. Ma credo che i primi coloni siano stati portati lì molto prima. Portati lì su navi aliene."

units.id: mission:Deep Archaeology 5|	"For what purpose?"|259|0
units.english: "For what purpose?"
units.italian: "Con quale scopo?"

units.id: mission:Deep Archaeology 5|	"What aliens? The Quarg?"|261|0
units.english: "What aliens? The Quarg?"
units.italian: "Quali alieni? I Quarg?"

units.id: mission:Deep Archaeology 5|	"For what purpose?"|265|0
units.english: "For what purpose?"
units.italian: "Con quale scopo?"

units.id: mission:Deep Archaeology 5|	"Do you think it was the Pug?"|267|0
units.english: "Do you think it was the Pug?"
units.italian: "Pensi che siano stati i Pug?"

units.id: mission:Deep Archaeology 5|	"I'm not sure," he says. "But I first became interested in the Deep while researching the Alpha Wars. I'm sure you know the history, how humanity was nearly enslaved by psychopathic 'super' humans that we ourselves had created by dabbling in genetic engineering. At that time, the Deep made a sudden, improbable technological leap that allowed them to construct weapons and ships far more powerful than what the Alphas had, and the war against them was won."|270|0
units.english: "I'm not sure," he says. "But I first became interested in the Deep while researching the Alpha Wars. I'm sure you know the history, how humanity was nearly enslaved by psychopathic 'super' humans that we ourselves had created by dabbling in genetic engineering. At that time, the Deep made a sudden, improbable technological leap that allowed them to construct weapons and ships far more powerful than what the Alphas had, and the war against them was won."
units.italian: "Non ne sono sicuro," dice. "Ma ho cominciato a interessarmi al Deep mentre studiavo le Guerre Alpha. Conoscerai la storia: come l'umanità fu quasi ridotta in schiavitù da 'super' umani psicopatici che avevamo creato noi giocando con l'ingegneria genetica. In quel periodo il Deep fece un balzo tecnologico improvviso e improbabile, che gli permise di costruire armi e navi molto più potenti di quelle degli Alpha, e la guerra contro di loro fu vinta."

units.id: mission:Deep Archaeology 5|	"There are popular folk tales in the Deep about 'elves,'" says Albert. "Thin, pale, graceful creatures, with blue blood."|273|0
units.english: "There are popular folk tales in the Deep about 'elves,'" says Albert. "Thin, pale, graceful creatures, with blue blood."
units.italian: "Nel Deep ci sono leggende popolari sugli 'elfi'," dice Albert. "Creature sottili, pallide, aggraziate, con il sangue blu."

units.id: mission:Deep Archaeology 5|	John frowns. "Hemocyanic blood. Not the Quarg, then. Their lungs are odd, but their blood uses hemoglobin for oxygen transport, just like ours."|274|0
units.english: John frowns. "Hemocyanic blood. Not the Quarg, then. Their lungs are odd, but their blood uses hemoglobin for oxygen transport, just like ours."
units.italian: John aggrotto la fronte. "Sangue emocianinico. Allora non sono Quarg. I loro polmoni sono strani, ma il sangue usa l'emoglobina per trasportare l'ossigeno, come il nostro."

units.id: mission:Deep Archaeology 5|	Albert and John give confused looks at each other for a second before Albert says, "The aliens that invaded human space?"|277|0
units.english: Albert and John give confused looks at each other for a second before Albert says, "The aliens that invaded human space?"
units.italian: Albert e John si scambiano uno sguardo confuso per un secondo, prima che Albert dica: "Gli alieni che hanno invaso lo spazio umano?"

units.id: mission:Deep Archaeology 5|	John appears to think hard on the subject before saying, "That's certainly an interesting connection. I don't know how we didn't think of it. From the descriptions that I've heard about them, they almost exactly match the folk tales in the Deep about 'elves.'"|278|0
units.english: John appears to think hard on the subject before saying, "That's certainly an interesting connection. I don't know how we didn't think of it. From the descriptions that I've heard about them, they almost exactly match the folk tales in the Deep about 'elves.'"
units.italian: John sembra rifletterci intensamente prima di dire: "È certamente un collegamento interessante. Non so come non ci abbiamo pensato. Da quello che ho sentito su di loro, corrispondono quasi esattamente alle leggende del Deep sugli 'elfi'."

units.id: mission:Deep Archaeology 5|	"Thin, pale, and blue blooded, yes? Well, I think you may have figured something out, Captain <last>," replies Albert.|279|0
units.english: "Thin, pale, and blue blooded, yes? Well, I think you may have figured something out, Captain <last>," replies Albert.
units.italian: "Sottili, pallidi e dal sangue blu, giusto? Beh, credo che tu abbia capito qualcosa, capitano <last>," risponde Albert.

units.id: mission:Deep Archaeology 5|	"That's great, but what does it mean for us?"|281|0
units.english: "That's great, but what does it mean for us?"
units.italian: "Ottimo, ma cosa significa per noi?"

units.id: mission:Deep Archaeology 5|	"From what I understand, they've been around for a while, and have mentioned past interference in the Deep."|283|0
units.english: "From what I understand, they've been around for a while, and have mentioned past interference in the Deep."
units.italian: "Da quello che so, esistono da un pezzo, e hanno parlato di interferenze passate nel Deep."

units.id: mission:Deep Archaeology 5|	"Well then, if the Pug have admitted to 'interfering' with the Deep in the past then we have good reason to believe they fit into our current knowledge of the timeline here," Albert replies. "Unfortunately we can't just ask the Pug exactly what they've done or when they did it, but simply knowing of their presence here aids in our research."|284|0
units.english: "Well then, if the Pug have admitted to 'interfering' with the Deep in the past then we have good reason to believe they fit into our current knowledge of the timeline here," Albert replies. "Unfortunately we can't just ask the Pug exactly what they've done or when they did it, but simply knowing of their presence here aids in our research."
units.italian: "Beh, allora se i Pug hanno ammesso di aver 'interferito' con il Deep in passato, abbiamo buone ragioni per credere che rientrino nella nostra conoscenza attuale della cronologia di qui," risponde Albert. "Sfortunatamente non possiamo semplicemente chiedere ai Pug cosa hanno fatto esattamente e quando, ma sapere della loro presenza qui aiuta la nostra ricerca."

units.id: mission:Deep Archaeology 5|	"Nothing immediately," says John, "but nevertheless, it is at least useful to know the timeline of events here."|287|0
units.english: "Nothing immediately," says John, "but nevertheless, it is at least useful to know the timeline of events here."
units.italian: "Niente di immediato," dice John, "ma comunque è almeno utile conoscere la cronologia degli eventi qui."

units.id: mission:Deep Archaeology 5|	"Indeed," replies Albert, "simply knowing of their presence here aids in our research."|288|0
units.english: "Indeed," replies Albert, "simply knowing of their presence here aids in our research."
units.italian: "Infatti," risponde Albert, "sapere della loro presenza qui aiuta la nostra ricerca."

units.id: mission:Deep Archaeology 5|	Albert continues, "What I think is that an unknown alien species has been involved in events in the Deep since the beginning, and is perhaps still involved there today. I think this is known to at least some of the Deep's inhabitants."|291|0
units.english: Albert continues, "What I think is that an unknown alien species has been involved in events in the Deep since the beginning, and is perhaps still involved there today. I think this is known to at least some of the Deep's inhabitants."
units.italian: Albert continua: "Quello che penso è che una specie aliena sconosciuta sia stata coinvolta negli eventi del Deep fin dall'inizio, e forse lo è ancora oggi. Penso che almeno alcuni abitanti del Deep lo sappiano."

units.id: mission:Deep Archaeology 5|	"So, what do we do now?"|294|0
units.english: "So, what do we do now?"
units.italian: "Allora, cosa facciamo adesso?"

units.id: mission:Deep Archaeology 5|	"How can we find out more information?"|295|0
units.english: "How can we find out more information?"
units.italian: "Come possiamo scoprire di più?"

units.id: mission:Deep Archaeology 5|	"Well," he says, "unfortunately, Captain, they're going to be watching you. I'll have to seek out someone else for the next stages of my research. But I will keep you notified if I discover anything further."|296|0
units.english: "Well," he says, "unfortunately, Captain, they're going to be watching you. I'll have to seek out someone else for the next stages of my research. But I will keep you notified if I discover anything further."
units.italian: "Beh," dice, "sfortunatamente, capitano, ti terranno d'occhio. Dovrò cercare qualcun altro per le prossime fasi della mia ricerca. Ma ti farò sapere se scopro altro."

units.id: mission:Deep Archaeology 5|	It is an unsatisfactory conclusion to your work, with so many questions unanswered. But to make up for that, Albert gives you <payment> as payment for your services. "You will hear from me again," he promises.|297|0
units.english: It is an unsatisfactory conclusion to your work, with so many questions unanswered. But to make up for that, Albert gives you <payment> as payment for your services. "You will hear from me again," he promises.
units.italian: È una conclusione insoddisfacente per il tuo lavoro, con così tante domande senza risposta. Ma per compensarti, Albert ti dà <payment> come pagamento per i tuoi servizi. "Sentirai ancora parlare di me," promette.

units.id: mission:Sad Archie|As your ship drifts through the cloud of dust that surrounds Ildaria, it occurs to you that this must be the "cloudy star out along the Rim" that Ulrich from There Might Be Riots told you about. Remembering his story, you shut your eyes and attempt to meditate. But instead, you just fall asleep.|352|0
units.english: As your ship drifts through the cloud of dust that surrounds Ildaria, it occurs to you that this must be the "cloudy star out along the Rim" that Ulrich from There Might Be Riots told you about. Remembering his story, you shut your eyes and attempt to meditate. But instead, you just fall asleep.
units.italian: Mentre la tua nave va alla deriva nella nube di polvere che circonda Ildaria, ti viene in mente che dev'essere la "stella nuvolosa lungo il Bordo" di cui ti aveva parlato Ulrich dei There Might Be Riots. Ricordando la sua storia, chiudi gli occhi e provi a meditare. Ma invece ti addormenti e basta.

units.id: mission:Sad Archie|You dream that you leave this star system and return to Zug, but when you land there everything is different: the cities you remember are gone, and in their place are other cities with strange architecture, populated by gargantuan dragon-like creatures.|354|0
units.english: You dream that you leave this star system and return to Zug, but when you land there everything is different: the cities you remember are gone, and in their place are other cities with strange architecture, populated by gargantuan dragon-like creatures.
units.italian: Sogni di lasciare questo sistema stellare e tornare su Zug, ma quando atterri lì tutto è diverso: le città che ricordi sono sparite, e al loro posto ci sono altre città dall'architettura strana, abitate da creature gigantesche simili a draghi.

units.id: mission:Sad Archie|	Time speeds up, and you watch as the dragon cities grow and spread out. You see one city buried under a massive lava flow, starships buzzing around it like a cloud of flies to carry people and goods to safety. Other cities are destroyed by war, and then abruptly the dragon-people are all gone and their cities lie vacant. Buildings crumble, and the forests reclaim the land.|355|0
units.english: Time speeds up, and you watch as the dragon cities grow and spread out. You see one city buried under a massive lava flow, starships buzzing around it like a cloud of flies to carry people and goods to safety. Other cities are destroyed by war, and then abruptly the dragon-people are all gone and their cities lie vacant. Buildings crumble, and the forests reclaim the land.
units.italian: Il tempo accelera e guardi le città dei draghi crescere e diffondersi. Vedi una città sepolta sotto una colata di lava enorme, con astronavi che le ronzano intorno come uno sciame di mosche per portare persone e merci in salvo. Altre città sono distrutte dalla guerra, e poi all'improvviso il popolo dei draghi non c'è più e le loro città restano vuote. Gli edifici crollano, e le foreste si riprendono la terra.

units.id: mission:Sad Archie|	Then you wake up and find yourself back in your ship, in the Ildaria system. Weird.|356|0
units.english: Then you wake up and find yourself back in your ship, in the Ildaria system. Weird.
units.italian: Poi ti svegli e ti ritrovi sulla tua nave, nel sistema Ildaria. Strano.

units.id: mission:Sad Archie|log|359|0
units.english: Experienced a strange vision while drifting in the Ildaria system that looked like the fall of a civilization of dragon-people. The terrain on the planet of Zug looks strikingly similar to this vision.
units.italian: Hai avuto una strana visione mentre andavi alla deriva nel sistema Ildaria, che sembrava la caduta di una civiltà di uomini-drago. Il terreno del pianeta Zug somiglia in modo impressionante a quella visione.

units.id: mission:Sad Archie|On a whim, as you're landing on Zug you pull up a geological map of the planet and find that the geography you dreamt of while drifting in the Ildaria system was surprisingly close to the real thing. There's even a massive basalt outcropping right where you saw a lava flow burying a city. There's no way your ship's sensors can tell what's underneath it, though.|366|0
units.english: On a whim, as you're landing on Zug you pull up a geological map of the planet and find that the geography you dreamt of while drifting in the Ildaria system was surprisingly close to the real thing. There's even a massive basalt outcropping right where you saw a lava flow burying a city. There's no way your ship's sensors can tell what's underneath it, though.
units.italian: Per un capriccio, mentre atterri su Zug apri una mappa geologica del pianeta e scopri che la geografia che avevi sognato mentre andavi alla deriva nel sistema Ildaria era sorprendentemente vicina alla realtà. C'è perfino un enorme affioramento di basalto proprio dove hai visto una colata di lava seppellire una città. I sensori della nave, però, non hanno modo di dire cosa c'è sotto.

units.id: mission:Rim Archaeology Reminder|name|373|0
units.english: Foster's Assistance?
units.italian: L'aiuto di Foster?

units.id: mission:Rim Archaeology Reminder|description|374|0
units.english: Head to <destination> and see if Albert Foster can help uncover Zug's mystery.
units.italian: Recati su <destination> e vedi se Albert Foster può aiutarti a scoprire il mistero di Zug.

units.id: mission:Rim Archaeology Reminder|As your ship settles down on <origin>, you recall the visions of an alien civilization you experienced while in Ildaria, and how the terrain you saw resembled the landscape of Zug. Perhaps Albert Foster can help you investigate further.|383|0
units.english: As your ship settles down on <origin>, you recall the visions of an alien civilization you experienced while in Ildaria, and how the terrain you saw resembled the landscape of Zug. Perhaps Albert Foster can help you investigate further.
units.italian: Mentre la nave si posa su <origin>, ricordi le visioni di una civiltà aliena che hai avuto a Ildaria, e come il terreno che vedevi somigliasse al paesaggio di Zug. Forse Albert Foster può aiutarti a indagare.

units.id: mission:Rim Archaeology 1|name|390|0
units.english: Archaeology on <planet>
units.italian: Archeologia su <planet>

units.id: mission:Rim Archaeology 1|description|391|0
units.english: Bring the famous archaeologist Albert Foster to <destination> to look for signs of an ancient alien civilization.
units.italian: Porta il famoso archeologo Albert Foster su <destination> per cercare segni di un'antica civiltà aliena.

units.id: mission:Rim Archaeology 1|blocked|395|0
units.english: You consider telling Albert Foster about your findings on Zug, but realize that you don't have a bunk free to take him there! Return when you have free space.
units.italian: Stai per raccontare ad Albert Foster quello che hai trovato su Zug, ma ti rendi conto di non avere una cuccetta libera per portarlo lì! Torna quando avrai spazio.

units.id: mission:Rim Archaeology 1|This planet is where the archaeologist Albert Foster has his lab, the one who sent you on a mission to collect samples from a planet in the Deep. Would you like to try to convince him to look for signs of an ancient alien civilization in the Rim systems?|405|0
units.english: This planet is where the archaeologist Albert Foster has his lab, the one who sent you on a mission to collect samples from a planet in the Deep. Would you like to try to convince him to look for signs of an ancient alien civilization in the Rim systems?
units.italian: Questo pianeta è dove l'archeologo Albert Foster ha il suo laboratorio, quello che ti ha mandato in missione a raccogliere campioni da un pianeta del Deep. Vuoi provare a convincerlo a cercare segni di un'antica civiltà aliena nei sistemi del Bordo?

units.id: mission:Rim Archaeology 1|	(Of course!)|407|0
units.english: (Of course!)
units.italian: (Certo!)

units.id: mission:Rim Archaeology 1|	(Not right now.)|408|0
units.english: (Not right now.)
units.italian: (Non ora.)

units.id: mission:Rim Archaeology 1|	Foster seems glad to see you. "It's been a while, <first>. Something catch your eye recently?"|412|0
units.english: Foster seems glad to see you. "It's been a while, <first>. Something catch your eye recently?"
units.italian: Foster sembra contento di vederti. "È passato un po' di tempo, <first>. Qualcosa ti ha colpito di recente?"

units.id: mission:Rim Archaeology 1|	Foster is slightly surprised by your arrival. "My apologies, but I haven't made any progress in the Deep since we last talked. Unless you have something else for me?"|415|0
units.english: Foster is slightly surprised by your arrival. "My apologies, but I haven't made any progress in the Deep since we last talked. Unless you have something else for me?"
units.italian: Foster è un po' sorpreso dal tuo arrivo. "Mi scuso, ma non ho fatto progressi nel Deep da quando ci siamo parlati. A meno che tu non abbia qualcos'altro per me?"

units.id: mission:Rim Archaeology 1|	You do your best to pique his interest without saying anything that will make him think you're crazy, but he's clearly not buying it. "I'm sorry," he says, "but I'm not mounting an expedition just because you have a 'hunch.' So unless you're willing to tell me the source of your information, I'm not interested." He turns his attention back to the data pad that he was reading before you walked into his office.|417|0
units.english: You do your best to pique his interest without saying anything that will make him think you're crazy, but he's clearly not buying it. "I'm sorry," he says, "but I'm not mounting an expedition just because you have a 'hunch.' So unless you're willing to tell me the source of your information, I'm not interested." He turns his attention back to the data pad that he was reading before you walked into his office.
units.italian: Fai del tuo meglio per stuzzicare il suo interesse senza dire nulla che gli faccia pensare che sei matto, ma chiaramente non ci crede. "Mi dispiace," dice, "ma non monto una spedizione solo perché hai un 'presentimento'. Quindi, a meno che tu non sia disposto a dirmi la fonte della tua informazione, non mi interessa." Torna a dedicarsi al tablet che stava leggendo prima che entrassi nel suo ufficio.

units.id: mission:Rim Archaeology 1|	"I'd rather not say."|419|0
units.english: "I'd rather not say."
units.italian: "Preferirei non dirlo."

units.id: mission:Rim Archaeology 1|	"I had this dream about dragon-people on Zug."|420|0
units.english: "I had this dream about dragon-people on Zug."
units.italian: "Ho fatto un sogno su uomini-drago su Zug."

units.id: mission:Rim Archaeology 1|	"I think a telepathic space alien spoke to me."|422|0
units.english: "I think a telepathic space alien spoke to me."
units.italian: "Credo che un alieno telepatico dello spazio mi abbia parlato."

units.id: mission:Rim Archaeology 1|	"Then I'd rather not help you," he says, without looking up from the data pad.|424|0
units.english: "Then I'd rather not help you," he says, without looking up from the data pad.
units.italian: "Allora preferisco non aiutarti," dice, senza alzare gli occhi dal tablet.

units.id: mission:Rim Archaeology 1|	"I had this dream about dragon-people on Zug."|426|0
units.english: "I had this dream about dragon-people on Zug."
units.italian: "Ho fatto un sogno su uomini-drago su Zug."

units.id: mission:Rim Archaeology 1|	"I think a telepathic space alien spoke to me."|427|0
units.english: "I think a telepathic space alien spoke to me."
units.italian: "Credo che un alieno telepatico dello spazio mi abbia parlato."

units.id: mission:Rim Archaeology 1|	"You had a dream," he says. "Sorry, no. Oneirological archaeology is notoriously unreliable." From his tone of voice, you think he's being sarcastic.|430|0
units.english: "You had a dream," he says. "Sorry, no. Oneirological archaeology is notoriously unreliable." From his tone of voice, you think he's being sarcastic.
units.italian: "Hai fatto un sogno," dice. "Mi dispiace, no. L'archeologia oneirologica è notoriamente inaffidabile." Dal tono, pensi che stia essere sarcastico.

units.id: mission:Rim Archaeology 1|	"I think a telepathic space alien spoke to me."|432|0
units.english: "I think a telepathic space alien spoke to me."
units.italian: "Credo che un alieno telepatico dello spazio mi abbia parlato."

units.id: mission:Rim Archaeology 1|	You expect him to laugh at you, but instead he's so shocked that he drops the data pad he's holding. "An Archon?" he says. "How the hell did you get tangled up with one of those?" You tell him the story, and he listens intently.|435|0
units.english: You expect him to laugh at you, but instead he's so shocked that he drops the data pad he's holding. "An Archon?" he says. "How the hell did you get tangled up with one of those?" You tell him the story, and he listens intently.
units.italian: Ti aspetti che rida di te, ma invece resta così scioccato che lascia cadere il tablet. "Un Archon?" dice. "Come diavolo hai fatto a finire invischiato con uno di quelli?" Gli racconti la storia, e lui ascolta con attenzione.

units.id: mission:Rim Archaeology 1|	"It's feasible," he says. "We've heard rumors from the Quarg that an alien civilization used to exist in the Rim, a hundred thousand years ago. No signs of it, of course - any artifacts they left behind have been destroyed by the elements, or perhaps intentionally removed. But if a city were encased in lava, that could preserve signs of it even over such a long time frame."|436|0
units.english: "It's feasible," he says. "We've heard rumors from the Quarg that an alien civilization used to exist in the Rim, a hundred thousand years ago. No signs of it, of course - any artifacts they left behind have been destroyed by the elements, or perhaps intentionally removed. But if a city were encased in lava, that could preserve signs of it even over such a long time frame."
units.italian: "È plausibile," dice. "Dai Quarg ci sono arrivati rumori di una civiltà aliena che esisteva nel Bordo, centomila anni fa. Nessuna traccia, naturalmente: qualsiasi manufatto abbiano lasciato è stato distrutto dagli elementi, o forse rimosso di proposito. Ma se una città fosse stata racchiusa nella lava, potrebbe conservare delle tracce anche per un intervallo così lungo."

units.id: mission:Rim Archaeology 1|	Foster makes a few phone calls to cancel his upcoming plans, and then shows up at your ship with a large collection of geological surveying tools. "Let's go check it out," he says.|437|0
units.english: Foster makes a few phone calls to cancel his upcoming plans, and then shows up at your ship with a large collection of geological surveying tools. "Let's go check it out," he says.
units.italian: Foster fa qualche telefonata per annullare i suoi prossimi impegni, poi si presenta alla tua nave con un grande set di strumenti per il rilevamento geologico. "Andiamo a dare un'occhiata," dice.

units.id: mission:Rim Archaeology 1|dialog|441|0
units.english: You land on <planet>, but realize that your escort carrying Albert hasn't entered the system yet. Better depart and wait for it.
units.italian: Atterri su <planet>, ma ti rendi conto che la tua scorta con Albert non è ancora entrata nel sistema. Meglio partire e aspettarla.

units.id: mission:Rim Archaeology 1|log|443|0
units.english: Found the archaeologist Albert Foster and told him about the vision of the dragon-people on Zug. Foster suggested that the vision was the doing of an Archon. He discovered a buried city under the lava flows on Zug; perhaps the vision was a real view of the past.
units.italian: Hai trovato l'archeologo Albert Foster e gli hai raccontato della visione degli uomini-drago su Zug. Foster ha suggerito che la visione sia opera di un Archon. Ha scoperto una città sepolta sotto le colate di lava di Zug; forse la visione era una vera immagine del passato.

units.id: mission:Rim Archaeology 1|You land your ship on the lava flow, and Albert Foster fires up his surveying equipment. "This will show me a density profile of different layers of rock beneath us," he says. As he gradually dials the instrument down to deeper and deeper layers, a few irregular white spots appear on the screen.|445|0
units.english: You land your ship on the lava flow, and Albert Foster fires up his surveying equipment. "This will show me a density profile of different layers of rock beneath us," he says. As he gradually dials the instrument down to deeper and deeper layers, a few irregular white spots appear on the screen.
units.italian: Posi la nave sulla colata di lava, e Albert Foster accende la sua attrezzatura da rilevamento. "Questo mi darà un profilo di densità dei diversi strati di roccia sotto di noi," dice. Mentre abbassa gradualmente lo strumento verso strati sempre più profondi, sullo schermo compaiono alcune macchie bianche irregolari.

units.id: mission:Rim Archaeology 1|	"What are those?"|447|0
units.english: "What are those?"
units.italian: "Cosa sono?"

units.id: mission:Rim Archaeology 1|	(Be quiet and let him focus.)|448|0
units.english: (Be quiet and let him focus.)
units.italian: (Sta' zitto e lascialo concentrare.)

units.id: mission:Rim Archaeology 1|	"Air pockets," he says, "some of them filled in with ground water. Nothing out of the ordinary."|450|0
units.english: "Air pockets," he says, "some of them filled in with ground water. Nothing out of the ordinary."
units.italian: "Sacche d'aria," dice, "alcune riempite di acqua sotterranea. Niente di straordinario."

units.id: mission:Rim Archaeology 1|	When the scan reaches about thirty meters below the surface, suddenly the view changes...|452|0
units.english: When the scan reaches about thirty meters below the surface, suddenly the view changes...
units.italian: Quando la scansione arriva a una trentina di metri sotto la superficie, all'improvviso la vista cambia...

units.id: mission:Rim Archaeology 1|	"Great burning suns!" says Foster. "There is something down there! Roads in a triangular grid. That ain't no human city." You both stare at the monitor for a minute, then Foster says, "I'm going to need to pull some permits. Meet me in the spaceport in an hour if you're willing to help pick up some of the other stuff we'll need."|454|0
units.english: "Great burning suns!" says Foster. "There is something down there! Roads in a triangular grid. That ain't no human city." You both stare at the monitor for a minute, then Foster says, "I'm going to need to pull some permits. Meet me in the spaceport in an hour if you're willing to help pick up some of the other stuff we'll need."
units.italian: "Per i grandi soli ardenti!" dice Foster. "C'è qualcosa laggiù! Strade disposte a griglia triangolare. Quella non è una città umana." Restate entrambi a fissare il monitor per un minuto, poi Foster dice: "Devo procurarmi dei permessi. Incontrami allo spazioporto tra un'ora, se sei disposto ad aiutarmi a prendere un po' della nostra altra attrezzatura."

units.id: mission:Rim Archaeology 2A|name|459|0
units.english: Archaeological Equipment
units.italian: Attrezzatura archeologica

units.id: mission:Rim Archaeology 2A|description|460|0
units.english: Fetch some excavation equipment from <destination>, and return with it to the dig site on Zug.
units.italian: Recupera un'attrezzatura di scavo da <destination> e portala al sito di scavo su Zug.

units.id: mission:Rim Archaeology 2A|When you meet up with Foster, he tells you, "This is going to be tricky. We're going to have to dig through a twenty meter thick slab of solid basalt to get at those ruins. We have to work fast, or my competitors will catch wind of what we're doing and beat us to the punch. But we have to work delicately, too, or we'll damage what's underneath. Blasting won't work. I think some of the Syndicate's strip mining equipment could do the job, though. Would you be able to pick up maybe twenty or thirty tons of heavy machinery from <planet>?"|468|0
units.english: When you meet up with Foster, he tells you, "This is going to be tricky. We're going to have to dig through a twenty meter thick slab of solid basalt to get at those ruins. We have to work fast, or my competitors will catch wind of what we're doing and beat us to the punch. But we have to work delicately, too, or we'll damage what's underneath. Blasting won't work. I think some of the Syndicate's strip mining equipment could do the job, though. Would you be able to pick up maybe twenty or thirty tons of heavy machinery from <planet>?"
units.italian: Quando ti incontri con Foster, ti dice: "La cosa sarà delicata. Dovremo scavare attraverso uno strato di basalto compatto spesso venti metri per arrivare a quelle rovine. Dobbiamo fare in fretta, o i miei concorrenti fiuteranno quello che stiamo facendo e ci batteranno sul tempo. Ma dobbiamo anche lavorare con delicatezza, o danneggeremo quello che c'è sotto. Con gli esplosivi non funzionerà. Credo però che l'attrezzatura per lo scavo a cielo aperto del Sindacato possa fare il lavoro. Riusciresti a prendere una ventina o una trentina di tonnellate di macchinari pesanti su <planet>?"

units.id: mission:Rim Archaeology 2A|	"Sure."|470|0
units.english: "Sure."
units.italian: "Certo."

units.id: mission:Rim Archaeology 2A|	"Sorry, I don't have time to help out anymore."|472|0
units.english: "Sorry, I don't have time to help out anymore."
units.italian: "Mi dispiace, non ho più tempo per aiutare."

units.id: mission:Rim Archaeology 2A|	He seems incredulous. "No time to participate in what could be one of the biggest discoveries of the last hundred years? You'll be well paid for your services too, if that's what's holding you back."|473|0
units.english: He seems incredulous. "No time to participate in what could be one of the biggest discoveries of the last hundred years? You'll be well paid for your services too, if that's what's holding you back."
units.italian: Sembra incredulo. "Niente tempo per partecipare a quella che potrebbe essere una delle più grandi scoperte degli ultimi cento anni? Sarai anche ben pagato per i tuoi servizi, se è questo che ti trattiene."

units.id: mission:Rim Archaeology 2A|	"Okay, I'll pick up your equipment from <planet>."|475|0
units.english: "Okay, I'll pick up your equipment from <planet>."
units.italian: "Va bene, prenderò la tua attrezzatura su <planet>."

units.id: mission:Rim Archaeology 2A|	"Sorry, I'm just not interested."|477|0
units.english: "Sorry, I'm just not interested."
units.italian: "Mi dispiace, non mi interessa."

units.id: mission:Rim Archaeology 2B|name|484|0
units.english: Archaeological Equipment
units.italian: Attrezzatura archeologica

units.id: mission:Rim Archaeology 2B|description|485|0
units.english: Deliver this excavation equipment to <destination>.
units.italian: Consegna questa attrezzatura di scavo su <destination>.

units.id: mission:Rim Archaeology 2B|blocked|491|0
units.english: You do not have enough cargo space to carry the equipment for Albert Foster's archaeological dig. Return here when you have at least 28 tons of space free.
units.italian: Non hai abbastanza spazio nel carico per trasportare l'attrezzatura per lo scavo archeologico di Albert Foster. Torna qui quando avrai almeno 28 tonnellate libere.

units.id: mission:Rim Archaeology 2B|When you arrive on <origin>, the excavation machines requested by Albert Foster are already waiting for you at the spaceport. They are some of the largest terrestrial vehicles you have ever seen: a truck with enormous toothed grinding wheels for cutting through stone, and a front-end loader for carrying the loose stone away. You are barely able to fit them through the entrance of your cargo bay.|495|0
units.english: When you arrive on <origin>, the excavation machines requested by Albert Foster are already waiting for you at the spaceport. They are some of the largest terrestrial vehicles you have ever seen: a truck with enormous toothed grinding wheels for cutting through stone, and a front-end loader for carrying the loose stone away. You are barely able to fit them through the entrance of your cargo bay.
units.italian: Quando arrivi su <origin>, i macchinari da scavo richiesti da Albert Foster ti aspettano già allo spazioporto. Sono tra i più grandi veicoli terrestri che tu abbia mai visto: un camion con enormi ruote dentate per tagliare la pietra, e una pala caricatrice per portare via la pietra sciolta. Riesci a malapena a farli passare dall'ingresso della tua stiva.

units.id: mission:Rim Archaeology 2B|dialog|499|0
units.english: You land on <planet>, but realize that your escort carrying the excavation equipment hasn't entered the system yet. Better depart and wait for it.
units.italian: Atterri su <planet>, ma ti rendi conto che la tua scorta con l'attrezzatura di scavo non è ancora entrata nel sistema. Meglio partire e aspettarla.

units.id: mission:Rim Archaeology 3A|name|507|0
units.english: Archaeological Equipment
units.italian: Attrezzatura archeologica

units.id: mission:Rim Archaeology 3A|description|508|0
units.english: Fetch some excavation equipment from <destination>, and return with it to the dig site on Zug.
units.italian: Recupera un'attrezzatura di scavo da <destination> e portala al sito di scavo su Zug.

units.id: mission:Rim Archaeology 3A|You drop off the excavation machines at the dig site on Zug, and receive your payment of three hundred thousand credits. Foster has already marked out lines of where he wants to dig and has completed a much more detailed geological scan. "We'll be starting with a narrow trench," he tells you, "and expanding out from there. It'll need to be wide enough to include a ramp for the vehicles, of course, so we'll still need to move a lot of rock. And when we get within the last five meters or so, I'm worried that the vibration from the grinders may be too destructive. So, I need some laser excavation equipment from <planet>, next."|516|0
units.english: You drop off the excavation machines at the dig site on Zug, and receive your payment of three hundred thousand credits. Foster has already marked out lines of where he wants to dig and has completed a much more detailed geological scan. "We'll be starting with a narrow trench," he tells you, "and expanding out from there. It'll need to be wide enough to include a ramp for the vehicles, of course, so we'll still need to move a lot of rock. And when we get within the last five meters or so, I'm worried that the vibration from the grinders may be too destructive. So, I need some laser excavation equipment from <planet>, next."
units.italian: Scarichi i macchinari da scavo al sito su Zug e ricevi il tuo pagamento di trecentomila crediti. Foster ha già tracciato le linee di dove vuole scavare e ha completato una scansione geologica molto più dettagliata. "Cominceremo con una trincea stretta," ti dice, "e poi allargheremo. Dovrà essere abbastanza larga da includere una rampa per i veicoli, naturalmente, quindi dovremo comunque spostare molta roccia. E quando arriveremo agli ultimi cinque metri, temo che le vibrazioni delle molatrici possano essere troppo distruttive. Perciò adesso mi serve un'attrezzatura di scavo laser da <planet>."

units.id: mission:Rim Archaeology 3A|	You agree to fetch the equipment, and he begins directing the work crews to get the digging started.|517|0
units.english: You agree to fetch the equipment, and he begins directing the work crews to get the digging started.
units.italian: Accetti di andare a prendere l'attrezzatura, e lui comincia a dirigere le squadre di scavo per far partire i lavori.

units.id: mission:Rim Archaeology 3B|name|524|0
units.english: Archaeological Equipment
units.italian: Attrezzatura archeologica

units.id: mission:Rim Archaeology 3B|description|525|0
units.english: Deliver this excavation equipment to <destination>. Be sure that the ship "Oxyrhynchus" is not in the system when you land.
units.italian: Consegna questa attrezzatura di scavo su <destination>. Assicurati che la nave "Oxyrhynchus" non sia nel sistema quando atterri.

units.id: mission:Rim Archaeology 3B|blocked|531|0
units.english: You do not have enough cargo space to carry the equipment for Albert Foster's archaeological dig. Return here when you have <capacity>.
units.italian: Non hai abbastanza spazio nel carico per trasportare l'attrezzatura per lo scavo archeologico di Albert Foster. Torna qui quando avrai <capacity>.

units.id: mission:Rim Archaeology 3B|Once again, the equipment that Foster needs is waiting for you when you land. It's a truck carrying a power generator and an articulated arm with a laser cannon mounted on the end. You can't help imagining what would happen if it malfunctioned and began firing while inside your cargo bay, but the engineer who delivers it assures you that it has many redundant safeties in place.|535|0
units.english: Once again, the equipment that Foster needs is waiting for you when you land. It's a truck carrying a power generator and an articulated arm with a laser cannon mounted on the end. You can't help imagining what would happen if it malfunctioned and began firing while inside your cargo bay, but the engineer who delivers it assures you that it has many redundant safeties in place.
units.italian: Anche questa volta l'attrezzatura che serve a Foster ti aspetta quando atterri. È un camion che trasporta un generatore di corrente e un braccio articolato con un cannone laser montato in punta. Non puoi fare a meno di immaginare cosa succederebbe se si guastasse e cominciasse a sparare dentro la stiva, ma l'ingegnere che te lo consegna ti assicura che ha molti sistemi di sicurezza ridondanti.

units.id: mission:Rim Archaeology 3B|	Also waiting for you is an encrypted message from Foster: "Hi there, <first>. I've been told that one of my competitors, Sibyl Greythatch, has been asking around trying to figure out where my dig site is. She's an antiquities thief - robs archaeological sites and sells the artifacts on the black market. I think my equipment purchase on <origin> may have caught her attention. If so, her ship, the Oxyrhynchus, will be following you. Don't return to the dig site until you're certain you've shaken her."|536|0
units.english: Also waiting for you is an encrypted message from Foster: "Hi there, <first>. I've been told that one of my competitors, Sibyl Greythatch, has been asking around trying to figure out where my dig site is. She's an antiquities thief - robs archaeological sites and sells the artifacts on the black market. I think my equipment purchase on <origin> may have caught her attention. If so, her ship, the Oxyrhynchus, will be following you. Don't return to the dig site until you're certain you've shaken her."
units.italian: Ti aspetta anche un messaggio cifrato di Foster: "Ciao, <first>. Mi hanno detto che una mia concorrente, Sibyl Greythatch, sta chiedendo in giro per scoprire dov'è il mio sito di scavo. È una ladra di antichità: saccheggia siti archeologici e vende i reperti al mercato nero. Penso che il mio acquisto di attrezzatura su <origin> possa aver attirato la sua attenzione. Se è così, la sua nave, l'Oxyrhynchus, ti seguirà. Non tornare al sito finché non sei certo di essertela tolta di dosso."

units.id: mission:Rim Archaeology 3B|As you are approaching Zug, you notice on your radar that the ship Foster warned you about has been following you: the Oxyrhynchus. You land in the main spaceport to avoid leading her to the dig site. You will need to shake her pursuit before delivering the equipment.|546|0
units.english: As you are approaching Zug, you notice on your radar that the ship Foster warned you about has been following you: the Oxyrhynchus. You land in the main spaceport to avoid leading her to the dig site. You will need to shake her pursuit before delivering the equipment.
units.italian: Mentre ti avvicini a Zug, noti sul radar che la nave di cui Foster ti aveva avvertito ti sta seguendo: l'Oxyrhynchus. Atterri allo spazioporto principale per non condurla al sito di scavo. Dovrai seminarla prima di consegnare l'attrezzatura.

units.id: mission:Rim Archaeology 4A|name|555|0
units.english: Transport a Xenobiologist
units.italian: Trasporta uno xenobiologo

units.id: mission:Rim Archaeology 4A|description|556|0
units.english: Travel to the Quarg station <destination>, and meet a xenobiologist who will help interpret the findings at Albert Foster's dig site.
units.italian: Viaggia verso la stazione Quarg <destination> e incontra uno xenobiologo che aiuterà a interpretare i ritrovamenti del sito di scavo di Albert Foster.

units.id: mission:Rim Archaeology 4A|When you return to the dig, Foster's trench is already almost ten meters deep. You tell him that you saw the Oxyrhynchus on your scanners, but you were able to evade it. "Good job," he says. "Now, we need a xenobiologist who can help us make sense of what we find. A friend of mine, Amelia Lee, has been living on the Quarg ringworld for the last decade or so, and she agreed to come visit the dig, and also to see what the Quarg can tell us about this old alien civilization. Also, here's your pay for transporting the laser cutter." He hands you another three hundred thousand credits.|564|0
units.english: When you return to the dig, Foster's trench is already almost ten meters deep. You tell him that you saw the Oxyrhynchus on your scanners, but you were able to evade it. "Good job," he says. "Now, we need a xenobiologist who can help us make sense of what we find. A friend of mine, Amelia Lee, has been living on the Quarg ringworld for the last decade or so, and she agreed to come visit the dig, and also to see what the Quarg can tell us about this old alien civilization. Also, here's your pay for transporting the laser cutter." He hands you another three hundred thousand credits.
units.italian: Quando torni allo scavo, la trincea di Foster è già quasi dieci metri di profondità. Gli dici che hai visto l'Oxyrhynchus sugli scanner, ma che sei riuscito a seminarla. "Bel lavoro," dice. "Ora ci serve uno xenobiologo che ci aiuti a dare un senso a quello che troviamo. Una mia amica, Amelia Lee, vive sul ringworld dei Quarg da una decina d'anni, e ha accettato di venire a visitare lo scavo, e anche di vedere cosa i Quarg possono dirci su questa vecchia civiltà aliena. Ecco anche il tuo compenso per il trasporto della taglierina laser." Ti consegna altri trecentomila crediti.

units.id: mission:Rim Archaeology 4A|	You agree to pick her up, and he returns to supervising the excavation.|565|0
units.english: You agree to pick her up, and he returns to supervising the excavation.
units.italian: Accetti di andare a prenderla, e lui torna a sovrintendere allo scavo.

units.id: mission:Rim Archaeology 4B|name|572|0
