units.english: Transport a Xenobiologist
units.italian: Trasporta uno xenobiologo

units.id: mission:Rim Archaeology 4B|description|573|0
units.english: Transport the xenobiologist Amelia Lee and her Quarg friend Yarthis to the dig site on Zug.
units.italian: Trasporta la xenobiologa Amelia Lee e la sua amica Quarg Yarthis al sito di scavo su Zug.

units.id: mission:Rim Archaeology 4B|blocked|579|0
units.english: You will need <capacity> to transport the xenobiologist that Albert Foster asked you to fetch. Return here when you have space available.
units.italian: Ti servirà <capacity> per trasportare la xenobiologa che Albert Foster ti ha chiesto di andare a prendere. Torna qui quando avrai spazio.

units.id: mission:Rim Archaeology 4B|Amelia Lee meets you at the spaceport, along with a Quarg who is a bit shorter than normal, but still tall enough to tower over you. "Captain <last>?" she says. "Let me introduce my friend Yarthis Amorthee Dek-Farsook Nai," she says. "Yarthis will be accompanying us to the site."|583|0
units.english: Amelia Lee meets you at the spaceport, along with a Quarg who is a bit shorter than normal, but still tall enough to tower over you. "Captain <last>?" she says. "Let me introduce my friend Yarthis Amorthee Dek-Farsook Nai," she says. "Yarthis will be accompanying us to the site."
units.italian: Amelia Lee ti incontra allo spazioporto, insieme a un Quarg un po' più basso del normale, ma comunque abbastanza alto da torreggiare su di te. "Capitano <last>?" dice. "Ti presento la mia amica Yarthis Amorthee Dek-Farsook Nai," dice. "Yarthis ci accompagnerà al sito."

units.id: mission:Rim Archaeology 4B|	"No problem. Welcome aboard!"|585|0
units.english: "No problem. Welcome aboard!"
units.italian: "Nessun problema. Benvenuti a bordo!"

units.id: mission:Rim Archaeology 4B|	"Do we really need to get the Quarg involved directly in this?"|587|0
units.english: "Do we really need to get the Quarg involved directly in this?"
units.italian: "Dobbiamo davvero coinvolgere direttamente i Quarg in questo?"

units.id: mission:Rim Archaeology 4B|	To your human eyes, unused to reading their expressions, the Quarg almost always seem grim and serious. But Yarthis seems particularly grave as it says, "You are digging in a graveyard, Captain. Someone must be present to see that the dead are given their due respect."|588|0
units.english: To your human eyes, unused to reading their expressions, the Quarg almost always seem grim and serious. But Yarthis seems particularly grave as it says, "You are digging in a graveyard, Captain. Someone must be present to see that the dead are given their due respect."
units.italian: Ai tuoi occhi umani, non abituati a leggere le loro espressioni, i Quarg sembrano quasi sempre cupi e seri. Ma Yarthis sembra particolarmente grave quando dice: "Stai scavando in un cimitero, capitano. Qualcuno deve essere presente per assicurarsi che ai morti sia dato il rispetto che meritano."

units.id: mission:Rim Archaeology 4B|	As both of them board your ship, Amelia chats enthusiastically with you. "One ringworld can sustain a population in excess of a trillion," she says, "so the Quarg need long names in order to unambiguously identify themselves." She goes on to ask questions about the progress of the dig, using so much technical jargon that at times it almost sounds like she is speaking the Quarg language rather than your own. Clearly she is very knowledgeable about the study of alien societies, and you are surprised to learn that she was actually born in Hai space, as the granddaughter of some of the first humans who settled there.|590|0
units.english: As both of them board your ship, Amelia chats enthusiastically with you. "One ringworld can sustain a population in excess of a trillion," she says, "so the Quarg need long names in order to unambiguously identify themselves." She goes on to ask questions about the progress of the dig, using so much technical jargon that at times it almost sounds like she is speaking the Quarg language rather than your own. Clearly she is very knowledgeable about the study of alien societies, and you are surprised to learn that she was actually born in Hai space, as the granddaughter of some of the first humans who settled there.
units.italian: Mentre salgono entrambe sulla tua nave, Amelia chiacchiera con entusiasmo. "Un ringworld può sostenere una popolazione superiore al bilione," dice, "quindi i Quarg hanno bisogno di nomi lunghi per identificarsi senza ambiguità." Continua a farti domande sullo stato dello scavo, usando così tanti termini tecnici che a tratti sembra quasi che parli il linguaggio dei Quarg invece del tuo. È chiaramente molto preparata sullo studio delle società aliene, e ti sorprende sapere che in realtà è nata nello spazio Hai, nipote di alcuni dei primi umani che vi si stabilirono.

units.id: mission:Rim Archaeology 4B|dialog|600|0
units.english: You land on <planet>, but realize that your escort carrying Amelia and Yarthis hasn't entered the system yet. Better depart and wait for it.
units.italian: Atterri su <planet>, ma ti rendi conto che la tua scorta con Amelia e Yarthis non è ancora entrata nel sistema. Meglio partire e aspettarla.

units.id: mission:Rim Archaeology 5A|name|608|0
units.english: Defend Zug
units.italian: Difendi Zug

units.id: mission:Rim Archaeology 5A|description|609|0
units.english: Drive off the pirates who are attacking Zug, or at least distract them for long enough for reinforcements to arrive.
units.italian: Scaccia i pirati che stanno attaccando Zug, o almeno distraili abbastanza da farti arrivare i rinforzi.

units.id: mission:Rim Archaeology 5A|Foster greets Amelia enthusiastically when you land, but seems less enthusiastic about having Yarthis here as well. The dig has nearly reached the target depth, and at the deepest part of the trench they are now slicing out blocks of stone with the laser and hoisting them out of the pit rather than just grinding through the rock. "Thanks again, Captain," he says, as he hands you a chip worth two hundred thousand credits.|616|0
units.english: Foster greets Amelia enthusiastically when you land, but seems less enthusiastic about having Yarthis here as well. The dig has nearly reached the target depth, and at the deepest part of the trench they are now slicing out blocks of stone with the laser and hoisting them out of the pit rather than just grinding through the rock. "Thanks again, Captain," he says, as he hands you a chip worth two hundred thousand credits.
units.italian: Foster accoglie Amelia con entusiasmo quando atterri, ma sembra meno entusiasta di avere anche Yarthis qui. Lo scavo ha quasi raggiunto la profondità prevista, e nella parte più profonda della trincea ora tagliano blocchi di pietra con il laser e li issano fuori dalla fossa invece di limitarsi a macinare la roccia. "Grazie di nuovo, capitano," dice, consegnandoti un gettone del valore di duecentomila crediti.

units.id: mission:Rim Archaeology 5A|	As Foster is showing the three of you around the dig, one of the workers runs up. "Mister Foster," he says, "there's a ton of traffic on the emergency militia channel. I think the planet is under attack."|617|0
units.english: As Foster is showing the three of you around the dig, one of the workers runs up. "Mister Foster," he says, "there's a ton of traffic on the emergency militia channel. I think the planet is under attack."
units.italian: Mentre Foster vi sta mostrando lo scavo, uno degli operai accorre. "Signor Foster," dice, "c'è un sacco di traffico sul canale di emergenza della milizia. Penso che il pianeta sia sotto attacco."

units.id: mission:Rim Archaeology 5A|	Foster swears and looks up at the sky as if expecting pirates to swoop down and steal his precious artifacts at any moment. "Captain <last>," he says, "We have to keep those pirates away from the dig at all costs, or they could destroy priceless information. Can you assist in defending the planet?"|618|0
units.english: Foster swears and looks up at the sky as if expecting pirates to swoop down and steal his precious artifacts at any moment. "Captain <last>," he says, "We have to keep those pirates away from the dig at all costs, or they could destroy priceless information. Can you assist in defending the planet?"
units.italian: Foster impreca e guarda il cielo come se si aspettasse che i pirati piombino giù da un momento all'altro a rubare i suoi preziosi reperti. "Capitano <last>," dice, "dobbiamo tenere quei pirati lontani dallo scavo a ogni costo, o potrebbero distruggere informazioni inestimabili. Puoi aiutarci a difendere il pianeta?"

units.id: mission:Rim Archaeology 5A|	"Of course."|620|0
units.english: "Of course."
units.italian: "Certamente."

units.id: mission:Rim Archaeology 5A|	"My ship is not a warship."|622|0
units.english: "My ship is not a warship."
units.italian: "La mia nave non è una nave da guerra."

units.id: mission:Rim Archaeology 5A|	"Then just get up there and lead them around in circles until reinforcements arrive," he says. "I don't care how you do it, just keep whoever is up there occupied."|623|0
units.english: "Then just get up there and lead them around in circles until reinforcements arrive," he says. "I don't care how you do it, just keep whoever is up there occupied."
units.italian: "Allora sali lassù e portali in giro in circolo finché non arrivano i rinforzi," dice. "Non m'importa come, tieni solo occupato chiunque sia lassù."

units.id: mission:Rim Archaeology 5A|	As you run for your ship, you see Yarthis pull out some sort of communication device and speak into it. Perhaps the Quarg will be joining in this fight as well...|625|0
units.english: As you run for your ship, you see Yarthis pull out some sort of communication device and speak into it. Perhaps the Quarg will be joining in this fight as well...
units.italian: Mentre corri verso la nave, vedi Yarthis tirare fuori una specie di dispositivo di comunicazione e parlarci dentro. Forse anche i Quarg parteciperanno a questa battaglia...

units.id: mission:Rim Archaeology 5A|dialog|638|0
units.english: The last of the pirate raiders have been driven off. Time to land and check if any damage was done to the dig.
units.italian: Gli ultimi predoni pirata sono stati scacciati. È il momento di atterrare e controllare se lo scavo ha subito danni.

units.id: mission:Rim Archaeology 5A|You try to land near the dig, but pirate ships are still circling nearby. Better deal with them before returning to check in on Foster.|648|0
units.english: You try to land near the dig, but pirate ships are still circling nearby. Better deal with them before returning to check in on Foster.
units.italian: Provi ad atterrare vicino allo scavo, ma le navi pirata stanno ancora girando lì intorno. Meglio occupartene prima di tornare a controllare Foster.

units.id: mission:Rim Archaeology 5A|log|653|0
units.english: With the help of a Quarg ship, fought off a group of antique thieves looking to rob the archaeological site that Albert Foster dug up. Foster will need some time to study what he has found and release the results of his findings.
units.italian: Con l'aiuto di una nave Quarg, hai respinto un gruppo di ladri di antichità che volevano saccheggiare il sito archeologico scavato da Albert Foster. Foster avrà bisogno di tempo per studiare ciò che ha trovato e pubblicare i risultati.

units.id: mission:Rim Archaeology 5A|A plume of smoke is rising from the dig site. Fearing the worst, you land and find out that a missile fired by one of the pirates destroyed one of the huts where the workers were living, but fortunately no one was inside it at the time. Foster is shaken but still committed to finishing the work. "It will be months before we've excavated enough to be able to publish any findings," he says, "but Yarthis has told me that the Quarg will be stationing a Wardragon here for the remainder of the project, to prevent any further foul play." Foster gives you one last payment: four hundred thousand credits for your help driving off the pirates. "And I'll be sure to give you credit for your help when the news goes public," he says.|655|0
units.english: A plume of smoke is rising from the dig site. Fearing the worst, you land and find out that a missile fired by one of the pirates destroyed one of the huts where the workers were living, but fortunately no one was inside it at the time. Foster is shaken but still committed to finishing the work. "It will be months before we've excavated enough to be able to publish any findings," he says, "but Yarthis has told me that the Quarg will be stationing a Wardragon here for the remainder of the project, to prevent any further foul play." Foster gives you one last payment: four hundred thousand credits for your help driving off the pirates. "And I'll be sure to give you credit for your help when the news goes public," he says.
units.italian: Una colonna di fumo si alza dal sito di scavo. Temendo il peggio, atterri e scopri che un missile sparato da uno dei pirati ha distrutto una delle baracche dove vivevano gli operai, ma per fortuna in quel momento non c'era nessuno dentro. Foster è scosso ma ancora deciso a finire il lavoro. "Ci vorranno mesi prima di aver scavato abbastanza da poter pubblicare qualcosa," dice, "ma Yarthis mi ha detto che i Quarg stazioneranno qui un Guardiadraghi per il resto del progetto, per evitare altre scorrettezze." Foster ti dà un ultimo compenso: quattrocentomila crediti per il tuo aiuto a scacciare i pirati. "E mi assicurerò che ti sia dato il merito del tuo aiuto quando la notizia diventerà pubblica," dice.

units.id: event:rim archaeology results|description|676|0
units.english: Zug is a pleasant world of rolling hills, fertile fields, and a few small oceans. Hundreds of millions of people live here, with more immigrants arriving every day, almost faster than the construction industry can keep up with them. In addition to the larger cities, many people live in smaller farming villages, making this one of the few worlds in the region that is truly self-sufficient both in industry and in agriculture.
units.italian: Zug è un mondo piacevole, di colline ondulate, campi fertili e qualche piccolo oceano. Centinaia di milioni di persone vivono qui, con nuovi immigrati che arrivano ogni giorno, quasi più in fretta di quanto l'industria delle costruzioni riesca a stargli dietro. Oltre alle città più grandi, molta gente vive in piccoli villaggi agricoli, il che rende questo uno dei pochi mondi della regione davvero autosufficienti sia nell'industria sia nell'agricoltura.

units.id: event:rim archaeology results|description|677|0
units.english: The largest industry on Zug is Southbound Shipyards. However, in the wake of some extraordinary archaeological discoveries of a lost civilization, Zug has suddenly also become a popular destination for tourists.
units.italian: L'industria più grande di Zug sono i Cantieri Southbound. Tuttavia, sulla scia di alcune straordinarie scoperte archeologiche di una civiltà perduta, Zug è diventata all'improvviso anche una meta turistica popolare.

units.id: mission:Rim Archaeology 6|log|690|0
units.english: Recent archaeological discoveries on Zug, a planet in the southern rim of human space, have turned up evidence of a lost alien civilization. The Quarg say that the ruins were left behind by a species called the Sheragi.
units.italian: Recenti scoperte archeologiche su Zug, un pianeta del bordo meridionale dello spazio umano, hanno portato alla luce prove di una civiltà aliena perduta. I Quarg dicono che le rovine sono state lasciate da una specie chiamata Sheragi.

units.id: mission:Rim Archaeology 6|When you give your name to the spaceport traffic controller, he says, "Wait, you're Captain <first> <last>? You're all over the news right now!"|692|0
units.english: When you give your name to the spaceport traffic controller, he says, "Wait, you're Captain <first> <last>? You're all over the news right now!"
units.italian: Quando dai il tuo nome al controllo del traffico dello spazioporto, quello dice: "Aspetta, sei il capitano <first> <last>? Sei su tutti i notiziari in questo momento!"

units.id: mission:Rim Archaeology 6|	You land and find that Albert Foster has published an initial report on the dig on Zug. The ruins under the lava flow did indeed turn out to be an alien city. The houses are built on a gargantuan scale, with most of the doorways at least ten meters tall. What's more, some of the buildings have no exterior doors on the street level, just doors facing balconies or inner courtyards, which supports the theory that the inhabitants were capable of flight. Most of the artifacts left behind are just everyday items, and in fact the technology seems less advanced than present human society, but scientists are studying the artifacts eagerly to glean hints about how these aliens lived.|693|0
units.english: You land and find that Albert Foster has published an initial report on the dig on Zug. The ruins under the lava flow did indeed turn out to be an alien city. The houses are built on a gargantuan scale, with most of the doorways at least ten meters tall. What's more, some of the buildings have no exterior doors on the street level, just doors facing balconies or inner courtyards, which supports the theory that the inhabitants were capable of flight. Most of the artifacts left behind are just everyday items, and in fact the technology seems less advanced than present human society, but scientists are studying the artifacts eagerly to glean hints about how these aliens lived.
units.italian: Atterri e scopri che Albert Foster ha pubblicato un primo rapporto sullo scavo di Zug. Le rovine sotto la colata di lava si sono rivelate davvero una città aliena. Le case sono costruite in scala gigantesca, con la maggior parte delle porte alta almeno dieci metri. Inoltre, alcuni edifici non hanno porte esterne a livello della strada, ma solo porte che danno su balconi o cortili interni, il che sostiene la teoria che gli abitanti fossero capaci di volare. La maggior parte dei reperti ritrovati sono semplici oggetti quotidiani, e in effetti la tecnologia sembra meno avanzata di quella della società umana attuale, ma gli scienziati studiano i reperti con avidità per ricavarne indizi su come vivevano questi alieni.

units.id: mission:Rim Archaeology 6|	The Quarg, who at other times seem quite willing to share their knowledge with human beings, are being surprisingly reticent with information about this lost civilization. Aside from telling Foster that the aliens were known as the Sheragi, their only comments have been vague warnings that if human beings persist in developing weapons of war, they will end up like the Sheragi. From this, Foster has surmised that the alien civilization was most likely destroyed by a civil war, not by natural disaster or an attack by another species.|694|0
units.english: The Quarg, who at other times seem quite willing to share their knowledge with human beings, are being surprisingly reticent with information about this lost civilization. Aside from telling Foster that the aliens were known as the Sheragi, their only comments have been vague warnings that if human beings persist in developing weapons of war, they will end up like the Sheragi. From this, Foster has surmised that the alien civilization was most likely destroyed by a civil war, not by natural disaster or an attack by another species.
units.italian: I Quarg, che in altre occasioni sembrano ben disposti a condividere le loro conoscenze con gli esseri umani, sono sorprendentemente reticenti sulle informazioni riguardanti questa civiltà perduta. A parte dire a Foster che gli alieni erano noti come Sheragi, i loro unici commenti sono stati vaghi avvertimenti: se gli esseri umani continueranno a sviluppare armi da guerra, finiranno come gli Sheragi. Da questo Foster ha dedotto che la civiltà aliena fu molto probabilmente distrutta da una guerra civile, non da un disastro naturale o dall'attacco di un'altra specie.

units.id: mission:Rim Archaeology 6|	It may not yield any great advances in human technology, but the dig will be providing clues to the history of the galaxy for years to come, and you can be proud to have played a part in that.|695|0
units.english: It may not yield any great advances in human technology, but the dig will be providing clues to the history of the galaxy for years to come, and you can be proud to have played a part in that.
units.italian: Potrebbe non portare a grandi progressi nella tecnologia umana, ma lo scavo fornirà indizi sulla storia della galassia per anni a venire, e puoi essere orgoglioso di avervi avuto un ruolo.

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 1|name|702|0
units.english: The Sheragi Bunker
units.italian: Il bunker Sheragi

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 1|description|703|0
units.english: Visit Albert Foster on <destination> to see what he has discovered.
units.italian: Visita Albert Foster su <destination> per vedere cosa ha scoperto.

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 1|You receive an encoded message from Albert Foster, the archaeologist who you helped to uncover the mysterious Sheragi ruins on Zug. He seems to be very excited.|716|0
units.english: You receive an encoded message from Albert Foster, the archaeologist who you helped to uncover the mysterious Sheragi ruins on Zug. He seems to be very excited.
units.italian: Ricevi un messaggio cifrato da Albert Foster, l'archeologo che hai aiutato a riportare alla luce le misteriose rovine Sheragi su Zug. Sembra molto emozionato.

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 1|	"<first>! Been a while, hasn't it? Remember the Sheragi dig site? We've just found something incredible here. Please, come visit me on Zug. I don't think I can trust anyone else with this."|717|0
units.english: "<first>! Been a while, hasn't it? Remember the Sheragi dig site? We've just found something incredible here. Please, come visit me on Zug. I don't think I can trust anyone else with this."
units.italian: "<first>! È passato un po' di tempo, eh? Ti ricordi del sito Sheragi? Abbiamo appena trovato qualcosa di incredibile qui. Per favore, vieni a trovarmi su Zug. Non credo di poter affidare questo a nessun altro."

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 2|name|723|0
units.english: The Mysterious Box
units.italian: La scatola misteriosa

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 2|description|724|0
units.english: Take the mysterious box to a trusted scientist on <destination>.
units.italian: Porta la scatola misteriosa a uno scienziato di fiducia su <destination>.

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 2|You land at the dig site and notice that Albert was already waiting for you, watching your descent. He greets you as soon as the ship doors open.|733|0
units.english: You land at the dig site and notice that Albert was already waiting for you, watching your descent. He greets you as soon as the ship doors open.
units.italian: Atterri al sito di scavo e noti che Albert ti stava già aspettando, guardando la tua discesa. Ti saluta appena si aprono le porte della nave.

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 2|	"Hello, <first>! Would you like to go on a little tour of the museum?"|734|0
units.english: "Hello, <first>! Would you like to go on a little tour of the museum?"
units.italian: "Ciao, <first>! Ti va di fare un piccolo giro del museo?"

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 2|	"Museum? What museum?"|736|0
units.english: "Museum? What museum?"
units.italian: "Museo? Quale museo?"

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 2|	"Sure, I'm eager to see what you discovered."|737|0
units.english: "Sure, I'm eager to see what you discovered."
units.italian: "Certo, sono impaziente di vedere cosa hai scoperto."

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 2|	"Just tell me what's so important."|739|0
units.english: "Just tell me what's so important."
units.italian: "Dimmi solo cosa c'è di così importante."

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 2|	"Didn't you know? There is a museum open within the dig site now, full of interesting artifacts. We turned it into quite the tourist trap. Here, follow me and I'll show you."|741|0
units.english: "Didn't you know? There is a museum open within the dig site now, full of interesting artifacts. We turned it into quite the tourist trap. Here, follow me and I'll show you."
units.italian: "Non lo sapevi? Ora c'è un museo aperto nel sito di scavo, pieno di reperti interessanti. L'abbiamo trasformato in una bella trappola per turisti. Vieni, ti faccio vedere."

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 2|	You take the chance to catch up as he leads you into the ancient city's ruins, talking about the "minor" discoveries he has made so far, though he insists on keeping the reason he brought you here a surprise. He leads you to one of the Sheragi buildings that have been uncovered, skipping a long queue lined before the entrance to find that the room has been filled with various artifacts in display cases.|743|0
units.english: You take the chance to catch up as he leads you into the ancient city's ruins, talking about the "minor" discoveries he has made so far, though he insists on keeping the reason he brought you here a surprise. He leads you to one of the Sheragi buildings that have been uncovered, skipping a long queue lined before the entrance to find that the room has been filled with various artifacts in display cases.
units.italian: Cogli l'occasione per aggiornarvi mentre ti guida nelle rovine dell'antica città, parlando delle "minori" scoperte fatte finora, anche se insiste a tenere segreta la ragione per cui ti ha chiamato. Ti conduce a uno degli edifici Sheragi riportati alla luce, saltando una lunga fila davanti all'ingresso, e scopri che la sala è stata riempita di reperti in teche di vetro.

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 2|	It's strange to see so many technological devices as old as some of the prehistoric tools from ancient Earth, most of them so deteriorated you wouldn't even be able to imagine what they were used for if it wasn't for the descriptions next to their display cases. One of the most intact relics is a small metal statue of an individual Sheragi in flight like the dragons of Skymoot, possibly a trophy for some event, or perhaps a mere sculpture of a popular character of their time. It's impossible to know now, but one thing is certain: it's the most faithful representation available of what they looked like. The figure matches almost perfectly the ones you saw in your dream, back in Ildaria. As you turn your head to look at how tall the doors of this house are, then back at the statue again, you realize how big they must have been. It's hard to imagine the size their spaceships must have been to even hope to fit a creature this large.|744|0
units.english: It's strange to see so many technological devices as old as some of the prehistoric tools from ancient Earth, most of them so deteriorated you wouldn't even be able to imagine what they were used for if it wasn't for the descriptions next to their display cases. One of the most intact relics is a small metal statue of an individual Sheragi in flight like the dragons of Skymoot, possibly a trophy for some event, or perhaps a mere sculpture of a popular character of their time. It's impossible to know now, but one thing is certain: it's the most faithful representation available of what they looked like. The figure matches almost perfectly the ones you saw in your dream, back in Ildaria. As you turn your head to look at how tall the doors of this house are, then back at the statue again, you realize how big they must have been. It's hard to imagine the size their spaceships must have been to even hope to fit a creature this large.
units.italian: È strano vedere tanti dispositivi tecnologici vecchi quanto alcuni degli utensili preistorici della Terra antica, la maggior parte dei quali così deteriorati che non riusciresti nemmeno a immaginare a cosa servissero, se non fosse per le descrizioni accanto alle teche. Uno dei reperti più intatti è una piccola statua metallica di un singolo Sheragi in volo, come i draghi di Skymoot, forse un trofeo per qualche evento, o magari solo una scultura di un personaggio popolare del loro tempo. Oggi è impossibile saperlo, ma una cosa è certa: è la rappresentazione più fedele disponibile di come apparivano. La figura corrisponde quasi perfettamente a quelle che hai visto nel tuo sogno, a Ildaria. Quando volti la testa per guardare quanto sono alte le porte di questa casa, e poi torni a guardare la statua, ti rendi conto di quanto dovessero essere grandi. È difficile immaginare quanto dovessero essere grandi le loro astronavi per sperare di contenere una creatura di quelle dimensioni.

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 2|	"This is an impressive collection."|746|0
units.english: "This is an impressive collection."
units.italian: "È una collezione impressionante."

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 2|	"It is! But it's not even the main attraction for you today. Follow me."|747|0
units.english: "It is! But it's not even the main attraction for you today. Follow me."
units.italian: "Lo è! Ma non è nemmeno l'attrazione principale per te oggi. Seguimi."

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 2|	After the tour is over, he leads you to another building in an area that is off-limits to the general public.|748|0
units.english: After the tour is over, he leads you to another building in an area that is off-limits to the general public.
units.italian: Finita la visita, ti conduce in un altro edificio, in una zona vietata al pubblico.

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 2|	"Straight to the point? Fair enough, I'm eager as well, but do come visit the museum some time in the future. There are so many interesting objects."|751|0
units.english: "Straight to the point? Fair enough, I'm eager as well, but do come visit the museum some time in the future. There are so many interesting objects."
units.italian: "Diretto al punto? Va bene, anch'io sono impaziente, ma passa qualche volta a visitare il museo in futuro. Ci sono tanti oggetti interessanti."

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 2|	You take the chance to catch up as he leads you into the ancient city's ruins, talking about the "minor" discoveries he made so far, such as statues of Sheragi that depict what they once looked like. "We would perhaps never know their appearance had we not found something like it. But these small discoveries are not the main attraction for you today," Albert says with a wide smile. He leads you into one of the uncovered Sheragi buildings, in an area that is off-limits to the public.|752|0
units.english: You take the chance to catch up as he leads you into the ancient city's ruins, talking about the "minor" discoveries he made so far, such as statues of Sheragi that depict what they once looked like. "We would perhaps never know their appearance had we not found something like it. But these small discoveries are not the main attraction for you today," Albert says with a wide smile. He leads you into one of the uncovered Sheragi buildings, in an area that is off-limits to the public.
units.italian: Cogli l'occasione per aggiornarvi mentre ti guida nelle rovine dell'antica città, parlando delle "minori" scoperte fatte finora, come le statue Sheragi che mostrano come apparivano un tempo. "Forse non avremmo mai conosciuto il loro aspetto se non avessimo trovato qualcosa del genere. Ma queste piccole scoperte non sono l'attrazione principale per te oggi," dice Albert con un ampio sorriso. Ti conduce in uno degli edifici Sheragi riportati alla luce, in una zona vietata al pubblico.

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 2|label|753|0
units.english: off limit
units.italian: off limit

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 2|	"Here it is!"|754|0
units.english: "Here it is!"
units.italian: "Eccolo qui!"

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 2|	There is a tunnel going deep underground inside the room, but Albert sets his attention on a large safe instead. As he opens it up, he begins to explain the situation.|755|0
units.english: There is a tunnel going deep underground inside the room, but Albert sets his attention on a large safe instead. As he opens it up, he begins to explain the situation.
units.italian: Nella stanza c'è un tunnel che scende in profondità, ma Albert punta l'attenzione su una grande cassaforte. Mentre la apre, comincia a spiegare la situazione.

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 2|	"So, from what we know, the Sheragi died off in a war of catastrophic proportions. One of our interns suggested we survey deeper underground, to check for military facilities or bunkers, even though our previous scans didn't show anything interesting, so we allowed her to play around with the ground-penetrating radar. And wouldn't you believe it, there were some angled pieces of metal under the dirt. Clearly man-made. Well... Sheragi-made, in this case. So we dug deeper, and found what we can only assume to have been a bunker, showing signs of having been hit by a powerful kinetic weapon. Despite the damage, we could still salvage some artifacts from the debris. Particularly, this thing."|756|0
units.english: "So, from what we know, the Sheragi died off in a war of catastrophic proportions. One of our interns suggested we survey deeper underground, to check for military facilities or bunkers, even though our previous scans didn't show anything interesting, so we allowed her to play around with the ground-penetrating radar. And wouldn't you believe it, there were some angled pieces of metal under the dirt. Clearly man-made. Well... Sheragi-made, in this case. So we dug deeper, and found what we can only assume to have been a bunker, showing signs of having been hit by a powerful kinetic weapon. Despite the damage, we could still salvage some artifacts from the debris. Particularly, this thing."
units.italian: "Dunque, da quello che sappiamo, gli Sheragi si estinsero in una guerra di proporzioni catastrofiche. Una delle nostre stagiste ha suggerito di fare un rilevamento più profondo, per cercare installazioni militari o bunker, anche se le nostre scansioni precedenti non mostravano nulla di interessante, così le abbiamo permesso di giocare con il radar penetrante. E non ci crederai: sotto la terra c'erano dei pezzi di metallo angolari. Chiaramente fatti dall'uomo. Beh... dagli Sheragi, in questo caso. Così abbiamo scavato più a fondo e trovato quello che possiamo solo supporre fosse un bunker, con i segni di essere stato colpito da un'arma cinetica potente. Nonostante i danni, siamo riusciti a recuperare alcuni reperti dalle macerie. In particolare, questa cosa."

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 2|	Albert opens the safe and shows you a weathered, red metal cube, around a quarter of a meter on each side. He struggles with the weight, but manages to set it down on the floor.|757|0
units.english: Albert opens the safe and shows you a weathered, red metal cube, around a quarter of a meter on each side. He struggles with the weight, but manages to set it down on the floor.
units.italian: Albert apre la cassaforte e ti mostra un cubo di metallo rosso, consumato, di circa un quarto di metro per lato. Fatica per il peso, ma riesce a posarlo sul pavimento.

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 2|	"This appears to be a data storage device of some sort. It was connected to what we think were once computers, but nothing else was salvageable after spending thousands of years under the wet soil. Based on how sturdy this thing is, it's plausible that some of the data could have survived, like a time capsule.|758|0
units.english: "This appears to be a data storage device of some sort. It was connected to what we think were once computers, but nothing else was salvageable after spending thousands of years under the wet soil. Based on how sturdy this thing is, it's plausible that some of the data could have survived, like a time capsule.
units.italian: "Questo sembra un dispositivo di archiviazione dati, di qualche tipo. Era collegato a quelli che pensiamo fossero computer, ma nient'altro era recuperabile dopo migliaia di anni sotto il terreno bagnato. Considerando quanto è robusto, è plausibile che alcuni dati siano sopravvissuti, come in una capsula del tempo.

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 2|	"I have a contact back on Vinci who could probably figure this out, and this is where you come in. You remember John, right? I can't leave the dig site, but I also don't have anyone else I could trust to carry such a valuable artifact. Will you take it there for me?"|759|0
units.english: "I have a contact back on Vinci who could probably figure this out, and this is where you come in. You remember John, right? I can't leave the dig site, but I also don't have anyone else I could trust to carry such a valuable artifact. Will you take it there for me?"
units.italian: "Ho un contatto su Vinci che probabilmente saprebbe risolverlo, ed è qui che entri in gioco tu. Ti ricordi di John, vero? Non posso lasciare il sito di scavo, ma non ho nessun altro di cui mi fidi per portare un reperto così prezioso. Lo porteresti tu?"

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 2|	"Sure, I'll take the cube to him."|761|0
units.english: "Sure, I'll take the cube to him."
units.italian: "Certo, porto io il cubo da lui."

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 2|	"Who's John again?"|763|0
units.english: "Who's John again?"
units.italian: "Chi è John, già?"

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 2|	"I'm sorry, but that sounds sketchier than all the other jobs I did for you. The Quarg were very clear in saying that some things are not meant to be found."|764|0
units.english: "I'm sorry, but that sounds sketchier than all the other jobs I did for you. The Quarg were very clear in saying that some things are not meant to be found."
units.italian: "Mi dispiace, ma mi sembra più losco di tutti gli altri lavori che ho fatto per te. I Quarg sono stati molto chiari: certe cose non sono destinate a essere trovate."

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 2|	"Oh, you don't remember him? He's the scientist who worked with us when we were investigating the church on Midgard. He has all the fancy equipment needed to look into this cube."|766|0
units.english: "Oh, you don't remember him? He's the scientist who worked with us when we were investigating the church on Midgard. He has all the fancy equipment needed to look into this cube."
units.italian: "Oh, non lo ricordi? È lo scienziato che lavorava con noi quando indagavamo sulla chiesa di Midgard. Ha tutta l'attrezzatura sofisticata che serve per esaminare questo cubo."

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 2|	"What?" He seems incredulous. "After going this far, you're abandoning me? Knowledge by itself isn't dangerous. This cube could be the key to lost eons of history, to secrets of the Sheragi we couldn't even dream of!"|769|0
units.english: "What?" He seems incredulous. "After going this far, you're abandoning me? Knowledge by itself isn't dangerous. This cube could be the key to lost eons of history, to secrets of the Sheragi we couldn't even dream of!"
units.italian: "Come?" Sembra incredulo. "Arrivati a questo punto, mi abbandoni? La conoscenza in sé non è pericolosa. Questo cubo potrebbe essere la chiave di eoni perduti di storia, di segreti sugli Sheragi che non potremmo nemmeno sognare!"

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 2|label|770|0
units.english: final choice
units.italian: final choice

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 2|	"All right, I'll take it to him."|772|0
units.english: "All right, I'll take it to him."
units.italian: "Va bene, glielo porto."

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 2|	"Sorry, but I'm not crossing that line."|773|0
units.english: "Sorry, but I'm not crossing that line."
units.italian: "Mi dispiace, ma quella linea non la oltrepasso."

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 2|	"Splendid!"|776|0
units.english: "Splendid!"
units.italian: "Splendido!"

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 2|	You put the cube in an inconspicuous backpack and carry it back to your ship. Albert gives you an address where you'll deliver the cube, mentions that you will be paid after transporting it, and wishes you good luck on your travel.|777|0
units.english: You put the cube in an inconspicuous backpack and carry it back to your ship. Albert gives you an address where you'll deliver the cube, mentions that you will be paid after transporting it, and wishes you good luck on your travel.
units.italian: Metti il cubo in uno zaino poco appariscente e lo porti alla tua nave. Albert ti dà un indirizzo dove consegnarlo, ti ricorda che sarai pagato dopo il trasporto, e ti augura buon viaggio.

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 2|log|783|0
units.english: Took a mysterious Sheragi data cube that Albert Foster dug up on Zug to a trusted friend on Vinci. John will take some time to see how exactly it works, and send a message when it's done.
units.italian: Hai portato un misterioso cubo dati Sheragi, scavato da Albert Foster su Zug, a un amico fidato su Vinci. John avrà bisogno di tempo per capire esattamente come funziona, e manderà un messaggio quando avrà finito.

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 2|You arrive on Vinci and carry the cube to the address Foster gave you. You find that John has been waiting for you. "So, Foster is up to no good again, huh?" He laughs as he lets you into his lab.|785|0
units.english: You arrive on Vinci and carry the cube to the address Foster gave you. You find that John has been waiting for you. "So, Foster is up to no good again, huh?" He laughs as he lets you into his lab.
units.italian: Arrivi su Vinci e porti il cubo all'indirizzo che ti ha dato Foster. Trovi John che ti aspettava. "Quindi Foster è di nuovo nei guai, eh?" Ride mentre ti fa entrare nel suo laboratorio.

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 2|	"It doesn't seem likely that we'll get in trouble this time."|787|0
units.english: "It doesn't seem likely that we'll get in trouble this time."
units.italian: "Non sembra probabile che finiremo nei guai questa volta."

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 2|	"I'm slightly concerned myself, but I'm sure he knows what he's doing."|788|0
units.english: "I'm slightly concerned myself, but I'm sure he knows what he's doing."
units.italian: "Anche io sono un po' preoccupato, ma sono sicuro che sa quello che fa."

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 2|	You set the backpack with the cube down on a table and open it up.|789|0
units.english: You set the backpack with the cube down on a table and open it up.
units.italian: Posi lo zaino con il cubo su un tavolo e lo apri.

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 2|	"Well, he's paying me to help with this, so no problem with me. It's not like everyone gets to see the exotic things he finds first hand. I mean, an artificial singularity..." he trails off, reminiscing about the adventure the three of you had in the Deep.|790|0
units.english: "Well, he's paying me to help with this, so no problem with me. It's not like everyone gets to see the exotic things he finds first hand. I mean, an artificial singularity..." he trails off, reminiscing about the adventure the three of you had in the Deep.
units.italian: "Beh, mi paga per aiutarlo, quindi per me nessun problema. Non capita a tutti di vedere in prima persona le cose esotiche che trova. Voglio dire, una singolarità artificiale..." si interrompe, ricordando l'avventura che avete vissuto tutti e tre nel Deep.

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 2|	John proceeds to examine the cube. He's strong enough to pick it up with no problems and look at it from different angles, trying to find some port to connect to. He finds one, but it's so deteriorated that any attempts to use it would be fruitless. He places the cube inside a machine to take a deeper scan of the object, and watches it silently working, staring patiently at the screen.|791|0
units.english: John proceeds to examine the cube. He's strong enough to pick it up with no problems and look at it from different angles, trying to find some port to connect to. He finds one, but it's so deteriorated that any attempts to use it would be fruitless. He places the cube inside a machine to take a deeper scan of the object, and watches it silently working, staring patiently at the screen.
units.italian: John procede a esaminare il cubo. È abbastanza forte da sollevarlo senza problemi e guardarlo da angolazioni diverse, cercando qualche porta a cui collegarsi. Ne trova una, ma è così deteriorata che qualsiasi tentativo di usarla sarebbe inutile. Mette il cubo dentro una macchina per fare una scansione più profonda dell'oggetto, e la guarda lavorare in silenzio, fissando paziente lo schermo.

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 2|	"Yes, this seems to be a data storage device of some sort... it's made to be sturdy, like a black box, so it's plausible that we could recover some data from it. This is going to take a very long time, though."|792|0
units.english: "Yes, this seems to be a data storage device of some sort... it's made to be sturdy, like a black box, so it's plausible that we could recover some data from it. This is going to take a very long time, though."
units.italian: "Sì, questo sembra un dispositivo di archiviazione dati di qualche tipo... è fatto per essere robusto, come una scatola nera, quindi è plausibile che possiamo recuperare dei dati. Però ci vorrà molto tempo."

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 2|	"How long?" you ask.|793|0
units.english: "How long?" you ask.
units.italian: "Quanto tempo?" chiedi.

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 2|	"A couple months, probably. It depends on how alien this thing is, and if it's encrypted or not, but I should at least figure out if there is any recoverable data in here by then."|794|0
units.english: "A couple months, probably. It depends on how alien this thing is, and if it's encrypted or not, but I should at least figure out if there is any recoverable data in here by then."
units.italian: "Un paio di mesi, probabilmente. Dipende da quanto è aliena questa cosa, e se è criptata o no, ma almeno dovrei capire se c'è dentro qualche dato recuperabile."

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 2|	John says he'll drop you a message once his results come out, and you part ways and return to your ship.|795|0
units.english: John says he'll drop you a message once his results come out, and you part ways and return to your ship.
units.italian: John dice che ti manderà un messaggio quando avrà i risultati, e vi separate, tu torni alla tua nave.

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 3|name|803|0
units.english: The Information Dealer
units.italian: Il venditore di informazioni

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 3|description|804|0
units.english: Discover the whereabouts of the box from an information broker on the pirate world of <destination>.
units.italian: Scopri dove si trova la scatola grazie a un intermediario di informazioni sul mondo pirata di <destination>.

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 3|You receive an urgent call from John, who has been working on the mysterious Sheragi black box for about a month now.|816|0
units.english: You receive an urgent call from John, who has been working on the mysterious Sheragi black box for about a month now.
units.italian: Ricevi una chiamata urgente da John, che lavora alla misteriosa scatola nera Sheragi da circa un mese.

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 3|	"Captain <last>! I have some bad news and some worse news. Which one do you want to hear first?"|817|0
units.english: "Captain <last>! I have some bad news and some worse news. Which one do you want to hear first?"
units.italian: "Capitano <last>! Ho una brutta notizia e una notizia peggiore. Quale vuoi sentire prima?"

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 3|	"The bad news."|819|0
units.english: "The bad news."
units.italian: "La brutta notizia."

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 3|	"The worse news."|821|0
units.english: "The worse news."
units.italian: "La notizia peggiore."

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 3|	"The bad news is that this is a lot more complicated than I thought. I found out that the data in the box has survived, and can still be recovered after all this time, but it will need some specialized hardware and knowledge that we don't have yet."|824|0
units.english: "The bad news is that this is a lot more complicated than I thought. I found out that the data in the box has survived, and can still be recovered after all this time, but it will need some specialized hardware and knowledge that we don't have yet."
units.italian: "La brutta notizia è che è molto più complicato di quanto pensassi. Ho scoperto che i dati nella scatola sono sopravvissuti e si possono ancora recuperare dopo tutto questo tempo, ma serviranno hardware specializzato e conoscenze che non abbiamo ancora."

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 3|	"And the worse news?" you ask.|825|0
units.english: "And the worse news?" you ask.
units.italian: "E la notizia peggiore?" chiedi.

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 3|	"Well... some people invaded my lab during the night and stole a lot of the things I was working on. Thankfully my insurance covers most of it, and I still have most of my heavy expensive equipment, but the box... it's gone."|826|0
units.english: "Well... some people invaded my lab during the night and stole a lot of the things I was working on. Thankfully my insurance covers most of it, and I still have most of my heavy expensive equipment, but the box... it's gone."
units.italian: "Beh... alcune persone hanno fatto irruzione nel mio laboratorio durante la notte e hanno rubato molte delle cose su cui stavo lavorando. Per fortuna l'assicurazione copre quasi tutto, e ho ancora la maggior parte delle mie attrezzature pesanti e costose, ma la scatola... è sparita."

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 3|	"Well... some people invaded my lab during the night, and stole a lot of the things I was working on. Thankfully my insurance covers most of it, and I still have most of my heavy expensive equipment, but the box... it's gone."|829|0
units.english: "Well... some people invaded my lab during the night, and stole a lot of the things I was working on. Thankfully my insurance covers most of it, and I still have most of my heavy expensive equipment, but the box... it's gone."
units.italian: "Beh... qualcuno si è intrufolato nel mio laboratorio stanotte e ha rubato molte delle cose su cui stavo lavorando. Per fortuna l'assicurazione copre quasi tutto, e ho ancora la maggior parte delle mie attrezzature pesanti e costose, ma la scatola... è sparita."

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 3|	"And the bad news?" you ask.|830|0
units.english: "And the bad news?" you ask.
units.italian: "E la brutta notizia?" chiedi.

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 3|	"The less bad news is that this is a lot more complicated than I thought. I found out that the data in the box has survived, and can still be recovered after all this time, but it will need some specialized hardware and knowledge that we don't have yet."|831|0
units.english: "The less bad news is that this is a lot more complicated than I thought. I found out that the data in the box has survived, and can still be recovered after all this time, but it will need some specialized hardware and knowledge that we don't have yet."
units.italian: "La notizia meno brutta è che è molto più complicato di quanto pensassi. Ho scoperto che i dati nella scatola sono sopravvissuti e si possono ancora recuperare dopo tutto questo tempo, ma serviranno hardware specializzato e conoscenze che non abbiamo ancora."

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 3|label|832|0
units.english: what now
units.italian: what now

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 3|	Your heart sinks. "What do we do now? Do you have any idea where to find the box? Did you contact law enforcement?"|833|0
units.english: Your heart sinks. "What do we do now? Do you have any idea where to find the box? Did you contact law enforcement?"
units.italian: Ti si stringe il cuore. "Cosa facciamo adesso? Hai idea di dove trovare la scatola? Hai contattato le autorità?"

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 3|	"I did what I could, but if this was mandated as I suspect, the police aren't going to help, and the box is probably off-world by now. However... if you have some cash on hand, and you're willing to go the extra mile to recover the box, there might be a way."|834|0
units.english: "I did what I could, but if this was mandated as I suspect, the police aren't going to help, and the box is probably off-world by now. However... if you have some cash on hand, and you're willing to go the extra mile to recover the box, there might be a way."
units.italian: "Ho fatto quello che potevo, ma se è andata come sospetto, la polizia non aiuterà, e la scatola a quest'ora sarà probabilmente fuori dal pianeta. Però... se hai un po' di contanti e sei disposto a fare un passo in più per recuperarla, potrebbe esserci un modo."

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 3|	"What do you mean?"|836|0
units.english: "What do you mean?"
units.italian: "Che vuoi dire?"

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 3|	"Are you trying to extort me?"|838|0
units.english: "Are you trying to extort me?"
units.italian: "Stai cercando di estorcermi?"

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 3|	"What? No, of course not! Do you think I would steal my own work? Let me explain.|839|0
units.english: "What? No, of course not! Do you think I would steal my own work? Let me explain.
units.italian: "Cosa? No, certo che no! Pensi che ruberei il mio stesso lavoro? Fammi spiegare.

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 3|	"Albert's methods are... nonstandard, to say the least, and we've dealt with a certain individual once. An information dealer who lives on Stormhold. Sketchy person, seems to have informants nearly everywhere and knows about everything. The individual in question is known as Mammon. If you want to find the box, dealing with Mammon is probably your best bet."|841|0
units.english: "Albert's methods are... nonstandard, to say the least, and we've dealt with a certain individual once. An information dealer who lives on Stormhold. Sketchy person, seems to have informants nearly everywhere and knows about everything. The individual in question is known as Mammon. If you want to find the box, dealing with Mammon is probably your best bet."
units.italian: "I metodi di Albert sono... non standard, a dir poco, e una volta abbiamo avuto a che fare con un certo individuo. Un venditore di informazioni che vive su Stormhold. Persona losca, sembra avere informatori quasi ovunque e sa tutto. L'individuo in questione è noto come Mammon. Se vuoi trovare la scatola, trattare con Mammon è probabilmente la tua migliore possibilità."

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 3|	"Thank you, I'll see if I can find this Mammon person."|843|0
units.english: "Thank you, I'll see if I can find this Mammon person."
units.italian: "Grazie, vedrò se riesco a trovare questo Mammon."

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 3|	"I'm sorry, but I think nothing good can come out of this. Better to forget about the cube."|844|0
units.english: "I'm sorry, but I think nothing good can come out of this. Better to forget about the cube."
units.italian: "Mi dispiace, ma credo che non possa venirne nulla di buono. Meglio dimenticare il cubo."

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 3|	"Knowing their methods, they'll likely find you first. But don't be alarmed, they're not... evil, per se. Just be careful, alright?"|846|0
units.english: "Knowing their methods, they'll likely find you first. But don't be alarmed, they're not... evil, per se. Just be careful, alright?"
units.italian: "Conoscendo i loro metodi, è probabile che ti trovino prima loro. Ma non allarmarti, non sono... malvagi, di per sé. Stai solo attento, va bene?"

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 4|name|856|0
units.english: The Search for the Artifact
units.italian: Alla ricerca del reperto

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 4|description|857|0
units.english: Confront the mercenaries who stole the cube on <destination>.
units.italian: Affronta i mercenari che hanno rubato il cubo su <destination>.

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 4|Despite the obvious hostility the locals display towards you, you've safely entered Stormhold's atmosphere. You're still halfway through the descent when a robotic, modulated voice hails you.|868|0
units.english: Despite the obvious hostility the locals display towards you, you've safely entered Stormhold's atmosphere. You're still halfway through the descent when a robotic, modulated voice hails you.
units.italian: Nonostante l'ostilità evidente che gli abitanti ti mostrano, sei entrato senza problemi nell'atmosfera di Stormhold. Sei ancora a metà della discesa quando una voce robotica e modulata ti chiama.

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 4|	"I heard you were looking for me, <first> <last>," the person on the other end says.|869|0
units.english: "I heard you were looking for me, <first> <last>," the person on the other end says.
units.italian: "Ho sentito che mi stavi cercando, <first> <last>," dice la persona dall'altra parte.

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 4|	"Who are you? How do you know my name?"|872|0
units.english: "Who are you? How do you know my name?"
units.italian: "Chi sei? Come conosci il mio nome?"

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 4|	"You did? How?"|874|0
units.english: "You did? How?"
units.italian: "Davvero? Come?"

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 4|	"In my line of business, I have to know everything. That includes the identities of any potential clients, such as yourself. How else would you hope to find me?|875|0
units.english: "In my line of business, I have to know everything. That includes the identities of any potential clients, such as yourself. How else would you hope to find me?
units.italian: "Nel mio mestiere devo sapere tutto. Compresa l'identità di eventuali clienti, come te. Altrimenti come speravi di trovarmi?

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 4|	The mysterious person laughs.|879|0
units.english: The mysterious person laughs.
units.italian: La persona misteriosa ride.

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 4|	"It looks like I know you more than you know yourself. I am who you're looking for, of course.|880|0
units.english: "It looks like I know you more than you know yourself. I am who you're looking for, of course.
units.italian: "Sembra che io sappia di te più di quanto tu sappia di te stesso. Sono chi stai cercando, naturalmente.

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 4|	"Mammon, information vendor. At your service," the voice states ominously. "Come meet me in person to discuss the specifics of what you're looking for." The connection cuts and you receive coordinates to land in a seemingly random location that appears to be in the middle of the sea.|883|0
units.english: "Mammon, information vendor. At your service," the voice states ominously. "Come meet me in person to discuss the specifics of what you're looking for." The connection cuts and you receive coordinates to land in a seemingly random location that appears to be in the middle of the sea.
units.italian: "Mammon, venditore di informazioni. Al tuo servizio," dichiara la voce con tono sinistro. "Vieni a incontrarmi di persona per discutere i dettagli di quello che cerchi." La comunicazione si interrompe e ricevi le coordinate per atterrare in un punto apparentemente casuale, che sembra in mezzo al mare.

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 4|	You arrive at the coordinates in the middle of nowhere under stormy conditions. You begin to question whether you received the correct coordinates until a massive submarine emerges from the waves. It is a gargantuan vessel, and as lights guide you to land on its deck, you notice that despite the size of your ship, it comfortably fits on the deck, where it is automatically secured in place by magnetic locks. Armed men in business suits surround your ship, and once you disembark, two of them guide you inside. You're led into a dimly lit room with a holographic map of the galaxy on the ceiling and a desk, behind which a hooded figure sits.|885|0
units.english: You arrive at the coordinates in the middle of nowhere under stormy conditions. You begin to question whether you received the correct coordinates until a massive submarine emerges from the waves. It is a gargantuan vessel, and as lights guide you to land on its deck, you notice that despite the size of your ship, it comfortably fits on the deck, where it is automatically secured in place by magnetic locks. Armed men in business suits surround your ship, and once you disembark, two of them guide you inside. You're led into a dimly lit room with a holographic map of the galaxy on the ceiling and a desk, behind which a hooded figure sits.
units.italian: Arrivi alle coordinate in mezzo al nulla, in condizioni di tempesta. Cominci a chiederti se hai ricevuto le coordinate giuste, finché dalle onde non emerge un sottomarino enorme. È un vascello gigantesco, e mentre le luci ti guidano ad atterrare sul ponte, noti che, nonostante le dimensioni della tua nave, ci sta comodamente, e vi viene bloccata in posizione da fermi magnetici. Uomini armati in abiti scuri circondano la nave, e quando sbarchi due di loro ti guidano dentro. Ti conducono in una stanza in penombra, con una mappa olografica della galassia sul soffitto e una scrivania, dietro la quale siede una figura incappucciata.

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 4|	"There we are, away from prying eyes. Please, take a seat," they say. Their voice has a strange tone with no distinguishable gender, with a sibilating, guttural accent, and it's not until you sit down that you notice a reptilian snout poking out of the hood. You don't know whether this is natural or an extreme body modification.|886|0
units.english: "There we are, away from prying eyes. Please, take a seat," they say. Their voice has a strange tone with no distinguishable gender, with a sibilating, guttural accent, and it's not until you sit down that you notice a reptilian snout poking out of the hood. You don't know whether this is natural or an extreme body modification.
units.italian: "Eccoci, lontano da occhi indiscreti. Prego, accomodati," dice. La voce ha un tono strano, senza un genere distinguibile, con un accento sibilante e gutturale, e solo quando ti siedi noti un muso rettiliano che spunta dal cappuccio. Non sai se sia naturale o una modifica corporea estrema.

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 4|	"Are you a..."|888|0
units.english: "Are you a..."
units.italian: "Sei un..."

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 4|	(Say nothing.)|889|0
units.english: (Say nothing.)
units.italian: (Non dire nulla.)

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 4|	They cut you off, grinning. "Forget it. You'd need to steal whole planets for that information."|891|0
units.english: They cut you off, grinning. "Forget it. You'd need to steal whole planets for that information."
units.italian: Ti interrompe, sogghignando. "Lascia perdere. Per quell'informazione dovresti rubare interi pianeti."

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 4|	"Let's get to what matters. You want to find that alien artifact, yes?" You nod in response. "I have the information you need. Finding lost objects is the most trivial of my services, but as with everything, it has a price.|894|0
units.english: "Let's get to what matters. You want to find that alien artifact, yes?" You nod in response. "I have the information you need. Finding lost objects is the most trivial of my services, but as with everything, it has a price.
units.italian: "Arriviamo a quello che conta. Vuoi trovare quel reperto alieno, giusto?" Annuisci in risposta. "Ho l'informazione che ti serve. Trovare oggetti perduti è il più banale dei miei servizi, ma come ogni cosa ha un prezzo.

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 4|	"Ten million credits," they say. "Non-negotiable. And don't try anything funny."|895|0
units.english: "Ten million credits," they say. "Non-negotiable. And don't try anything funny."
units.italian: "Dieci milioni di crediti," dice. "Non negoziabile. E non provare scherzi."

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 4|	"What? I don't have that much money!"|900|0
units.english: "What? I don't have that much money!"
units.italian: "Cosa? Non ho tutti quei soldi!"

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 4|	"That's expensive. If it's such a trivial service, can't I have a discount?"|902|0
units.english: "That's expensive. If it's such a trivial service, can't I have a discount?"
units.italian: "È caro. Se è un servizio così banale, non posso avere uno sconto?"

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 4|You come back to Stormhold and receive new coordinates to meet with Mammon. Would you like to visit them?|906|0
units.english: You come back to Stormhold and receive new coordinates to meet with Mammon. Would you like to visit them?
units.italian: Torni su Stormhold e ricevi nuove coordinate per incontrare Mammon. Vuoi andarci?

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 4|	(Yes.)|908|0
units.english: (Yes.)
units.italian: (Sì.)

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 4|	(No.)|909|0
units.english: (No.)
units.italian: (No.)

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 4|	You follow the new coordinates, arriving again in a random place in the sea, again under stormy conditions, which seems to be the norm on this planet. The submarine emerges, you land, and follow the men to Mammon's room once again.|911|0
units.english: You follow the new coordinates, arriving again in a random place in the sea, again under stormy conditions, which seems to be the norm on this planet. The submarine emerges, you land, and follow the men to Mammon's room once again.
units.italian: Segui le nuove coordinate e arrivi di nuovo in un punto casuale del mare, di nuovo con il maltempo, che sembra essere la norma su questo pianeta. Il sottomarino emerge, atterri, e segui di nuovo gli uomini fino alla stanza di Mammon.

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 4|	"Welcome back," they say.|912|0
units.english: "Welcome back," they say.
units.italian: "Bentornato," dice.

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 4|	"I hope you are ready to make your payment."|913|0
units.english: "I hope you are ready to make your payment."
units.italian: "Spero che tu sia pronto a pagare."

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 4|	"You should know that I don't have that much money to spare."|921|0
units.english: "You should know that I don't have that much money to spare."
units.italian: "Sai bene che non ho tutti quei soldi da parte."

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 4|	"Are you ready to give me a discount?"|923|0
units.english: "Are you ready to give me a discount?"
units.italian: "Sei pronto a farmi uno sconto?"

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 4|	"You should know that I don't have that much money to spare."|927|0
units.english: "You should know that I don't have that much money to spare."
units.italian: "Sai bene che non ho tutti quei soldi da parte."

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 4|	"How about you tell me what I want and I don't blow up your ship and your pirate friends?"|929|0
units.english: "How about you tell me what I want and I don't blow up your ship and your pirate friends?"
units.italian: "Che ne dici se mi dici quello che voglio e io non faccio saltare in aria la tua nave e i tuoi amici pirati?"

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 4|	"I need to think about this. Give me some time."|936|0
units.english: "I need to think about this. Give me some time."
units.italian: "Devo pensarci. Dammi un po' di tempo."

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 4|	"That's a lot of money just for information. Can you make it cheaper?"|938|0
units.english: "That's a lot of money just for information. Can you make it cheaper?"
units.italian: "Sono un sacco di soldi solo per un'informazione. Puoi farmi un prezzo migliore?"

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 4|	"Here's the money."|940|0
units.english: "Here's the money."
units.italian: "Ecco i soldi."

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 4|label|942|0
units.english: haggled cash
units.italian: haggled cash

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 4|	"I need to think about this. Give me some time."|944|0
units.english: "I need to think about this. Give me some time."
units.italian: "Devo pensarci. Dammi un po' di tempo."

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 4|	"How about you tell me what I want and I don't blow up your ship and your pirate friends?"|946|0
units.english: "How about you tell me what I want and I don't blow up your ship and your pirate friends?"
units.italian: "Che ne dici se mi dici quello che voglio e io non faccio saltare in aria la tua nave e i tuoi amici pirati?"

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 4|	"Here's the money."|948|0
units.english: "Here's the money."
units.italian: "Ecco i soldi."

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 4|label|951|0
units.english: no money
units.italian: no money

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 4|	"I know you don't. I can arrange for the payment to be made in different ways. Organ donation, prostitution, volunteering as a test subject... We'll need an appraisal first, though."|952|0
units.english: "I know you don't. I can arrange for the payment to be made in different ways. Organ donation, prostitution, volunteering as a test subject... We'll need an appraisal first, though."
units.italian: "Lo so che non li hai. Posso organizzare il pagamento in altri modi. Donazione di organi, prostituzione, volontariato come cavia... ma prima dovremo fare una valutazione."

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 4|	You politely decline.|953|0
units.english: You politely decline.
units.italian: Rifiuti con cortesia.

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 4|	"Come back to me when you have it, then, and I shall provide you with the information. We have all the time in the universe. Until you die, or someone decides to destroy the cube, that is."|954|0
units.english: "Come back to me when you have it, then, and I shall provide you with the information. We have all the time in the universe. Until you die, or someone decides to destroy the cube, that is."
units.italian: "Allora torna da me quando li avrai, e ti fornirò l'informazione. Abbiamo tutto il tempo dell'universo. Fino alla tua morte, o finché qualcuno non deciderà di distruggere il cubo, naturalmente."

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 4|	"Come back when you're ready, then. We have all the time in the universe. Until you die, or someone decides to destroy the cube, that is. It's all up to you."|958|0
units.english: "Come back when you're ready, then. We have all the time in the universe. Until you die, or someone decides to destroy the cube, that is. It's all up to you."
units.italian: "Allora torna quando sei pronto. Abbiamo tutto il tempo dell'universo. Fino alla tua morte, o finché qualcuno non deciderà di distruggere il cubo, naturalmente. Dipende tutto da te."

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 4|	They gesture, and the men promptly and diligently escort you back out to your ship.|961|0
units.english: They gesture, and the men promptly and diligently escort you back out to your ship.
units.italian: Fa un gesto, e gli uomini ti riaccompagnano prontamente e diligentemente alla tua nave.

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 4|	Mammon doesn't look pleased.|967|0
units.english: Mammon doesn't look pleased.
units.italian: Mammon non sembra soddisfatto.

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 4|	"What part of non-negotiable did you not understand? You're pushing your luck, Captain <last>. I didn't expect you to be such a petty money pincher."|968|0
units.english: "What part of non-negotiable did you not understand? You're pushing your luck, Captain <last>. I didn't expect you to be such a petty money pincher."
units.italian: "Quale parte di 'non negoziabile' non hai capito? Stai tirando troppo la corda, capitano <last>. Non pensavo che fossi così tirchio."

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 4|	Mammon just smiles, displaying sharp teeth and licking them with a forked tongue, more entertained than intimidated.|972|0
units.english: Mammon just smiles, displaying sharp teeth and licking them with a forked tongue, more entertained than intimidated.
units.italian: Mammon si limita a sorridere, mostrando denti aguzzi e leccandoli con una lingua biforcuta, più divertito che intimidito.

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 4|	"Really? You think you can intimidate me? It's your funeral, human. If you were smart, you would know that my power far exceeds yours, especially in my own home. You know I can't let you leave here alive now. It would set a bad precedent for me. Safety is my top priority."|973|0
units.english: "Really? You think you can intimidate me? It's your funeral, human. If you were smart, you would know that my power far exceeds yours, especially in my own home. You know I can't let you leave here alive now. It would set a bad precedent for me. Safety is my top priority."
units.italian: "Davvero? Pensi di potermi intimidire? Sarà il tuo funerale, umano. Se fossi intelligente, sapresti che il mio potere supera di gran lunga il tuo, soprattutto a casa mia. Sai che ora non posso lasciarti andare via vivo. Sarebbe un precedente negativo per me. La sicurezza è la mia priorità assoluta."

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 4|	You look around, and the men in suits are pointing guns at you. Alien guns. Before you can react, Mammon shoots you from under the table, fatally injuring your abdomen. Your half conscious body is dragged out of the submarine, and your ship being shredded to pieces by alien weapons is the last thing you see.|974|0
units.english: You look around, and the men in suits are pointing guns at you. Alien guns. Before you can react, Mammon shoots you from under the table, fatally injuring your abdomen. Your half conscious body is dragged out of the submarine, and your ship being shredded to pieces by alien weapons is the last thing you see.
units.italian: Ti guardi intorno, e gli uomini in giacca ti stanno puntando delle pistole. Pistole aliene. Prima che tu possa reagire, Mammon ti spara da sotto il tavolo, ferendoti gravemente all'addome. Il tuo corpo semicosciente viene trascinato fuori dal sottomarino, e la tua nave che viene ridotta a pezzi da armi aliene è l'ultima cosa che vedi.

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 4|	You slide the credit chips to Mammon, but they decline it, grinning with their sharp teeth.|978|0
units.english: You slide the credit chips to Mammon, but they decline it, grinning with their sharp teeth.
units.italian: Fai scivolare i gettoni di credito verso Mammon, ma rifiuta, sogghignando con i denti aguzzi.

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 4|	"Don't worry about paying right now. I only needed you to agree to the deal. I will withdraw the credits in the future, when I desire.|979|0
units.english: "Don't worry about paying right now. I only needed you to agree to the deal. I will withdraw the credits in the future, when I desire.
units.italian: "Non preoccuparti di pagare adesso. Mi serviva solo che accettassi l'accordo. Preleverò i crediti in futuro, quando vorrò.

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 4|	"Now that we're done with that, the artifact you're looking for has been taken by some mercenaries. It seems to me that your friend messed with the wrong people, but I digress. That is not the information you paid for."|980|0
units.english: "Now that we're done with that, the artifact you're looking for has been taken by some mercenaries. It seems to me that your friend messed with the wrong people, but I digress. That is not the information you paid for."
units.italian: "Ora che abbiamo finito con questo, il reperto che cerchi è stato preso da alcuni mercenari. Mi sembra che il tuo amico abbia avuto a che fare con le persone sbagliate, ma divago. Non è questa l'informazione che hai pagato."

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 4|	Mammon lifts their hands to the holographic map of the galaxy in the ceiling. It zooms in, filling up the entire room with stars. In front of you, you recognize the border between the Deep and the Dirt Belt.|981|0
units.english: Mammon lifts their hands to the holographic map of the galaxy in the ceiling. It zooms in, filling up the entire room with stars. In front of you, you recognize the border between the Deep and the Dirt Belt.
units.italian: Mammon alza le mani verso la mappa olografica della galassia sul soffitto. La mappa ingrandisce, riempiendo l'intera stanza di stelle. Davanti a te riconosci il confine tra il Deep e la Dirt Belt.

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 4|	"They have kept the artifact for themselves to sell on the black market, and their base of operations is right... here. Algieba."|982|0
units.english: "They have kept the artifact for themselves to sell on the black market, and their base of operations is right... here. Algieba."
units.italian: "Hanno tenuto il reperto per sé per venderlo al mercato nero, e la loro base operativa è proprio... qui. Algieba."

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 4|	The hologram zooms further in on Watcher, one of the system's moons, and continues until it finally stops over a large forest.|983|0
units.english: The hologram zooms further in on Watcher, one of the system's moons, and continues until it finally stops over a large forest.
units.italian: L'ologramma ingrandisce ancora su Watcher, una delle lune del sistema, e continua finché non si ferma su una grande foresta.

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 4|	"You will find them on this uninhabited moon. They are hiding out in this forest, and the artifact is with them. The exact coordinates will be forwarded to your ship. Expect hostilities."|984|0
units.english: "You will find them on this uninhabited moon. They are hiding out in this forest, and the artifact is with them. The exact coordinates will be forwarded to your ship. Expect hostilities."
units.italian: "Li troverai su questa luna disabitata. Si nascondono in questa foresta, e il reperto è con loro. Le coordinate esatte saranno trasmesse alla tua nave. Aspettati ostilità."

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 4|	You thank Mammon for the service and get up to leave.|985|0
units.english: You thank Mammon for the service and get up to leave.
units.italian: Ringrazi Mammon per il servizio e ti alzi per andartene.

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 4|	"See you, Captain <last>. Remember I always do."|986|0
