units.english: "See you, Captain <last>. Remember I always do."
units.italian: "Ci vediamo, capitano <last>. Ricorda che io mantengo sempre."

units.id: mission:Mammon Payment|You receive a message informing you of a very large transaction: 10 million credits. With it, a message containing only the image of a reptilian eye logo. It seems Mammon's crew have withdrawn the money you agreed to pay for the information about the Sheragi black box.|1016|0
units.english: You receive a message informing you of a very large transaction: 10 million credits. With it, a message containing only the image of a reptilian eye logo. It seems Mammon's crew have withdrawn the money you agreed to pay for the information about the Sheragi black box.
units.italian: Ricevi un messaggio che ti informa di una transazione molto grande: 10 milioni di crediti. Insieme c'è un messaggio contenente solo l'immagine di un logo a forma di occhio rettiliano. Sembra che l'equipaggio di Mammon abbia prelevato il denaro che avevi accettato di pagare per l'informazione sulla scatola nera Sheragi.

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 5|name|1023|0
units.english: The Fight for the Artifact
units.italian: La battaglia per il reperto

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 5|description|1024|0
units.english: Destroy the mercenary fleet, then land on <planet>.
units.italian: Distruggi la flotta di mercenari, poi atterra su <planet>.

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 5|You arrive at the uninhabited moon of Watcher and scout the area around the coordinates Mammon sent you. It's relatively easy to find some smoke rising from a campfire in a clearing, but as you approach to investigate, you're surprised by several large ships taking off to greet you, ditching the green tarps used to hide among the trees. It looks like they really don't want you here.|1032|0
units.english: You arrive at the uninhabited moon of Watcher and scout the area around the coordinates Mammon sent you. It's relatively easy to find some smoke rising from a campfire in a clearing, but as you approach to investigate, you're surprised by several large ships taking off to greet you, ditching the green tarps used to hide among the trees. It looks like they really don't want you here.
units.italian: Arrivi sulla luna disabitata di Watcher e perlustri la zona intorno alle coordinate che ti ha mandato Mammon. È relativamente facile trovare del fumo che sale da un fuoco da campo in una radura, ma mentre ti avvicini per controllare, vieni sorpreso da diverse navi grandi che decollano per accoglierti, abbandonando i teli verdi usati per nascondersi tra gli alberi. Sembra che non ti vogliano affatto qui.

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 5|dialog|1040|0
units.english: You managed to defeat the entire mercenary fleet. You should have no problem landing in their camp now and recovering the cube.
units.italian: Sei riuscito a sconfiggere l'intera flotta di mercenari. Ora non dovresti avere problemi ad atterrare nel loro campo e recuperare il cubo.

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 5|You attempt to evade the mercenary ships and make a quick assault on their encampment, but the ships follow you through the atmosphere, and ground personnel start shooting at you. Bombing it on a pass means you risk destroying the cube. You have no choice but to go back to space and eliminate the mercenary fleet.|1044|0
units.english: You attempt to evade the mercenary ships and make a quick assault on their encampment, but the ships follow you through the atmosphere, and ground personnel start shooting at you. Bombing it on a pass means you risk destroying the cube. You have no choice but to go back to space and eliminate the mercenary fleet.
units.italian: Cerchi di eludere le navi mercenarie e di sferrare un attacco rapido al loro accampamento, ma le navi ti seguono attraverso l'atmosfera e il personale a terra comincia a spararti. Bombardare in un passaggio significa rischiare di distruggere il cubo. Non hai altra scelta che tornare nello spazio ed eliminare la flotta mercenaria.

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 6a|You come in for a landing, and the few mercenaries that stayed on the ground march towards your ship carrying a makeshift white flag. Dozens of tough-looking men and women approach in uniform but unarmed. They remain calm and organized. These aren't ordinary criminals, it seems.|1060|0
units.english: You come in for a landing, and the few mercenaries that stayed on the ground march towards your ship carrying a makeshift white flag. Dozens of tough-looking men and women approach in uniform but unarmed. They remain calm and organized. These aren't ordinary criminals, it seems.
units.italian: Ti avvicini per atterrare, e i pochi mercenari rimasti a terra marciano verso la tua nave portando una bandiera bianca di fortuna. Decine di uomini e donne dall'aria tosta si avvicinano in uniforme ma disarmati. Restano calmi e organizzati. Questi non sembrano criminali comuni.

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 6a|	"We know when we've lost," one of them yells to your ship on a megaphone. "What is it that you want?"|1061|0
units.english: "We know when we've lost," one of them yells to your ship on a megaphone. "What is it that you want?"
units.italian: "Sappiamo quando abbiamo perso," grida uno di loro alla tua nave con un megafono. "Che cosa vuoi?"

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 6a|	(Shoot them.)|1063|0
units.english: (Shoot them.)
units.italian: (Spara a loro.)

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 6a|	(Talk to them.)|1065|0
units.english: (Talk to them.)
units.italian: (Parla con loro.)

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 6a|	You land and cautiously open the hatch to talk with them.|1067|0
units.english: You land and cautiously open the hatch to talk with them.
units.italian: Atterri e apri con cautela il portello per parlare con loro.

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 6a|	"Who do you work for? Where is the cube you stole?" you ask.|1068|0
units.english: "Who do you work for? Where is the cube you stole?" you ask.
units.italian: "Per chi lavorate? Dov'è il cubo che avete rubato?" chiedi.

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 6a|	"So that old thing was yours?" one woman up front says. "I knew that mission was sketchy... We're mercenaries. We were employed by fancy-looking people who paid us really well to steal it, but when we returned with it, they just scanned it and told us to dispose of it. Said that a digital copy is fine, and the trouble should be enough retribution. We don't know who they were, we don't ask questions. That might be about to change now.|1069|0
units.english: "So that old thing was yours?" one woman up front says. "I knew that mission was sketchy... We're mercenaries. We were employed by fancy-looking people who paid us really well to steal it, but when we returned with it, they just scanned it and told us to dispose of it. Said that a digital copy is fine, and the trouble should be enough retribution. We don't know who they were, we don't ask questions. That might be about to change now.
units.italian: "Quindi quella vecchia cosa era tua?" dice una donna in prima fila. "Sapevo che quella missione era losca... Siamo mercenari. Ci ha ingaggiati gente dall'aria elegante che ci ha pagato molto bene per rubarlo, ma quando siamo tornati con il cubo si sono limitati a scannerizzarlo e ci hanno detto di disfarci di lui. Hanno detto che una copia digitale andava bene, e che il disturbo era una punizione sufficiente. Non sappiamo chi fossero, non facciamo domande. Ma forse sta per cambiare.

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 6a|	"If you want the cube, you can have it if you spare us. It's not worth our lives."|1070|0
units.english: "If you want the cube, you can have it if you spare us. It's not worth our lives."
units.italian: "Se volete il cubo, potete averlo se ci risparmiate. Non vale le nostre vite."

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 6a|	(Spare them.)|1072|0
units.english: (Spare them.)
units.italian: (Risparmiali.)

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 6a|	(Open fire.)|1074|0
units.english: (Open fire.)
units.italian: (Aprite il fuoco.)

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 6a|	Feeling distrustful, you immediately close the hatch and get back into your ship while they scatter.|1078|0
units.english: Feeling distrustful, you immediately close the hatch and get back into your ship while they scatter.
units.italian: Diffidente, chiudi subito il portello e rientri nella nave mentre si disperdono.

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 6a|	Disregarding their surrender, you turn your ship towards them and open fire on the small army. Using your ship-mounted guns against ground personnel is honestly excessive, and they didn't stand a chance. There is now a smoldering clearing around the place where they once stood, and a forest fire is beginning to spread.|1083|0
units.english: Disregarding their surrender, you turn your ship towards them and open fire on the small army. Using your ship-mounted guns against ground personnel is honestly excessive, and they didn't stand a chance. There is now a smoldering clearing around the place where they once stood, and a forest fire is beginning to spread.
units.italian: Ignorando la loro resa, giri la nave verso di loro e apri il fuoco sul piccolo esercito. Usare le armi di bordo contro personale a terra è onestamente eccessivo, e non avevano alcuna possibilità. Al posto dove stavano ora c'è una radura fumante, e un incendio boschivo comincia a propagarsi.

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 6a|	You enter the camp, shooting any mercenaries that remained hidden, and pillage their tents. You find hundreds of thousands of credits, in chips and valuables, and eventually, you find the cube as well. With that in hand, you go back to your ship, ready to take it back to John.|1084|0
units.english: You enter the camp, shooting any mercenaries that remained hidden, and pillage their tents. You find hundreds of thousands of credits, in chips and valuables, and eventually, you find the cube as well. With that in hand, you go back to your ship, ready to take it back to John.
units.italian: Entri nel campo, sparando ai mercenari rimasti nascosti, e saccheggi le loro tende. Trovi centinaia di migliaia di crediti, in gettoni e oggetti di valore, e alla fine trovi anche il cubo. Con quello in mano, torni alla tua nave, pronto a riportarlo a John.

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 6a|	"Deal. Bring it to me," you say.|1088|0
units.english: "Deal. Bring it to me," you say.
units.italian: "Affare fatto. Portalo qui," dici.

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 6a|	While one of them goes to fetch it, you wait in an uncomfortable silence, watching their every move while they watch yours. Eventually the young man who left to get the cube comes back and gives it to you. You examine it, confirming it is the artifact you were looking for.|1089|0
units.english: While one of them goes to fetch it, you wait in an uncomfortable silence, watching their every move while they watch yours. Eventually the young man who left to get the cube comes back and gives it to you. You examine it, confirming it is the artifact you were looking for.
units.italian: Mentre uno di loro va a prenderlo, aspetti in un silenzio scomodo, osservando ogni loro movimento mentre loro osservano i tuoi. Alla fine il giovane che è andato a prendere il cubo torna e te lo consegna. Lo esamini, confermando che è il reperto che cercavi.

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 6a|	"You have it, now go away. We won't get in your way again," the woman who spoke before says, and the other mercenaries begin to disband, going back to their tents.|1090|0
units.english: "You have it, now go away. We won't get in your way again," the woman who spoke before says, and the other mercenaries begin to disband, going back to their tents.
units.italian: "Ce l'hai, ora vattene. Non ti intralceremo più," dice la donna che ha parlato prima, e gli altri mercenari cominciano a sciogliersi, tornando alle loro tende.

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 6a|	With the cube in your arms, you have no more reason to stay here. You go back to your ship, ready to take it back to John.|1091|0
units.english: With the cube in your arms, you have no more reason to stay here. You go back to your ship, ready to take it back to John.
units.italian: Con il cubo tra le braccia, non hai più motivi per restare qui. Torni alla tua nave, pronto a riportarlo a John.

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 6b|name|1101|0
units.english: The Box Recovered
units.italian: La scatola recuperata

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 6b|description|1102|0
units.english: Bring the cube back to John on <destination>.
units.italian: Riporta il cubo a John su <destination>.

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 6b|Carrying the mysterious box again, you make your way to John's lab. He lets you in, and you tell him about what you just went through.|1111|0
units.english: Carrying the mysterious box again, you make your way to John's lab. He lets you in, and you tell him about what you just went through.
units.italian: Con la misteriosa scatola di nuovo con te, ti dirigi al laboratorio di John. Ti fa entrare, e gli racconti quello che hai appena passato.

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 6b|	"So, retribution, huh? You think it was the officials from the Deep that got angry at us last time? Or maybe Foster's competitors for that dig site? I should have seen that coming."|1112|0
units.english: "So, retribution, huh? You think it was the officials from the Deep that got angry at us last time? Or maybe Foster's competitors for that dig site? I should have seen that coming."
units.italian: "Quindi una punizione, eh? Pensi che siano stati i funzionari del Deep ad arrabbiarsi l'altra volta? O magari i concorrenti di Foster per quel sito di scavo? Avrei dovuto prevederlo."

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 6b|	"Possibly," you say. "I can't imagine any other reason."|1113|0
units.english: "Possibly," you say. "I can't imagine any other reason."
units.italian: "Probabile," dici. "Non riesco a immaginare un altro motivo."

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 6b|	"At least you got it back. But I don't know if it would be wise to continue to work on it here, and I can't just leave the planet for a couple months with no consequences. I don't even have a clue on how to read that data yet."|1114|0
units.english: "At least you got it back. But I don't know if it would be wise to continue to work on it here, and I can't just leave the planet for a couple months with no consequences. I don't even have a clue on how to read that data yet."
units.italian: "Almeno l'hai recuperato. Ma non so se sarebbe saggio continuare a lavorarci qui, e non posso lasciare il pianeta per un paio di mesi senza conseguenze. E non ho ancora idea di come leggere quei dati."

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 6b|	"And what, do you happen to have another shady contact who can help?" you ask.|1115|0
units.english: "And what, do you happen to have another shady contact who can help?" you ask.
units.italian: "E allora, per caso hai un altro contatto losco che può aiutarci?" chiedi.

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 6b|	"Unfortunately not. And now we seem to be running against time. If only the Quarg would be willing to work with us and give us the information we need to crack this box..."|1116|0
units.english: "Unfortunately not. And now we seem to be running against time. If only the Quarg would be willing to work with us and give us the information we need to crack this box..."
units.italian: "Purtroppo no. E ora sembra che stiamo correndo contro il tempo. Se solo i Quarg fossero disposti a lavorare con noi e a darci le informazioni che ci servono per aprire questa scatola..."

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 6b|	As soon as you hear that phrase, it suddenly hits you. You've met the Hai up north, and you heard from the Unfettered that they've met the Sheragi many millennia ago. Perhaps the Hai could be able to help.|1117|0
units.english: As soon as you hear that phrase, it suddenly hits you. You've met the Hai up north, and you heard from the Unfettered that they've met the Sheragi many millennia ago. Perhaps the Hai could be able to help.
units.italian: Appena senti quella frase, ti viene in mente all'improvviso. Hai conosciuto gli Hai a nord, e hai saputo dagli Slegati che hanno incontrato gli Sheragi molti millenni fa. Forse gli Hai potrebbero aiutare.

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 6b|	"I think I know what to do. You're not the only person with contacts in strange places."|1118|0
units.english: "I think I know what to do. You're not the only person with contacts in strange places."
units.italian: "Credo di sapere cosa fare. Non sei l'unica persona con contatti in posti strani."

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 6b|	You pick up your things, placing the cube back inside the backpack.|1119|0
units.english: You pick up your things, placing the cube back inside the backpack.
units.italian: Raccogli le tue cose, rimettendo il cubo nello zaino.

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 6b|	"Well, I wish I could study it longer, but if you have a lead, it's worth pursuing. I trust you'll return the cube to either myself or Albert once you're done with it. Good luck, Captain. Don't get in too much trouble."|1120|0
units.english: "Well, I wish I could study it longer, but if you have a lead, it's worth pursuing. I trust you'll return the cube to either myself or Albert once you're done with it. Good luck, Captain. Don't get in too much trouble."
units.italian: "Beh, vorrei poterlo studiare più a lungo, ma se hai una pista vale la pena seguirla. Confido che restituirai il cubo a me o ad Albert quando avrai finito. Buona fortuna, capitano. Non metterti nei guai più del necessario."

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 6c|name|1126|0
units.english: Hai Knowledge
units.italian: La conoscenza degli Hai

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 6c|description|1127|0
units.english: Ask the Hai if they know more about the Sheragi.
units.italian: Chiedi agli Hai se sanno qualcosa di più sugli Sheragi.

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 7a|name|1138|0
units.english: The Museum of Galactic History
units.italian: Il Museo di Storia Galattica

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 7a|description|1139|0
units.english: Travel to <destination> to visit the Hai Museum of Galactic History.
units.italian: Viaggia verso <destination> per visitare il Museo di Storia Galattica degli Hai.

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 7a|You ask around the spaceport until you manage to find a Hai tourist guide. You ask him if there's any place where you could find more information about the Sheragi.|1148|0
units.english: You ask around the spaceport until you manage to find a Hai tourist guide. You ask him if there's any place where you could find more information about the Sheragi.
units.italian: Chiedi in giro allo spazioporto finché non riesci a trovare una guida turistica Hai. Gli chiedi se c'è un posto dove potresti trovare maggiori informazioni sugli Sheragi.

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 7a|	"A human knows about them? I'm surprised. This is ancient history. If there's any place where you can find out more about them, it's the Museum of Galactic History on <planet>."|1149|0
units.english: "A human knows about them? I'm surprised. This is ancient history. If there's any place where you can find out more about them, it's the Museum of Galactic History on <planet>."
units.italian: "Un umano che sa di loro? Mi sorprendi. Questa è storia antica. Se c'è un posto dove puoi scoprire di più su di loro, è il Museo di Storia Galattica su <planet>."

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 7a|	You thank the guide and return to your ship, plotting a course to the <system> system.|1150|0
units.english: You thank the guide and return to your ship, plotting a course to the <system> system.
units.italian: Ringrazi la guida e torni alla tua nave, impostando la rotta per il sistema <system>.

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 7b|name|1157|0
units.english: The Hai Ministry of Culture
units.italian: Il Ministero della Cultura degli Hai

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 7b|description|1158|0
units.english: Land on <destination> to speak with the Ministry of Culture.
units.italian: Atterra su <destination> per parlare con il Ministero della Cultura.

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 7b|Arriving on Mirrorlake, you ask around for a while, and eventually, someone directs you to the Museum of Galactic History: a huge, and very important place, but surprisingly not a very popular tourist spot. Most Hai aren't very fond of looking at the past, and most humans have no idea this place exists. The museum staff is surprised to see a human face, and as you wander you feel like you're drawing more attention from the locals than the exhibits themselves.|1168|0
units.english: Arriving on Mirrorlake, you ask around for a while, and eventually, someone directs you to the Museum of Galactic History: a huge, and very important place, but surprisingly not a very popular tourist spot. Most Hai aren't very fond of looking at the past, and most humans have no idea this place exists. The museum staff is surprised to see a human face, and as you wander you feel like you're drawing more attention from the locals than the exhibits themselves.
units.italian: Arrivando su Mirrorlake, chiedi in giro per un po', e alla fine qualcuno ti indirizza al Museo di Storia Galattica: un luogo enorme e molto importante, ma sorprendentemente non una meta turistica molto frequentata. Alla maggior parte degli Hai non piace granché guardare al passato, e la maggior parte degli umani non ha idea che questo posto esista. Il personale del museo è sorpreso di vedere una faccia umana, e mentre giri hai l'impressione di attirare più attenzione dai locali che i reperti stessi.

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 7b|	The place has a very unusual architecture vaguely resembling Earth's Ancient Greece, but clearly not based on any human design. Touches of metal, concrete, glass, and plastic add a modern aspect to its design. Exhibit rooms branch off a long corridor that makes up the majority of the building. The rooms are arranged such that history proceeds backwards as you walk through the museum, with recent events at the front and the earliest at the back.|1169|0
units.english: The place has a very unusual architecture vaguely resembling Earth's Ancient Greece, but clearly not based on any human design. Touches of metal, concrete, glass, and plastic add a modern aspect to its design. Exhibit rooms branch off a long corridor that makes up the majority of the building. The rooms are arranged such that history proceeds backwards as you walk through the museum, with recent events at the front and the earliest at the back.
units.italian: Il posto ha un'architettura molto insolita, che ricorda vagamente la Grecia antica della Terra, ma chiaramente non si basa su alcun progetto umano. Tocchi di metallo, cemento, vetro e plastica aggiungono un aspetto moderno al disegno. Le sale espositive si diramano da un lungo corridoio che costituisce la maggior parte dell'edificio. Le sale sono disposte in modo che la storia proceda all'indietro mentre attraversi il museo, con gli eventi recenti davanti e i più antichi in fondo.

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 7b|	One room you enter is dominated by a mural depicting the Hai's history of contact with humanity. What jumps out to you is that the first humans in the mural are shown with green skin. The only green skinned humans you know of are the Alphas. The mural seems to show the Alphas stealing something from the Hai, followed by a series of battles, at the end of which the Alphas are shown retreating into the wormhole. Ships then come back through the wormhole, only this time carrying normal humans. The Hai in the mural appear apprehensive at first, but it is clear that a friendship was quickly established.|1173|0
units.english: One room you enter is dominated by a mural depicting the Hai's history of contact with humanity. What jumps out to you is that the first humans in the mural are shown with green skin. The only green skinned humans you know of are the Alphas. The mural seems to show the Alphas stealing something from the Hai, followed by a series of battles, at the end of which the Alphas are shown retreating into the wormhole. Ships then come back through the wormhole, only this time carrying normal humans. The Hai in the mural appear apprehensive at first, but it is clear that a friendship was quickly established.
units.italian: Una sala in cui entri è dominata da un murale che raffigura la storia dei contatti degli Hai con l'umanità. Quello che ti salta all'occhio è che i primi umani del murale hanno la pelle verde. Gli unici umani dalla pelle verde che conosci sono gli Alpha. Il murale sembra mostrare gli Alpha che rubano qualcosa agli Hai, seguiti da una serie di battaglie, alla fine delle quali gli Alpha sono mostrati in ritirata nel cunicolo. Poi delle navi tornano indietro dal cunicolo, ma questa volta con a bordo umani normali. Gli Hai del murale sembrano diffidenti all'inizio, ma è chiaro che si stabilì rapidamente un'amicizia.

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 7b|	It is surprising and unfortunate to learn that the first contact the Hai ever had with humanity was with the Alphas.|1174|0
units.english: It is surprising and unfortunate to learn that the first contact the Hai ever had with humanity was with the Alphas.
units.italian: È sorprendente e spiacevole scoprire che il primo contatto che gli Hai abbiano mai avuto con l'umanità fu con gli Alpha.

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 7b|	One room you enter is dominated by a mural depicting the Hai's history of contact with humanity. It begins with the Alphas, just as Ambassador Hiyamaharu told you about. The mural seems to show the Alphas stealing something from the Hai, followed by a series of battles, at the end of which the Alphas are shown retreating into the wormhole. Ships then come back through the wormhole, only this time carrying normal humans. The Hai in the mural appear apprehensive at first, but it is clear that a friendship was quickly established.|1178|0
units.english: One room you enter is dominated by a mural depicting the Hai's history of contact with humanity. It begins with the Alphas, just as Ambassador Hiyamaharu told you about. The mural seems to show the Alphas stealing something from the Hai, followed by a series of battles, at the end of which the Alphas are shown retreating into the wormhole. Ships then come back through the wormhole, only this time carrying normal humans. The Hai in the mural appear apprehensive at first, but it is clear that a friendship was quickly established.
units.italian: Una sala in cui entri è dominata da un murale che raffigura la storia dei contatti degli Hai con l'umanità. Comincia con gli Alpha, proprio come ti aveva raccontato l'ambasciatore Hiyamaharu. Il murale sembra mostrare gli Alpha che rubano qualcosa agli Hai, seguiti da una serie di battaglie, alla fine delle quali gli Alpha sono mostrati in ritirata nel cunicolo. Poi delle navi tornano indietro dal cunicolo, ma questa volta con a bordo umani normali. Gli Hai del murale sembrano diffidenti all'inizio, ma è chiaro che si stabilì rapidamente un'amicizia.

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 7b|	As you continue to wander further down the aisle, you find rooms dedicated to the Korath raids, their civil war, and the first contact with them, along with a very poetic recounting of the origins of the Unfettered. Going deeper, you find even more sections: a long one detailing Hai culture on several different worlds and how they shifted with time, another on the fall of the Hai government that once inhabited part of what is now human space and the decision to pull back into a small territory, one on the completion of the Quarg ringworld, one for Hai trade and military culture during their imperial phase, and a very grim-looking room on the Hai Civil Wars. Finally, after a very long walk, you arrive at a room nearly at the end of the aisle, recounting the history of the Sheragi.|1181|0
units.english: As you continue to wander further down the aisle, you find rooms dedicated to the Korath raids, their civil war, and the first contact with them, along with a very poetic recounting of the origins of the Unfettered. Going deeper, you find even more sections: a long one detailing Hai culture on several different worlds and how they shifted with time, another on the fall of the Hai government that once inhabited part of what is now human space and the decision to pull back into a small territory, one on the completion of the Quarg ringworld, one for Hai trade and military culture during their imperial phase, and a very grim-looking room on the Hai Civil Wars. Finally, after a very long walk, you arrive at a room nearly at the end of the aisle, recounting the history of the Sheragi.
units.italian: Mentre continui a vagare lungo il corridoio, trovi sale dedicate alle incursioni Korath, alla loro guerra civile e al primo contatto con loro, insieme a un racconto molto poetico delle origini degli Slegati. Andando più a fondo trovi altre sezioni: una lunga che descrive la cultura Hai su diversi mondi e come è cambiata nel tempo, un'altra sulla caduta del governo Hai che un tempo abitava parte di quello che oggi è lo spazio umano e sulla decisione di ritirarsi in un territorio più piccolo, una sul completamento del ringworld Quarg, una sul commercio e la cultura militare Hai durante la loro fase imperiale, e una sala dall'aria molto cupa sulle Guerre Civili Hai. Infine, dopo una camminata molto lunga, arrivi a una sala quasi in fondo al corridoio, che racconta la storia degli Sheragi.

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 7b|	(Continue into the Sheragi room.)|1183|0
units.english: (Continue into the Sheragi room.)
units.italian: (Prosegui nella sala Sheragi.)

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 7b|	What you see here is much richer than what Albert Foster's little museum could ever hope to display. There are pictures of Sheragi military officials of the time, as well as their names and roles. Details on their culture, their biology, and their apparent conflicts with the Hai are provided as well. There is a huge statue of a bipedal dragon at the center of the room, around 8 meters tall, so large that the ceiling had to be raised. The inscription on the plaque at its feet indicates it is a reproduction of a life-sized Sheragi. A smaller interactive holographic display of one shows details on their biology and behavior. Samples of culture are scarce, but it indicates that they lived under a military meritocracy that valued strength and leadership above all else.|1184|0
units.english: What you see here is much richer than what Albert Foster's little museum could ever hope to display. There are pictures of Sheragi military officials of the time, as well as their names and roles. Details on their culture, their biology, and their apparent conflicts with the Hai are provided as well. There is a huge statue of a bipedal dragon at the center of the room, around 8 meters tall, so large that the ceiling had to be raised. The inscription on the plaque at its feet indicates it is a reproduction of a life-sized Sheragi. A smaller interactive holographic display of one shows details on their biology and behavior. Samples of culture are scarce, but it indicates that they lived under a military meritocracy that valued strength and leadership above all else.
units.italian: Quello che vedi qui è molto più ricco di quanto il piccolo museo di Albert Foster potesse mai sperare di esporre. Ci sono immagini di funzionari militari Sheragi dell'epoca, con i loro nomi e i loro ruoli. Ci sono anche dettagli sulla loro cultura, sulla loro biologia e sui loro evidenti conflitti con gli Hai. Al centro della sala c'è un'enorme statua di un drago bipede, alta circa 8 metri, così grande che il soffitto ha dovuto essere rialzato. L'iscrizione sulla targa ai suoi piedi indica che è una riproduzione di uno Sheragi a grandezza naturale. Un ologramma interattivo più piccolo ne mostra dettagli sulla biologia e sul comportamento. I campioni di cultura sono scarsi, ma indicano che vivevano in una meritocrazia militare che metteva la forza e la capacità di comando al di sopra di tutto.

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 7b|	You see pictures and rough blueprints of their ships, some depicting fearsome fleets of massive warships. They had angular, multi-layered armor that rivaled the strength of modern Hai vessels by sheer mass. If your measurement conversions are correct, their ships were bigger than anything else in human space, dwarfing even the Navy Carrier. A few of them display equally impressive spinal cannons of unknown capability, with grim descriptions suggesting that they were responsible for the extinction of the Sheragi - weapons of mass destruction in the hands of a warlike and immature species that used them carelessly.|1185|0
units.english: You see pictures and rough blueprints of their ships, some depicting fearsome fleets of massive warships. They had angular, multi-layered armor that rivaled the strength of modern Hai vessels by sheer mass. If your measurement conversions are correct, their ships were bigger than anything else in human space, dwarfing even the Navy Carrier. A few of them display equally impressive spinal cannons of unknown capability, with grim descriptions suggesting that they were responsible for the extinction of the Sheragi - weapons of mass destruction in the hands of a warlike and immature species that used them carelessly.
units.italian: Vedi immagini e progetti approssimativi delle loro navi, alcune delle quali raffigurano temibili flotte di enormi navi da guerra. Avevano un'armatura angolare a più strati che, per pura massa, rivaleggiava con la robustezza delle navi Hai moderne. Se le tue conversioni di misura sono corrette, le loro navi erano più grandi di qualsiasi cosa nello spazio umano, e facevano sembrare minuscola perfino la Portaerei della Marina. Alcune mostrano cannoni spinali altrettanto impressionanti, di capacità sconosciuta, con descrizioni cupe che suggeriscono che furono responsabili dell'estinzione degli Sheragi: armi di distruzione di massa nelle mani di una specie bellicosa e immatura che le usò con leggerezza.

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 7b|	While you are looking around the room, one of the curators approaches you, speaking your own language, albeit with a heavy accent.|1186|0
units.english: While you are looking around the room, one of the curators approaches you, speaking your own language, albeit with a heavy accent.
units.italian: Mentre ti guardi intorno nella sala, uno dei curatori ti si avvicina, parlando la tua lingua, anche se con un forte accento.

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 7b|	"Sad, isn't it? I don't think they ever had a peaceful time in their spacefaring history."|1187|0
units.english: "Sad, isn't it? I don't think they ever had a peaceful time in their spacefaring history."
units.italian: "Triste, vero? Non credo che abbiano mai avuto un momento di pace nella loro storia spaziale."

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 7b|	"It's a pity they had to focus so much on conflict. They seemed very capable."|1189|0
units.english: "It's a pity they had to focus so much on conflict. They seemed very capable."
units.italian: "È un peccato che abbiano dovuto concentrarsi così tanto sul conflitto. Sembravano molto capaci."

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 7b|	"They lived fast, died young, and left good-looking corpses."|1190|0
units.english: "They lived fast, died young, and left good-looking corpses."
units.italian: "Vissero in fretta, morirono giovani e lasciarono bei cadaveri."

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 7b|	"Well, it's not like we are ones to talk. At the time, we Hai were a troubled species too. We even tried invading Sheragi territory. Perhaps if we had been successful, they might have united against a common enemy and might have even survived their rebellious phase, at our own expense.|1192|0
units.english: "Well, it's not like we are ones to talk. At the time, we Hai were a troubled species too. We even tried invading Sheragi territory. Perhaps if we had been successful, they might have united against a common enemy and might have even survived their rebellious phase, at our own expense.
units.italian: "Beh, non siamo certo noi a poter parlare. A quei tempi anche noi Hai eravamo una specie problematica. Abbiamo perfino provato a invadere il territorio Sheragi. Forse, se ci fossimo riusciti, si sarebbero uniti contro un nemico comune e avrebbero potuto perfino sopravvivere alla loro fase ribelle, a nostre spese.

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 7b|	The curator laughs in the distinctive Hai way.|1195|0
units.english: The curator laughs in the distinctive Hai way.
units.italian: Il curatore ride nel modo inconfondibile degli Hai.

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 7b|	"That's one way to put it. I can't deny the scale of their engineering was a marvel even for the Hai of that time, and our civilization was already old. Some things scale well with size, and they had no choice but to build big. But it's still a shame. Imagine such capability being used for peace.|1196|0
units.english: "That's one way to put it. I can't deny the scale of their engineering was a marvel even for the Hai of that time, and our civilization was already old. Some things scale well with size, and they had no choice but to build big. But it's still a shame. Imagine such capability being used for peace.
units.italian: "È un modo di dire. Non posso negare che la scala della loro ingegneria fosse una meraviglia anche per gli Hai di allora, e la nostra civiltà era già antica. Certe cose migliorano con le dimensioni, e loro non avevano scelta: dovevano costruire in grande. Ma resta un peccato. Immagina una capacità del genere usata per la pace.

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 7b|	"Anyway, it's rare to see a human face here, and even more intriguing for them to be staring at Sheragi artifacts. What brings you here?"|1198|0
units.english: "Anyway, it's rare to see a human face here, and even more intriguing for them to be staring at Sheragi artifacts. What brings you here?"
units.italian: "Comunque, è raro vedere una faccia umana qui, ed è ancora più intrigante che stia fissando reperti Sheragi. Cosa ti porta qui?"

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 7b|	You explain about the ruins recently discovered on Zug.|1199|0
units.english: You explain about the ruins recently discovered on Zug.
units.italian: Spieghi delle rovine scoperte di recente su Zug.

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 7b|	"Ohhh, right. They used to inhabit the part of human space that is now called the Rim. Are you looking for anything in particular?"|1200|0
units.english: "Ohhh, right. They used to inhabit the part of human space that is now called the Rim. Are you looking for anything in particular?"
units.italian: "Ohhh, giusto. Abitavano la parte dello spazio umano che oggi si chiama il Bordo. Cerchi qualcosa in particolare?"

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 7b|	"I would like to know more about Sheragi computers," you respond.|1201|0
units.english: "I would like to know more about Sheragi computers," you respond.
units.italian: "Vorrei saperne di più sui computer Sheragi," rispondi.

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 7b|	"Hmmm, computers. The Sheragi built their hardware to last. Very sturdy electronics with redundancies, designed to be able to take a shot and survive. But still, I doubt they would have survived so many thousand years. If you want to identify how their hardware used to work, there are a few documents and manuals the ancient Hai stole from them."|1202|0
units.english: "Hmmm, computers. The Sheragi built their hardware to last. Very sturdy electronics with redundancies, designed to be able to take a shot and survive. But still, I doubt they would have survived so many thousand years. If you want to identify how their hardware used to work, there are a few documents and manuals the ancient Hai stole from them."
units.italian: "Hmmm, i computer. Gli Sheragi costruivano hardware fatto per durare. Elettronica molto robusta con ridondanze, progettata per incassare un colpo e sopravvivere. Ma dubito che sarebbero sopravvissuti a tanti millenni. Se vuoi capire come funzionava il loro hardware, ci sono alcuni documenti e manuali che gli antichi Hai rubarono loro."

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 7b|	"Are they for sale?" you inquire.|1203|0
units.english: "Are they for sale?" you inquire.
units.italian: "Sono in vendita?" chiedi.

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 7b|	"You want to buy a copy of the documents? Right now? I'm intrigued. Did you actually find something that still works?"|1204|0
units.english: "You want to buy a copy of the documents? Right now? I'm intrigued. Did you actually find something that still works?"
units.italian: "Vuoi comprare una copia dei documenti? Adesso? Sono incuriosito. Hai davvero trovato qualcosa che funziona ancora?"

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 7b|	"We found a kind of storage device that seems to still be functioning. A black box."|1206|0
units.english: "We found a kind of storage device that seems to still be functioning. A black box."
units.italian: "Abbiamo trovato una specie di dispositivo di archiviazione che sembra ancora funzionante. Una scatola nera."

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 7b|	"I'm just curious. Studying their technology might allow us to improve ours."|1208|0
units.english: "I'm just curious. Studying their technology might allow us to improve ours."
units.italian: "Sono solo curioso. Studiare la loro tecnologia potrebbe permetterci di migliorare la nostra."

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 7b|	"I see. I'll have to warn you though, following the footsteps of a doomed species can only get you so far.|1209|0
units.english: "I see. I'll have to warn you though, following the footsteps of a doomed species can only get you so far.
units.italian: "Capisco. Devo avvertirti, però: seguire le orme di una specie condannata può portarti solo fino a un certo punto.

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 7b|	You produce an image of the cube that you found on your holopad. The curator stares at it, and then slowly turns to you with pity in his eyes.|1212|0
units.english: You produce an image of the cube that you found on your holopad. The curator stares at it, and then slowly turns to you with pity in his eyes.
units.italian: Mostri un'immagine del cubo che hai trovato sul tuo olopad. Il curatore la fissa, poi si volta lentamente verso di te con pietà negli occhi.

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 7b|	"This box is red," he says gently. "I read a thesis once on the prevalence of color blindness in humans, but-"|1213|0
units.english: "This box is red," he says gently. "I read a thesis once on the prevalence of color blindness in humans, but-"
units.italian: "Questa scatola è rossa," dice con delicatezza. "Una volta ho letto una tesi sulla diffusione del daltonismo negli umani, ma..."

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 7b|	In the interest of time, you interrupt the curator and explain that "black box," in human terminology, refers to a device used to collect and preserve flight data in the event of a catastrophic failure.|1214|0
units.english: In the interest of time, you interrupt the curator and explain that "black box," in human terminology, refers to a device used to collect and preserve flight data in the event of a catastrophic failure.
units.italian: Per non perdere tempo, interrompi il curatore e spieghi che "scatola nera", nella terminologia umana, indica un dispositivo usato per raccogliere e conservare i dati di volo in caso di guasto catastrofico.

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 7b|	Recognition seems to dawn on him. "A Sheragi 'black box,' you say? That's an incredible find! Be careful about the information it contains, though. They are a doomed species. Don't you humans have a legend about a cursed box? What was it... Pandora's Box?|1215|0
units.english: Recognition seems to dawn on him. "A Sheragi 'black box,' you say? That's an incredible find! Be careful about the information it contains, though. They are a doomed species. Don't you humans have a legend about a cursed box? What was it... Pandora's Box?
units.italian: Sembra che capisca. "Una 'scatola nera' Sheragi, dici? È un ritrovamento incredibile! Però stai attento alle informazioni che contiene. Sono una specie condannata. Voi umani non avete una leggenda su una scatola maledetta? Come si chiamava... il vaso di Pandora?

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 7b|	"In any case... I am not authorized to sell you documents, I just take care of artifacts here. Giving Sheragi technology to humans will likely be a very bureaucratic process. I suggest you contact the Ministry of Culture on Hai-home."|1217|0
units.english: "In any case... I am not authorized to sell you documents, I just take care of artifacts here. Giving Sheragi technology to humans will likely be a very bureaucratic process. I suggest you contact the Ministry of Culture on Hai-home."
units.italian: "In ogni caso... non sono autorizzato a venderti documenti, io mi occupo solo dei reperti qui. Dare tecnologia Sheragi agli umani sarà probabilmente un processo molto burocratico. Ti suggerisco di contattare il Ministero della Cultura su Hai-home."

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 7b|	You thank him for his help, and make your way back to the spaceport, mentally preparing yourself for what is likely to be a long meeting.|1218|0
units.english: You thank him for his help, and make your way back to the spaceport, mentally preparing yourself for what is likely to be a long meeting.
units.italian: Lo ringrazi per l'aiuto e torni allo spazioporto, preparandoti mentalmente a quello che sarà probabilmente un lungo incontro.

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 7b|Arriving on Hai-home, you manage to contact the Ministry of Culture, expressing your interests in obtaining Sheragi documents and manuals. After some time on hold, you're scheduled to meet them in person.|1228|0
units.english: Arriving on Hai-home, you manage to contact the Ministry of Culture, expressing your interests in obtaining Sheragi documents and manuals. After some time on hold, you're scheduled to meet them in person.
units.italian: Arrivando su Hai-home, riesci a contattare il Ministero della Cultura, esprimendo il tuo interesse a ottenere documenti e manuali Sheragi. Dopo un po' di attesa in linea, ti danno un appuntamento per incontrarli di persona.

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 7b|	You get ready and make your way to the city hall, where the Ministry is, to meet with the Hai officials, who are accompanied by a few diplomats. You all sit down at a round table. You describe the discovery of the Sheragi ruins to them and they begin inquiring more about it, curious about the state of preservation of the ruins and what artifacts were found. They seem very excited.|1229|0
units.english: You get ready and make your way to the city hall, where the Ministry is, to meet with the Hai officials, who are accompanied by a few diplomats. You all sit down at a round table. You describe the discovery of the Sheragi ruins to them and they begin inquiring more about it, curious about the state of preservation of the ruins and what artifacts were found. They seem very excited.
units.italian: Ti prepari e ti dirigi al municipio, dove ha sede il Ministero, per incontrare i funzionari Hai, accompagnati da alcuni diplomatici. Vi sedete tutti a un tavolo rotondo. Descrivi loro la scoperta delle rovine Sheragi e cominciano a fare domande, curiosi dello stato di conservazione delle rovine e di quali reperti siano stati trovati. Sembrano molto emozionati.

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 7b|	"This is a unique opportunity! Even when our species were in... active contact, millennia ago, we Hai never had the opportunity to study Sheragi cities up close. Brief skirmishes and diplomatic meetings were as close as our ancestors got.|1230|0
units.english: "This is a unique opportunity! Even when our species were in... active contact, millennia ago, we Hai never had the opportunity to study Sheragi cities up close. Brief skirmishes and diplomatic meetings were as close as our ancestors got.
units.italian: "È un'opportunità unica! Anche quando la nostra specie era in... contatto attivo, millenni fa, noi Hai non abbiamo mai avuto l'occasione di studiare da vicino le città Sheragi. Brevi scaramucce e incontri diplomatici furono il massimo a cui arrivarono i nostri antenati.

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 7b|	"You'll understand, however, that we can't simply sell you the documents you're requesting. Instead, we have a proposition for you: cooperation between our species, so both Hai and human can mutually benefit in ways more significant than the financial one."|1231|0
units.english: "You'll understand, however, that we can't simply sell you the documents you're requesting. Instead, we have a proposition for you: cooperation between our species, so both Hai and human can mutually benefit in ways more significant than the financial one."
units.italian: "Capirai, però, che non possiamo semplicemente venderti i documenti che chiedi. Abbiamo invece una proposta: cooperazione fra le nostre specie, così che sia gli Hai sia gli umani possano trarne beneficio in modi più significativi di quello economico."

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 7b|	Given this opportunity, you tell them about the Sheragi black box found in the dig site, and the possibility of decrypting it and uncovering its secrets.|1232|0
units.english: Given this opportunity, you tell them about the Sheragi black box found in the dig site, and the possibility of decrypting it and uncovering its secrets.
units.italian: Vista l'opportunità, racconti della scatola nera Sheragi trovata nel sito di scavo, e della possibilità di decifrarla e scoprirne i segreti.

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 7b|	"With the proper tools, we could decode it. But in return, we'd like to have a copy of the contents as well, and to learn more about your findings."|1233|0
units.english: "With the proper tools, we could decode it. But in return, we'd like to have a copy of the contents as well, and to learn more about your findings."
units.italian: "Con gli strumenti giusti potremmo decodificarla. Ma in cambio vorremmo avere anche una copia del contenuto, e saperne di più sui vostri ritrovamenti."

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 7b|	"Wait, can't I just pay for some help?"|1235|0
units.english: "Wait, can't I just pay for some help?"
units.italian: "Aspetta, non posso semplicemente pagare per un aiuto?"

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 7b|	"Sounds fair to me."|1236|0
units.english: "Sounds fair to me."
units.italian: "Mi sembra giusto."

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 7b|	"This is an excellent opportunity for us to learn as well, Captain <last>. We're not going to take anything from you, but rather, it's a mutual benefit."|1238|0
units.english: "This is an excellent opportunity for us to learn as well, Captain <last>. We're not going to take anything from you, but rather, it's a mutual benefit."
units.italian: "È un'ottima opportunità anche per noi, capitano <last>. Non ti toglieremo nulla, anzi: è un beneficio reciproco."

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 7b|	You ponder your choices for a moment. There is no way you could solve this puzzle without their help. You've gone this far, so you agree.|1239|0
units.english: You ponder your choices for a moment. There is no way you could solve this puzzle without their help. You've gone this far, so you agree.
units.italian: Rifletti un momento sulle tue scelte. Non hai modo di risolvere questo enigma senza il loro aiuto. Sei arrivato fin qui, quindi accetti.

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 7b|	"Excellent!" the Hai exclaims.|1241|0
units.english: "Excellent!" the Hai exclaims.
units.italian: "Eccellente!" esclama l'Hai.

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 7b|	They chat with you a bit more, and the diplomatic leader excuses himself for a moment to make a call. A moment later he returns.|1242|0
units.english: They chat with you a bit more, and the diplomatic leader excuses himself for a moment to make a call. A moment later he returns.
units.italian: Chiacchierano ancora un po' con te, e il capo dei diplomatici si scusa un momento per fare una chiamata. Un attimo dopo torna.

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 7b|	"We have arranged for a very capable team of archaeologists to meet you in the spaceport in a few hours. They specialize in Sheragi artifacts. I would advise you to make room for three passengers and some cargo for their equipment."|1243|0
units.english: "We have arranged for a very capable team of archaeologists to meet you in the spaceport in a few hours. They specialize in Sheragi artifacts. I would advise you to make room for three passengers and some cargo for their equipment."
units.italian: "Abbiamo organizzato l'incontro allo spazioporto, tra qualche ora, con una squadra di archeologi molto capaci. Sono specializzati in reperti Sheragi. Ti consiglio di fare spazio per tre passeggeri e un po' di carico per la loro attrezzatura."

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 7b|	You thank them for their help and leave the building, ready to meet your new team in the spaceport.|1244|0
units.english: You thank them for their help and leave the building, ready to meet your new team in the spaceport.
units.italian: Li ringrazi per l'aiuto e lasci l'edificio, pronto a incontrare la tua nuova squadra allo spazioporto.

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 8|name|1249|0
units.english: Assembling the Team
units.italian: Riunire la squadra

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 8|description|1250|0
units.english: Take the Hai archaeologists to meet Albert Foster on <destination>.
units.italian: Porta gli archeologi Hai a incontrare Albert Foster su <destination>.

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 8|blocked|1255|0
units.english: You arrive at the spaceport, but then you realize your ships don't have enough free bunks or cargo space required to bring the archaeologist team with you. You manage to contact them, and in an embarrassing conversation ask them to wait for you while you make sure you're ready.
units.italian: Arrivi allo spazioporto, ma poi ti rendi conto che le tue navi non hanno abbastanza cuccette libere o spazio nel carico per portare con te la squadra di archeologi. Riesci a contattarli e, in una conversazione imbarazzante, chiedi loro di aspettarti mentre ti assicuri di essere pronto.

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 8|You meet up with the Hai archaeologists that will accompany you to human space, an all female team. They introduce themselves to you as Eyama, Rakei, and Desyo.|1262|0
units.english: You meet up with the Hai archaeologists that will accompany you to human space, an all female team. They introduce themselves to you as Eyama, Rakei, and Desyo.
units.italian: Incontri gli archeologi Hai che ti accompagneranno nello spazio umano, una squadra tutta al femminile. Si presentano come Eyama, Rakei e Desyo.

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 8|	Eyama is a linguist specializing in the Sheragi language. She playfully greets you in the dragons' rather guttural tongue, with strange tones.|1263|0
units.english: Eyama is a linguist specializing in the Sheragi language. She playfully greets you in the dragons' rather guttural tongue, with strange tones.
units.italian: Eyama è una linguista specializzata nella lingua Sheragi. Ti saluta scherzosamente nella lingua gutturale dei draghi, con tonalità strane.

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 8|	Rakei is an archaeological engineer, who immediately takes a liking to the cube as soon as she sees it, examining its structure.|1264|0
units.english: Rakei is an archaeological engineer, who immediately takes a liking to the cube as soon as she sees it, examining its structure.
units.italian: Rakei è un'esperta di ingegneria archeologica, e prende subito in simpatia il cubo appena lo vede, esaminandone la struttura.

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 8|	Finally, Desyo is a xenoprogramming expert who studies alien software, and seemingly has a lot of experience with Sheragi code. Apparently, the displays of the Sheragi room of the museum all run in this exotic language, unseen by the public.|1265|0
units.english: Finally, Desyo is a xenoprogramming expert who studies alien software, and seemingly has a lot of experience with Sheragi code. Apparently, the displays of the Sheragi room of the museum all run in this exotic language, unseen by the public.
units.italian: Infine Desyo è un'esperta di xenoprogrammazione che studia software alieni, e sembra avere molta esperienza con il codice Sheragi. A quanto pare, i display della sala Sheragi del museo funzionano tutti in questa lingua esotica, invisibile al pubblico.

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 8|	After the brief introduction, they each take their equipment and load it into the cargo bay of your ship. Rakei approaches you after everything is in place.|1266|0
units.english: After the brief introduction, they each take their equipment and load it into the cargo bay of your ship. Rakei approaches you after everything is in place.
units.italian: Dopo la breve presentazione, ognuna prende la propria attrezzatura e la carica nella stiva della tua nave. Rakei ti si avvicina quando tutto è al suo posto.

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 8|	"We want to meet the human archaeologist who uncovered the ruins in the Rim. Can you take us there? We will start examining the cube along the way. I think by the time we get there, we'll have something to work with."|1267|0
units.english: "We want to meet the human archaeologist who uncovered the ruins in the Rim. Can you take us there? We will start examining the cube along the way. I think by the time we get there, we'll have something to work with."
units.italian: "Vogliamo incontrare l'archeologo umano che ha riportato alla luce le rovine nel Bordo. Puoi portarci da lui? Cominceremo a esaminare il cubo lungo la strada. Credo che quando arriveremo avremo qualcosa su cui lavorare."

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 8|log|1274|0
units.english: A brilliant Hai xenoprogramming expert, Desyo specializes in Sheragi code and software. She is more interested in technology and electronics than people and often coordinates the work in the Hai archaeologist team, despite her introversion and lack of hierarchy. Her dedication is the grease that keeps that machine running.
units.italian: Esperta di xenoprogrammazione Hai di grande talento, Desyo è specializzata nel codice e nel software Sheragi. Si interessa più di tecnologia ed elettronica che di persone, e coordina spesso il lavoro della squadra di archeologi Hai, nonostante la sua introversione e la mancanza di gerarchia. La sua dedizione è l'olio che tiene in moto quella macchina.

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 8|log|1275|0
units.english: Rakei is an engineering expert specializing in archaeological artifacts, but also very interested in new and unusual technology, often nerding out with Desyo over the latest scientific papers. She is part of the Hai archaeologist team tasked to uncover the mystery of the Sheragi black box.
units.italian: Rakei è un'esperta di ingegneria specializzata in reperti archeologici, ma anche molto interessata a tecnologia nuova e insolita, e spesso si entusiasma con Desyo sugli ultimi articoli scientifici. Fa parte della squadra di archeologi Hai incaricata di svelare il mistero della scatola nera Sheragi.

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 8|log|1276|0
units.english: Uncaring about formalities and seriousness, you wouldn't guess Eyama is an accomplished linguist specializing in Sheragi language. She also has an interest in culture and sociology in general, and has a lot more knowledge about human culture than you would expect from a Hai, or even most humans. Her work with the Hai archaeologist team is invaluable to deciphering Sheragi mysteries and maintaining their relationship with human partners.
units.italian: Poco attenta alle formalità e alla serietà, non diresti che Eyama è una linguista affermata specializzata nella lingua Sheragi. Si interessa anche di cultura e sociologia in generale, e sa molto più sulla cultura umana di quanto ti aspetteresti da un Hai, o anche dalla maggior parte degli umani. Il suo lavoro con la squadra di archeologi Hai è prezioso per decifrare i misteri Sheragi e mantenere i rapporti con i partner umani.

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 8|It was a long trip, almost halfway across the galaxy. The Hai archaeologists have been quite friendly and amiable, giving you updates every time they made a new breakthrough. During this time, the cube, previously thought to be impenetrable, had been disassembled and cleaned. Components that decayed into a mess of oxidized wires and goopy paste over the eons have been identified and removed to substitute for equivalent ones, and a blueprint of the box and its circuits has started to take shape.|1278|0
units.english: It was a long trip, almost halfway across the galaxy. The Hai archaeologists have been quite friendly and amiable, giving you updates every time they made a new breakthrough. During this time, the cube, previously thought to be impenetrable, had been disassembled and cleaned. Components that decayed into a mess of oxidized wires and goopy paste over the eons have been identified and removed to substitute for equivalent ones, and a blueprint of the box and its circuits has started to take shape.
units.italian: È stato un viaggio lungo, quasi metà della galassia. Gli archeologi Hai sono stati molto amichevoli e cordiali, e ti aggiornavano ogni volta che facevano un nuovo passo avanti. Nel frattempo il cubo, che si pensava impenetrabile, è stato smontato e ripulito. I componenti che nel corso degli eoni si erano ridotti a un ammasso di fili ossidati e pasta appiccicosa sono stati identificati e rimossi per sostituirli con altri equivalenti, e ha cominciato a prendere forma un progetto della scatola e dei suoi circuiti.

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 8|	As soon as you land, you call Albert Foster, who doesn't believe you when you say you've gotten alien archaeologists to help. You then look for the three Hai to figure out how they're going to go unnoticed on a human world. You're surprised to find Eyama wearing long, dark but colorful human clothing with an equally oversized hoodie and a bandanna. You recognize this outfit, very popular with the youth these days, who are generally regarded as delinquents by the previous generation. Additionally, she's carrying two more sets for her Hai partners as well. It hides her body really well at the cost of making her look like a young boy, and the Hai's relatively short stature doesn't help.|1279|0
units.english: As soon as you land, you call Albert Foster, who doesn't believe you when you say you've gotten alien archaeologists to help. You then look for the three Hai to figure out how they're going to go unnoticed on a human world. You're surprised to find Eyama wearing long, dark but colorful human clothing with an equally oversized hoodie and a bandanna. You recognize this outfit, very popular with the youth these days, who are generally regarded as delinquents by the previous generation. Additionally, she's carrying two more sets for her Hai partners as well. It hides her body really well at the cost of making her look like a young boy, and the Hai's relatively short stature doesn't help.
units.italian: Appena atterri, chiami Albert Foster, che non ti crede quando dici di aver trovato archeologi alieni disposti ad aiutarvi. Poi cerchi le tre Hai per capire come faranno a passare inosservate su un mondo umano. Ti sorprende trovare Eyama vestita con abiti umani lunghi, scuri ma colorati, con una felpa altrettanto oversize e un fazzoletto. Riconosci questo look, molto in voga tra i giovani di oggi, che la generazione precedente considera in genere dei delinquenti. Inoltre ha con sé altri due completi per le sue colleghe Hai. Nasconde il corpo molto bene, al prezzo di farla sembrare un ragazzino, e la statura relativamente bassa degli Hai non aiuta.

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 8|	"Call me Miss Deus ex Machina, because I thought ahead and bought these from a merchant back home. Perfect disguises. The humans will never notice. How do I look?"|1280|0
units.english: "Call me Miss Deus ex Machina, because I thought ahead and bought these from a merchant back home. Perfect disguises. The humans will never notice. How do I look?"
units.italian: "Chiamami Signorina Deus ex Machina, perché ci ho pensato prima e li ho comprati da un mercante a casa mia. Travestimenti perfetti. Gli umani non se ne accorgeranno mai. Come sto?"

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 8|	"That's... clever. It hides you well."|1282|0
units.english: "That's... clever. It hides you well."
units.italian: "È... ingegnoso. Ti nasconde bene."

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 8|	"Well, it works, but you look like a child."|1283|0
units.english: "Well, it works, but you look like a child."
units.italian: "Beh, funziona, ma sembri una bambina."

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 8|	"Right? I can even hide my tail in the back of the hoodie!" She spins around happily.|1285|0
units.english: "Right? I can even hide my tail in the back of the hoodie!" She spins around happily.
units.italian: "Vero? Posso perfino nascondere la coda dietro il cappuccio!" Si gira su sé stessa contenta.

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 8|	"That's not that bad, is it? I always considered myself young at heart, anyway!" she giggles a little.|1288|0
units.english: "That's not that bad, is it? I always considered myself young at heart, anyway!" she giggles a little.
units.italian: "Non è poi così male, no? Comunque mi sono sempre considerata giovane dentro!" ridacchia un po'.

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 8|	"Anyway, can you take us to Mr. Foster's museum? We'll take the cube and fill him in on the details."|1290|0
units.english: "Anyway, can you take us to Mr. Foster's museum? We'll take the cube and fill him in on the details."
units.italian: "Comunque, puoi portarci al museo del signor Foster? Prenderemo il cubo e lo aggiorneremo sui dettagli."

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 8|	You agree, and after they're all ready, you make your way out to the dig site. Surprisingly, the three Hai don't get many weird looks if they walk a bit further behind you. You arrive at the museum and they immediately break character by being very obviously excited to see the exhibits. This probably comes as a relief to onlookers, however, who would normally expect that type of kid to vandalize priceless artifacts.|1291|0
units.english: You agree, and after they're all ready, you make your way out to the dig site. Surprisingly, the three Hai don't get many weird looks if they walk a bit further behind you. You arrive at the museum and they immediately break character by being very obviously excited to see the exhibits. This probably comes as a relief to onlookers, however, who would normally expect that type of kid to vandalize priceless artifacts.
units.italian: Accetti, e dopo che sono tutte pronte vi incamminate verso il sito di scavo. Sorprendentemente, le tre Hai non ricevono molti sguardi strani se camminano un po' più indietro di te. Arrivate al museo e rompono subito il personaggio, mostrandosi chiaramente entusiaste di vedere gli exhibit. Il che probabilmente è un sollievo per i passanti, che normalmente si aspetterebbero da quel tipo di ragazzino atti di vandalismo su reperti inestimabili.

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 8|	Finally, you arrive at Albert's workshop. He stops brushing layers of hardened soil off of an object that looks like it was once a television, and looks startled at you and the three "kids." The Hai take off their hoods and bandannas, causing his jaw to nearly drop to the floor.|1292|0
units.english: Finally, you arrive at Albert's workshop. He stops brushing layers of hardened soil off of an object that looks like it was once a television, and looks startled at you and the three "kids." The Hai take off their hoods and bandannas, causing his jaw to nearly drop to the floor.
units.italian: Alla fine arrivate all'officina di Albert. Lui smette di spazzolare gli strati di terra indurita da un oggetto che sembra essere stato un televisore, e ti guarda allarmato, insieme ai tre "ragazzini". Le Hai si tolgono cappucci e fazzoletti, e la sua mascella quasi gli cade a terra.

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 8|	"I'll be damned. The Hai really exist!" he exclaims.|1293|0
units.english: "I'll be damned. The Hai really exist!" he exclaims.
units.italian: "Che mi venga un colpo. Gli Hai esistono davvero!" esclama.

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 8|	"Of course we do," Eyama laughs. "Haven't you heard all the stories?"|1294|0
units.english: "Of course we do," Eyama laughs. "Haven't you heard all the stories?"
units.italian: "Certo che esistiamo," ride Eyama. "Non hai sentito tutte le storie?"

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 8|	"I had my doubts. Merchants are not usually the most reputable sources." He smiles. "I'm Albert Foster, archaeologist, pleased to meet you all."|1295|0
units.english: "I had my doubts. Merchants are not usually the most reputable sources." He smiles. "I'm Albert Foster, archaeologist, pleased to meet you all."
units.italian: "Avevo i miei dubbi. I mercanti non sono di solito le fonti più attendibili." Sorride. "Sono Albert Foster, archeologo, piacere di conoscervi."

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 8|	They introduce themselves, and very soon the conversation evolves to a kind of jargon even Albert has trouble following. They talk about the box and their findings, while Albert talks about the history uncovered in the dig site and insights on the Sheragi daily life and culture. You close the door to make sure nobody else is listening in.|1296|0
units.english: They introduce themselves, and very soon the conversation evolves to a kind of jargon even Albert has trouble following. They talk about the box and their findings, while Albert talks about the history uncovered in the dig site and insights on the Sheragi daily life and culture. You close the door to make sure nobody else is listening in.
units.italian: Si presentano, e molto presto la conversazione scivola in una specie di gergo che anche Albert fatica a seguire. Parlano della scatola e dei loro ritrovamenti, mentre Albert racconta la storia emersa dal sito di scavo e le sue intuizioni sulla vita quotidiana e la cultura Sheragi. Chiudi la porta per assicurarti che nessun altro stia ascoltando.

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 8|	"We've managed to open the box and we're making a blueprint of it," says Desyo. "Once that's done, we might be able to rebuild the broken pieces and recover the data. We already have documentation on how their hardware worked."|1297|0
units.english: "We've managed to open the box and we're making a blueprint of it," says Desyo. "Once that's done, we might be able to rebuild the broken pieces and recover the data. We already have documentation on how their hardware worked."
units.italian: "Siamo riusciti ad aprire la scatola e stiamo facendo un progetto," dice Desyo. "Quando avremo finito, potremmo essere in grado di ricostruire i pezzi rotti e recuperare i dati. Abbiamo già la documentazione su come funzionava il loro hardware."

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 8|	"The catch is that this is a collaboration now. We'll help you, if you share your findings with us," Rakei continues.|1298|0
units.english: "The catch is that this is a collaboration now. We'll help you, if you share your findings with us," Rakei continues.
units.italian: "Il punto è che ora è una collaborazione. Vi aiuteremo, se condividerete i vostri ritrovamenti con noi," continua Rakei.

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 8|	"Sounds like a fair deal to me," Albert says. "We'll arrange the details later. <first>, thank you so much for your help. We'll continue studying this artifact, and we'll send you a message when we're done."|1299|0
units.english: "Sounds like a fair deal to me," Albert says. "We'll arrange the details later. <first>, thank you so much for your help. We'll continue studying this artifact, and we'll send you a message when we're done."
units.italian: "Mi sembra un accordo giusto," dice Albert. "Definiremo i dettagli più avanti. <first>, grazie mille per il tuo aiuto. Continueremo a studiare questo reperto, e ti manderemo un messaggio quando avremo finito."

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 8|	You say goodbye to Albert, Rakei, Eyama, and Desyo, and make your way back to your ship. However, as you're walking back to the ship, you feel a heavy hand on your shoulder. You look back, and you're startled to see a Quarg. It's Yarthis, who came to this system to watch over the Sheragi dig site.|1300|0
units.english: You say goodbye to Albert, Rakei, Eyama, and Desyo, and make your way back to your ship. However, as you're walking back to the ship, you feel a heavy hand on your shoulder. You look back, and you're startled to see a Quarg. It's Yarthis, who came to this system to watch over the Sheragi dig site.
units.italian: Saluti Albert, Rakei, Eyama e Desyo, e torni alla tua nave. Mentre però stai tornando a bordo, senti una mano pesante sulla spalla. Ti volti, e sussulti vedendo un Quarg. È Yarthis, venuto in questo sistema per sorvegliare il sito Sheragi.

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 8|	"I wasn't expecting to see you here."|1302|0
units.english: "I wasn't expecting to see you here."
units.italian: "Non mi aspettavo di vederti qui."

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 8|	"Can I help you?"|1303|0
units.english: "Can I help you?"
units.italian: "Posso aiutarti?"

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 8|	"It has come to my attention that your friends have found a Sheragi black box, and kept it a secret. I am well aware your species view us with distrust, but please understand we only work to prevent extinction. I've been told not to interfere, but I must advise you to be careful with its contents. You will be led to more memories of the Sheragi, and a glimpse at their destruction. But what you find should be seen as nothing more than an oddity, not something to replicate or imitate."|1304|0
units.english: "It has come to my attention that your friends have found a Sheragi black box, and kept it a secret. I am well aware your species view us with distrust, but please understand we only work to prevent extinction. I've been told not to interfere, but I must advise you to be careful with its contents. You will be led to more memories of the Sheragi, and a glimpse at their destruction. But what you find should be seen as nothing more than an oddity, not something to replicate or imitate."
units.italian: "Mi è giunto all'orecchio che i tuoi amici hanno trovato una scatola nera Sheragi, e l'hanno tenuta segreta. So bene che la tua specie ci guarda con diffidenza, ma cerca di capire: noi lavoriamo solo per impedire l'estinzione. Mi è stato detto di non interferire, ma devo consigliarti prudenza con il suo contenuto. Sarai condotto ad altri ricordi degli Sheragi, e a uno scorcio della loro distruzione. Ma quello che troverai va considerato solo una curiosità, non qualcosa da replicare o imitare."

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Box 8|	It turns around and leaves you without another word.|1305|0
units.english: It turns around and leaves you without another word.
units.italian: Si volta e ti lascia senza un'altra parola.

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Emerald Sword 1|name|1313|0
units.english: Black Box Decoded
units.italian: Scatola nera decifrata

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Emerald Sword 1|description|1314|0
units.english: Visit Albert Foster on Zug.
units.italian: Visita Albert Foster su Zug.

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Emerald Sword 1|You're still in the middle of the post-flight check when you receive a new encoded message from Albert Foster.|1324|0
units.english: You're still in the middle of the post-flight check when you receive a new encoded message from Albert Foster.
units.italian: Sei ancora a metà dei controlli dopo il volo quando ricevi un nuovo messaggio cifrato da Albert Foster.

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Emerald Sword 1|	"Hello <first>. I have some good news! We have decoded what's in the black box. You should come visit us on Zug; we have plenty to tell you!"|1325|0
units.english: "Hello <first>. I have some good news! We have decoded what's in the black box. You should come visit us on Zug; we have plenty to tell you!"
units.italian: "Ciao <first>. Ho buone notizie! Abbiamo decifrato ciò che c'è nella scatola nera. Dovresti venire a trovarci su Zug; abbiamo molto da raccontarti!"

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Emerald Sword 2|name|1331|0
units.english: The Emerald Sword
units.italian: La Spada di Smeraldo

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Emerald Sword 2|description|1332|0
units.english: Bring an additional jump drive to Zug.
units.italian: Porta un motore di salto in più su Zug.

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Emerald Sword 2|You arrive on Zug, and after contacting Albert and the three Hai archaeologists and following their directions, you find them in an ice cream shop. They're still wearing the youngster clothes, but not even bothering to hide their faces with bandannas anymore. Surprisingly, nobody seems too distressed at the sight. Rakei waves for you and stands up, coming to you with ice creams in paw.|1339|0
units.english: You arrive on Zug, and after contacting Albert and the three Hai archaeologists and following their directions, you find them in an ice cream shop. They're still wearing the youngster clothes, but not even bothering to hide their faces with bandannas anymore. Surprisingly, nobody seems too distressed at the sight. Rakei waves for you and stands up, coming to you with ice creams in paw.
