units.italian: Arrivi su Zug, e dopo aver contattato Albert e le tre archeologhe Hai e aver seguito le loro indicazioni, li trovi in una gelateria. Indossano ancora i vestiti da ragazzini, ma non si preoccupano più di nascondere il viso con i fazzoletti. Sorprendentemente, nessuno sembra turbato dalla vista. Rakei ti fa cenno e si alza, venendoti incontro con i gelati in mano.

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Emerald Sword 2|	"Hello <first>! It seems our disguise worked better than intended. The humans around here think we're wearing a costume. Apparently young humans like to dress up as aliens?" she says confusedly.|1340|0
units.english: "Hello <first>! It seems our disguise worked better than intended. The humans around here think we're wearing a costume. Apparently young humans like to dress up as aliens?" she says confusedly.
units.italian: "Ciao <first>! Sembra che il nostro travestimento abbia funzionato meglio del previsto. Gli umani qui intorno pensano che indossiamo un costume. A quanto pare ai giovani umani piace vestirsi da alieni?" dice confusa.

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Emerald Sword 2|	"I had a feeling we'd fit right in with the furry crowd," Eyama responds proudly.|1341|0
units.english: "I had a feeling we'd fit right in with the furry crowd," Eyama responds proudly.
units.italian: "Avevo la sensazione che ci saremmo integrate bene nella fauna pelosa," risponde Eyama con orgoglio.

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Emerald Sword 2|	"It has been an interesting cultural exchange. Human space might be a great vacation spot for us. But we're not on vacation yet. We have a mystery to solve," she continues.|1342|0
units.english: "It has been an interesting cultural exchange. Human space might be a great vacation spot for us. But we're not on vacation yet. We have a mystery to solve," she continues.
units.italian: "È stato uno scambio culturale interessante. Lo spazio umano potrebbe essere un ottimo posto per le vacanze, per noi. Ma non siamo ancora in vacanza. Abbiamo un mistero da risolvere," continua.

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Emerald Sword 2|	You sit down with your group on a bench in a nearby park, mostly empty, and Desyo picks up the conversation.|1343|0
units.english: You sit down with your group on a bench in a nearby park, mostly empty, and Desyo picks up the conversation.
units.italian: Ti siedi con il gruppo su una panchina in un parco vicino, quasi vuoto, e Desyo riprende la conversazione.

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Emerald Sword 2|	"So, the files in the black box were thankfully standard for Sheragi. Not very difficult to decode, once we managed to read them."|1344|0
units.english: "So, the files in the black box were thankfully standard for Sheragi. Not very difficult to decode, once we managed to read them."
units.italian: "Dunque, i file nella scatola nera erano per fortuna standard per gli Sheragi. Non molto difficili da decodificare, una volta che siamo riusciti a leggerli."

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Emerald Sword 2|	"What did it contain?"|1346|0
units.english: "What did it contain?"
units.italian: "Cosa conteneva?"

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Emerald Sword 2|	Desyo responds, "It was all fleet movement data and military strategy details. This system was apparently on the border of one of the factions' territories. On the final moments of the recording, a large transport fleet had entered the system, unarmed ships. They were followed by military vessels in pursuit. There's no telling what they thought at the time, but a military fleet was immediately dispatched to eliminate both fleets. One particular ship, the name of which Eyama has translated as 'Emerald Sword,' started behaving erratically when given orders. It fired and missed a few shots until it eventually stopped and fled. Clear signs of a mutiny. However, what is perhaps most interesting is that when it fled, it fled in an unexpected direction, away from any hyperlanes."|1347|0
units.english: Desyo responds, "It was all fleet movement data and military strategy details. This system was apparently on the border of one of the factions' territories. On the final moments of the recording, a large transport fleet had entered the system, unarmed ships. They were followed by military vessels in pursuit. There's no telling what they thought at the time, but a military fleet was immediately dispatched to eliminate both fleets. One particular ship, the name of which Eyama has translated as 'Emerald Sword,' started behaving erratically when given orders. It fired and missed a few shots until it eventually stopped and fled. Clear signs of a mutiny. However, what is perhaps most interesting is that when it fled, it fled in an unexpected direction, away from any hyperlanes."
units.italian: Desyo risponde: "Erano tutti dati di movimento di flotte e dettagli di strategia militare. Questo sistema era apparentemente al confine del territorio di una delle fazioni. Negli ultimi istanti della registrazione, una grande flotta da trasporto era entrata nel sistema, navi disarmate. Le seguivano navi militari all'inseguimento. Non è dato sapere cosa pensassero allora, ma una flotta militare fu subito inviata a eliminare entrambe. Una nave in particolare, il cui nome Eyama ha tradotto come 'Spada di Smeraldo', cominciò a comportarsi in modo erratico quando ricevette gli ordini. Sparò e mancò alcuni colpi, finché alla fine si fermò e fuggì. Segni chiari di ammutinamento. Però la cosa più interessante è che, quando fuggì, lo fece in una direzione inaspettata, lontano da qualsiasi ipervia."

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Emerald Sword 2|	Albert continues, "We think they wanted to flee from the fighting. These were soldiers scarred by the horrors of the war, and they just got ordered to attack what we assume to be refugees. The Emerald Sword was a big ship, likely with an equally large crew, and from the movement data, its engines were very powerful too, possibly capable of crossing interstellar distances within a Sheragi lifetime. This has some interesting implications. The ship was moving precisely towards a star named Zubenelhakrabi. Not significant enough to show up in the star maps, but we did our survey, and there is a potentially habitable planet there, but zero signs of intelligent life. We think they failed in colonizing it, but the ship might still be there. It's a priceless artifact. We can't know for sure until we get there. Thing is, there is no way to do so."|1348|0
units.english: Albert continues, "We think they wanted to flee from the fighting. These were soldiers scarred by the horrors of the war, and they just got ordered to attack what we assume to be refugees. The Emerald Sword was a big ship, likely with an equally large crew, and from the movement data, its engines were very powerful too, possibly capable of crossing interstellar distances within a Sheragi lifetime. This has some interesting implications. The ship was moving precisely towards a star named Zubenelhakrabi. Not significant enough to show up in the star maps, but we did our survey, and there is a potentially habitable planet there, but zero signs of intelligent life. We think they failed in colonizing it, but the ship might still be there. It's a priceless artifact. We can't know for sure until we get there. Thing is, there is no way to do so."
units.italian: Albert continua: "Pensiamo volessero fuggire dai combattimenti. Erano soldati segnati dagli orrori della guerra, e gli era appena stato ordinato di attaccare quelli che supponiamo fossero profughi. La Spada di Smeraldo era una nave grande, probabilmente con un equipaggio altrettanto numeroso, e dai dati di movimento i suoi motori erano anche molto potenti, forse capaci di coprire distanze interstellari nella vita di uno Sheragi. Questo ha implicazioni interessanti. La nave si dirigeva esattamente verso una stella chiamata Zubenelhakrabi. Non abbastanza importante da comparire nelle mappe stellari, ma abbiamo fatto un rilevamento, e c'è un pianeta potenzialmente abitabile, ma zero segni di vita intelligente. Pensiamo che abbiano fallito nel colonizzarlo, ma la nave potrebbe essere ancora lì. È un reperto inestimabile. Non possiamo saperlo con certezza finché non ci arriviamo. Il problema è che non c'è modo di farlo."

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Emerald Sword 2|	"Unless you have a jump drive," Rakei adds. "And you do have one, don't you?"|1349|0
units.english: "Unless you have a jump drive," Rakei adds. "And you do have one, don't you?"
units.italian: "A meno che tu non abbia un motore di salto," aggiunge Rakei. "E ce l'hai, vero?"

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Emerald Sword 2|	"I do."|1351|0
units.english: "I do."
units.italian: "Ce l'ho."

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Emerald Sword 2|	"I used to, but not anymore."|1352|0
units.english: "I used to, but not anymore."
units.italian: "Prima sì, ma non più."

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Emerald Sword 2|	"This is perfect! Do you think you can get another one? If we're going there, and the ship's remains are still there, we're going to need one to install on the Emerald Sword and bring it back home."|1354|0
units.english: "This is perfect! Do you think you can get another one? If we're going there, and the ship's remains are still there, we're going to need one to install on the Emerald Sword and bring it back home."
units.italian: "È perfetto! Pensi di poterne trovare un altro? Se andiamo lì e i resti della nave sono ancora al loro posto, ci servirà per installarlo sulla Spada di Smeraldo e riportarla a casa."

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Emerald Sword 2|label|1356|0
units.english: not anymore
units.italian: not anymore

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Emerald Sword 2|	"You sold it?" she replies incredulously. "How can you sell such a priceless piece of technology? Well, I hope there is a way to get more of them without having one, because we're going to need two for the next stage. One for your ship, and another one for the Emerald Sword, if its remains are still there."|1357|0
units.english: "You sold it?" she replies incredulously. "How can you sell such a priceless piece of technology? Well, I hope there is a way to get more of them without having one, because we're going to need two for the next stage. One for your ship, and another one for the Emerald Sword, if its remains are still there."
units.italian: "L'hai venduto?" risponde incredula. "Come si fa a vendere un pezzo di tecnologia così inestimabile? Beh, spero che ci sia un modo per procurarsene altri senza averne uno, perché per la prossima fase ce ne serviranno due. Uno per la tua nave, e un altro per la Spada di Smeraldo, se i suoi resti sono ancora lì."

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Emerald Sword 2|	"What do I get in return?" you ask.|1359|0
units.english: "What do I get in return?" you ask.
units.italian: "Che cosa ottengo in cambio?" chiedi.

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Emerald Sword 2|	"Fame and fortune, my friend. And if the ship is still there, I think you deserve to keep it," Albert responds. "You've helped me so much, and you went to hell and back to get this black box decoded. Give us some time to assemble a crew to survey the system and help refurbish the ship, and in the meantime, go get a jump drive for the Emerald Sword. Come back to us once you have it."|1360|0
units.english: "Fame and fortune, my friend. And if the ship is still there, I think you deserve to keep it," Albert responds. "You've helped me so much, and you went to hell and back to get this black box decoded. Give us some time to assemble a crew to survey the system and help refurbish the ship, and in the meantime, go get a jump drive for the Emerald Sword. Come back to us once you have it."
units.italian: "Fama e fortuna, amico mio. E se la nave è ancora lì, credo che ti meriti di tenerla," risponde Albert. "Mi hai aiutato così tanto, e sei andato all'inferno e ritorno per far decifrare questa scatola nera. Dacci il tempo di mettere insieme un equipaggio per rilevare il sistema e aiutare a rimettere in sesto la nave, e nel frattempo vai a prendere un motore di salto per la Spada di Smeraldo. Torna da noi quando ce l'hai."

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Emerald Sword 2|	"You're just going to let me have it? Isn't this something of a priceless historical artifact?"|1362|0
units.english: "You're just going to let me have it? Isn't this something of a priceless historical artifact?"
units.italian: "Me la lasceresti e basta? Non è forse un reperto storico inestimabile?"

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Emerald Sword 2|	"Thank you."|1364|0
units.english: "Thank you."
units.italian: "Grazie."

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Emerald Sword 2|label|1366|0
units.english: ask keep ship
units.italian: ask keep ship

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Emerald Sword 2|	Albert responds, "Well, yes, but I'd feel much more comfortable with it in your hands than sitting here on <origin> waiting to be destroyed in loose fire during a pirate raid. Besides that though, while the Free Worlds work hard and have a stronger presence here than the Navy ever did, they can't stop everyone who may have an interest in this ship. At least with you it's a moving target."|1367|0
units.english: Albert responds, "Well, yes, but I'd feel much more comfortable with it in your hands than sitting here on <origin> waiting to be destroyed in loose fire during a pirate raid. Besides that though, while the Free Worlds work hard and have a stronger presence here than the Navy ever did, they can't stop everyone who may have an interest in this ship. At least with you it's a moving target."
units.italian: Albert risponde: "Beh, sì, ma mi sentirei molto più tranquillo se fosse nelle tue mani invece di stare qui su <origin> ad aspettare di essere distrutta da un fuoco vagante durante un'incursione pirata. Oltre a questo, i Mondi Liberi lavorano sodo e hanno qui una presenza più forte di quanta ne abbia mai avuta la Marina, ma non possono fermare tutti quelli che potrebbero avere interesse per questa nave. Almeno con te è un bersaglio mobile."

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Emerald Sword 3|name|1382|0
units.english: The Emerald Sword
units.italian: La Spada di Smeraldo

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Emerald Sword 3|description|1383|0
units.english: Search for the Emerald Sword.
units.italian: Cerca la Spada di Smeraldo.

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Emerald Sword 3|blocked|1388|0
units.english: You arrive to make the preparations to jump to Zubenelhakrabi, but Albert stops you. "Captain, the Emerald Sword is an alien ship, and we have no idea how many people we will need to man it, so I've taken the liberty of hiring some extra crew on top of the specialist team. We're going to need 150 additional crew to help, including us, and 50 tons of cargo to take our materials and the spare jump drive."
units.italian: Arrivi per fare i preparativi del salto verso Zubenelhakrabi, ma Albert ti ferma. "Capitano, la Spada di Smeraldo è una nave aliena, e non abbiamo idea di quante persone servano per equipaggiarla, quindi mi sono preso la libertà di assumere altro equipaggio oltre alla squadra di specialisti. Ci serviranno 150 persone in più, noi compresi, e 50 tonnellate di carico per i nostri materiali e il motore di salto di riserva."

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Emerald Sword 3|You have a spare jump drive in your possession. Would you like to give it to Albert's crew?|1396|0
units.english: You have a spare jump drive in your possession. Would you like to give it to Albert's crew?
units.italian: Hai un motore di salto di riserva in tuo possesso. Vuoi darlo all'equipaggio di Albert?

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Emerald Sword 3|	(Yes.)|1398|0
units.english: (Yes.)
units.italian: (Sì.)

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Emerald Sword 3|	(No.)|1399|0
units.english: (No.)
units.italian: (No.)

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Emerald Sword 3|	You give Albert a call, and arrange to meet with him to plan the next step. He shows up at your ship, greets you, and starts loading in some equipment, along with the jump drive you brought. He has assembled a crew of around 150 people, including a specialized team of shipyard workers, a large amount of veteran crew members, himself, and the three Hai archaeologists, who are comfortable to let go of their disguise once they're back in your ship.|1401|0
units.english: You give Albert a call, and arrange to meet with him to plan the next step. He shows up at your ship, greets you, and starts loading in some equipment, along with the jump drive you brought. He has assembled a crew of around 150 people, including a specialized team of shipyard workers, a large amount of veteran crew members, himself, and the three Hai archaeologists, who are comfortable to let go of their disguise once they're back in your ship.
units.italian: Chiami Albert e prendi accordi per incontrarvi e pianificare il passo successivo. Si presenta alla tua nave, ti saluta e comincia a caricare un po' di attrezzatura, insieme al motore di salto che hai portato. Ha messo insieme un equipaggio di circa 150 persone, tra cui una squadra specializzata di operai dei cantieri, un gran numero di membri esperti, lui stesso e le tre archeologhe Hai, che sono ben contente di liberarsi del travestimento una volta rientrate sulla tua nave.

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Emerald Sword 3|	"<first>, meet the people who will help us uncover the fate of the Emerald Sword. I've just briefed them on the situation and what we plan to do. Along with the jump drive, we're going to take some specialized tools with us, which should allow us to repair and outfit the ship in any world we can land on. This might look like a lot of people, but if we want to recover a derelict ship, I suspect we'll need just this many. If you're ready to go, here are the coordinates to Zubenelhakrabi."|1402|0
units.english: "<first>, meet the people who will help us uncover the fate of the Emerald Sword. I've just briefed them on the situation and what we plan to do. Along with the jump drive, we're going to take some specialized tools with us, which should allow us to repair and outfit the ship in any world we can land on. This might look like a lot of people, but if we want to recover a derelict ship, I suspect we'll need just this many. If you're ready to go, here are the coordinates to Zubenelhakrabi."
units.italian: "<first>, ti presento le persone che ci aiuteranno a scoprire il destino della Spada di Smeraldo. Gli ho appena spiegato la situazione e cosa intendiamo fare. Oltre al motore di salto, porteremo con noi alcuni strumenti specializzati, che dovrebbero permetterci di riparare e attrezzare la nave su qualsiasi mondo dove possiamo atterrare. Potrebbe sembrare tanta gente, ma se vogliamo recuperare una nave in rovina, sospetto che ci servirà proprio questo numero. Se sei pronto a partire, ecco le coordinate di Zubenelhakrabi."

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Emerald Sword 3|	You thank Albert, and make your preparations for the voyage into the unknown.|1403|0
units.english: You thank Albert, and make your preparations for the voyage into the unknown.
units.italian: Ringrazi Albert e fai i preparativi per il viaggio verso l'ignoto.

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Emerald Sword 3|The trip to Zubenelhakrabi is completely normal and calm. When you arrive, a simple scan reveals the system's star is unremarkable, nearing the end of its main sequence phase. Among the planets orbiting it, one is in the habitable zone and shows apparent signs of life, covered in dark green spots under the clouds.|1414|0
units.english: The trip to Zubenelhakrabi is completely normal and calm. When you arrive, a simple scan reveals the system's star is unremarkable, nearing the end of its main sequence phase. Among the planets orbiting it, one is in the habitable zone and shows apparent signs of life, covered in dark green spots under the clouds.
units.italian: Il viaggio verso Zubenelhakrabi è del tutto normale e tranquillo. Quando arrivi, una semplice scansione rivela che la stella del sistema è insignificante, vicina alla fine della sua fase di sequenza principale. Tra i pianeti che le orbitano, uno è nella zona abitabile e mostra evidenti segni di vita, coperto di macchie verde scuro sotto le nuvole.

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Emerald Sword 3|	You also find the Emerald Sword, but strangely, it is not on the planet, but drifting through space. An enormous ship of angular design, its most striking feature is an incredibly large cannon going through the center of the ship. It is so large the ship might as well have been built around it; you can only wonder about its power. Thankfully, you won't have to find out the hard way; the ship is inert, derelict, ruined from lack of maintenance, and abandoned to the mercy of micrometeorite showers and decay. It seems like it could fall apart if looked at the wrong way... luckily, you have just the right crew for the job.|1416|0
units.english: You also find the Emerald Sword, but strangely, it is not on the planet, but drifting through space. An enormous ship of angular design, its most striking feature is an incredibly large cannon going through the center of the ship. It is so large the ship might as well have been built around it; you can only wonder about its power. Thankfully, you won't have to find out the hard way; the ship is inert, derelict, ruined from lack of maintenance, and abandoned to the mercy of micrometeorite showers and decay. It seems like it could fall apart if looked at the wrong way... luckily, you have just the right crew for the job.
units.italian: Trovi anche la Spada di Smeraldo, ma stranamente non è sul pianeta: va alla deriva nello spazio. Nave enorme dal disegno angolare, la sua caratteristica più impressionante è un cannone incredibilmente grande che attraversa il centro della nave. È così grande che la nave potrebbe benissimo essere stata costruita intorno a esso; puoi solo chiederti quanto sia potente. Per fortuna non dovrai scoprirlo nel modo peggiore: la nave è inerte, in rovina, rovinata dalla mancanza di manutenzione e abbandonata alla mercé di micrometeoriti e del degrado. Sembra che potrebbe cadere a pezzi se la guardi nel modo sbagliato... per fortuna hai proprio l'equipaggio giusto per il lavoro.

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Emerald Sword 3|	But before you can initiate the approach to the ship, a strange feeling washes over you. First, a feeling of being watched by something far greater. Then, a void in your chest, a deep apprehension you can't shake. A thought forms in your mind, but it's not your own:|1417|0
units.english: But before you can initiate the approach to the ship, a strange feeling washes over you. First, a feeling of being watched by something far greater. Then, a void in your chest, a deep apprehension you can't shake. A thought forms in your mind, but it's not your own:
units.italian: Ma prima che tu possa iniziare l'avvicinamento alla nave, ti investe una sensazione strana. Prima la sensazione di essere osservato da qualcosa di molto più grande. Poi un vuoto nel petto, un profondo timore che non riesci a scacciare. Nella tua mente si forma un pensiero, ma non è il tuo:

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Emerald Sword 3|	"You have arrived, human. This was the Sheragi's last stand before their extinction. You would do well not to disturb this place of remembrance." A strong shiver washes over you as the thoughts of "extinction" and "remembrance" are punctuated by an indescribable feeling. As if there is a cold deep within your bones.|1418|0
units.english: "You have arrived, human. This was the Sheragi's last stand before their extinction. You would do well not to disturb this place of remembrance." A strong shiver washes over you as the thoughts of "extinction" and "remembrance" are punctuated by an indescribable feeling. As if there is a cold deep within your bones.
units.italian: "Sei arrivato, umano. Questo fu l'ultimo baluardo degli Sheragi prima della loro estinzione. Faresti bene a non disturbare questo luogo di memoria." Un brivido forte ti attraversa mentre le parole "estinzione" e "memoria" sono scandite da una sensazione indescrivibile. Come se ci fosse un freddo dentro le tue ossa.

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Emerald Sword 3|	"Who are you?"|1420|0
units.english: "Who are you?"
units.italian: "Chi sei?"

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Emerald Sword 3|	"What... what is this feeling?"|1422|0
units.english: "What... what is this feeling?"
units.italian: "Che... che cos'è questa sensazione?"

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Emerald Sword 3|	There is a pause. The feeling of being watched becomes intense, as if you're being studied intently.|1423|0
units.english: There is a pause. The feeling of being watched becomes intense, as if you're being studied intently.
units.italian: C'è una pausa. La sensazione di essere osservato diventa intensa, come se fossi studiato con attenzione.

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Emerald Sword 3|	"A human would call it... dread. Regret. Loss. You are standing in the last untouched graveyard of a lost civilization.|1424|0
units.english: "A human would call it... dread. Regret. Loss. You are standing in the last untouched graveyard of a lost civilization.
units.italian: "Un umano la chiamerebbe... terrore. Rimpianto. Perdita. Sei in piedi nell'ultimo cimitero intatto di una civiltà perduta.

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Emerald Sword 3|	"I am the guardian of this site. I am also the one who guided you towards the buried city, so your species would bear witness and take heed of the lessons of ones who have long succumbed to their own folly. I did not intend for you to reach this far.|1426|0
units.english: "I am the guardian of this site. I am also the one who guided you towards the buried city, so your species would bear witness and take heed of the lessons of ones who have long succumbed to their own folly. I did not intend for you to reach this far.
units.italian: "Sono il guardiano di questo sito. Sono anche colui che ti ha guidato verso la città sepolta, perché la tua specie fosse testimone e tenesse conto delle lezioni di chi da tempo ha ceduto alla propria follia. Non intendevo che arrivassi così lontano.

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Emerald Sword 3|	"Here is where the Sheragi came to an end. The tools that drove them to extinction are long gone. We witnessed as they cast those tools into the heart of this star."|1427|0
units.english: "Here is where the Sheragi came to an end. The tools that drove them to extinction are long gone. We witnessed as they cast those tools into the heart of this star."
units.italian: "Qui è dove gli Sheragi giunsero alla fine. Gli strumenti che li portarono all'estinzione sono spariti da tempo. Abbiamo assistito al momento in cui li gettarono nel cuore di questa stella."

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Emerald Sword 3|	"You mean this ship? Its weapons systems seem to be intact."|1429|0
units.english: "You mean this ship? Its weapons systems seem to be intact."
units.italian: "Intendi questa nave? I suoi sistemi d'arma sembrano intatti."

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Emerald Sword 3|	"What tools?"|1431|0
units.english: "What tools?"
units.italian: "Quali strumenti?"

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Emerald Sword 3|	"Ones capable of crippling an entire world's worth of life."|1432|0
units.english: "Ones capable of crippling an entire world's worth of life."
units.italian: "Quelli capaci di annientare tutta la vita di un intero mondo."

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Emerald Sword 3|	"That ship is just a relic, its weapons a mere trinket. The weapon that perished the Sheragi was indiscriminate. An irrational decision they made for themselves, failing to judge the risk."|1435|0
units.english: "That ship is just a relic, its weapons a mere trinket. The weapon that perished the Sheragi was indiscriminate. An irrational decision they made for themselves, failing to judge the risk."
units.italian: "Quella nave è solo un reperto, le sue armi un semplice gingillo. L'arma che distrusse gli Sheragi non distingueva tra amici e nemici. Una decisione irrazionale che presero per sé stessi, senza saper valutare il rischio."

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Emerald Sword 3|	As that is said, you're overcome by glimpses of memories that are not yours, not clear enough for you to identify what exactly is happening, but you can feel a hellish panic in them.|1437|0
units.english: As that is said, you're overcome by glimpses of memories that are not yours, not clear enough for you to identify what exactly is happening, but you can feel a hellish panic in them.
units.italian: Mentre questo viene detto, sei sopraffatto da scorci di ricordi che non sono tuoi, non abbastanza nitidi perché tu possa capire cosa sta succedendo esattamente, ma in essi senti un panico infernale.

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Emerald Sword 3|	The voice continues: "I know what you seek here. The trinket you covet is of little relevance, even for your own, human standards. But if you wish to possess it, then take it. Show your respect to those who have perished here, learn their lessons, and I will allow it. Perhaps the sight of that vessel will remind the living races of those who have come and gone... and how, despite their great accomplishments, their decision to make war reduced them to graveyards, relics, memories... and dust."|1438|0
units.english: The voice continues: "I know what you seek here. The trinket you covet is of little relevance, even for your own, human standards. But if you wish to possess it, then take it. Show your respect to those who have perished here, learn their lessons, and I will allow it. Perhaps the sight of that vessel will remind the living races of those who have come and gone... and how, despite their great accomplishments, their decision to make war reduced them to graveyards, relics, memories... and dust."
units.italian: La voce continua: "So cosa cerchi qui. Il gingillo a cui ambisci ha poca rilevanza, anche per i tuoi standard umani. Ma se desideri possederlo, prendilo. Mostra rispetto a chi è perito qui, impara le loro lezioni, e lo permetterò. Forse la vista di quel vascello ricorderà alle razze viventi di quelli che sono venuti e se ne sono andati... e di come, nonostante i loro grandi successi, la loro decisione di fare la guerra li abbia ridotti a cimiteri, reperti, ricordi... e polvere."

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Emerald Sword 3|	The voice, and the overwhelming emotions that came alongside it, disappear as mysteriously as they came. Desyo, who witnessed you speaking into the void, asks whether you feel okay. It seems like no one else heard it.|1439|0
units.english: The voice, and the overwhelming emotions that came alongside it, disappear as mysteriously as they came. Desyo, who witnessed you speaking into the void, asks whether you feel okay. It seems like no one else heard it.
units.italian: La voce, e le emozioni travolgenti che l'accompagnavano, spariscono misteriosamente come sono arrivate. Desyo, che ti ha visto parlare nel vuoto, ti chiede se stai bene. Sembra che nessun altro l'abbia sentita.

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Emerald Sword 3|You dock with the Emerald Sword and the crew starts working to carefully find a way in, directed by the Hai archaeologists. There is no atmosphere inside, as the life support has long since ceased to work.|1447|0
units.english: You dock with the Emerald Sword and the crew starts working to carefully find a way in, directed by the Hai archaeologists. There is no atmosphere inside, as the life support has long since ceased to work.
units.italian: Ti agganci alla Spada di Smeraldo e l'equipaggio comincia a lavorare per trovare con cautela un modo per entrare, sotto la guida delle archeologhe Hai. All'interno non c'è atmosfera, perché il supporto vitale ha smesso di funzionare da tempo.

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Emerald Sword 3|	After patching as many micrometeorite holes as you can find, you use your ship's own life support to restore the Emerald Sword's atmosphere, and connect your ship's power to it to get the ship's systems minimally functional. Once it's in breathable condition, the crew boards the ship and begins getting to work. With the freshly pressurized atmosphere, you can't help but think that it smells like a tomb.|1448|0
units.english: After patching as many micrometeorite holes as you can find, you use your ship's own life support to restore the Emerald Sword's atmosphere, and connect your ship's power to it to get the ship's systems minimally functional. Once it's in breathable condition, the crew boards the ship and begins getting to work. With the freshly pressurized atmosphere, you can't help but think that it smells like a tomb.
units.italian: Dopo aver tappato tutti i fori da micrometeorite che riesci a trovare, usi il supporto vitale della tua nave per ripristinare l'atmosfera della Spada di Smeraldo, e colleghi l'energia della tua nave alla sua per rendere i sistemi minimamente funzionanti. Quando l'ambiente è respirabile, l'equipaggio sale a bordo e comincia a lavorare. Con l'atmosfera appena pressurizzata, non puoi fare a meno di pensare che sa di tomba.

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Emerald Sword 3|	Foster divides the crew up into various groups to explore the massive vessel and report back with their findings. "We may be here for a while. There's no telling how long it will take us to get this thing operational again. It has been many thousands of years after all," he says. Foster immediately begins inspecting one of the many Sheragi remains on board, while Eyama, Rakei, and Desyo each explore the ship with their own groups.|1449|0
units.english: Foster divides the crew up into various groups to explore the massive vessel and report back with their findings. "We may be here for a while. There's no telling how long it will take us to get this thing operational again. It has been many thousands of years after all," he says. Foster immediately begins inspecting one of the many Sheragi remains on board, while Eyama, Rakei, and Desyo each explore the ship with their own groups.
units.italian: Foster divide l'equipaggio in vari gruppi per esplorare l'enorme vascello e riferire i ritrovamenti. "Potremmo restare qui un bel po'. Non si può dire quanto ci vorrà per rimetterla in funzione. Dopotutto sono passate molte migliaia di anni," dice. Foster comincia subito a ispezionare uno dei tanti resti Sheragi a bordo, mentre Eyama, Rakei e Desyo esplorano la nave ciascuna con il proprio gruppo.

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Emerald Sword 3|	Within half an hour, the entire ship is swarming with crew members hard at work studying the ship (and the remains of its prior inhabitants) and attempting to get it operational.|1450|0
units.english: Within half an hour, the entire ship is swarming with crew members hard at work studying the ship (and the remains of its prior inhabitants) and attempting to get it operational.
units.italian: Nel giro di mezz'ora, l'intera nave brulica di membri dell'equipaggio che lavorano sodo studiando la nave (e i resti dei suoi precedenti abitanti) e cercando di rimetterla in funzione.

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Emerald Sword 3|	(Look for Foster to see what he's doing.)|1453|0
units.english: (Look for Foster to see what he's doing.)
units.italian: (Cerca Foster per vedere cosa sta facendo.)

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Emerald Sword 3|	(Look for Eyama to see what she's doing.)|1456|0
units.english: (Look for Eyama to see what she's doing.)
units.italian: (Cerca Eyama per vedere cosa sta facendo.)

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Emerald Sword 3|	(Look for Rakei to see what she's doing.)|1460|0
units.english: (Look for Rakei to see what she's doing.)
units.italian: (Cerca Rakei per vedere cosa sta facendo.)

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Emerald Sword 3|	(Look for Desyo to see what she's doing.)|1464|0
units.english: (Look for Desyo to see what she's doing.)
units.italian: (Cerca Desyo per vedere cosa sta facendo.)

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Emerald Sword 3|	(Return to my ship and wait until the Emerald Sword is operational.)|1468|0
units.english: (Return to my ship and wait until the Emerald Sword is operational.)
units.italian: (Torna alla mia nave e aspetta che la Spada di Smeraldo sia operativa.)

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Emerald Sword 3|	You find Foster in a room that appears to have been expanded beyond its original size and converted into a farming facility of some sort. There are rows of dried out soil, its nutrients long gone, with sunlamps suspended above. While most of the crew with Foster is busy studying the farm itself, his attention seems to be on a mummified Sheragi corpse slumped over against one of the walls. You notice that the corpse has a prosthetic wing attached to it, which has survived far better than its host.|1473|0
units.english: You find Foster in a room that appears to have been expanded beyond its original size and converted into a farming facility of some sort. There are rows of dried out soil, its nutrients long gone, with sunlamps suspended above. While most of the crew with Foster is busy studying the farm itself, his attention seems to be on a mummified Sheragi corpse slumped over against one of the walls. You notice that the corpse has a prosthetic wing attached to it, which has survived far better than its host.
units.italian: Trovi Foster in una stanza che sembra essere stata ampliata oltre le sue dimensioni originali e convertita in una specie di impianto agricolo. Ci sono file di terra secca, da cui i nutrienti sono spariti da tempo, con lampade solari sospese sopra. Mentre la maggior parte dell'equipaggio con Foster è occupata a studiare l'impianto stesso, la sua attenzione sembra rivolta al corpo mummificato di uno Sheragi, riverso contro una delle pareti. Noti che il cadavere ha un'ala protesica attaccata, che è sopravvissuta molto meglio del suo ospite.

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Emerald Sword 3|	"What have you found so far?" you ask Foster.|1474|0
units.english: "What have you found so far?" you ask Foster.
units.italian: "Che cosa hai trovato finora?" chiedi a Foster.

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Emerald Sword 3|	Foster doesn't respond at first, so you begin to ask your question again, but he then turns quickly to look at you, then back at the corpse. "Sorry, I was busy daydreaming. What we found. What we found..." Foster's voice trails off as he looks around the room. "Do you hear that banging sound?"|1475|0
units.english: Foster doesn't respond at first, so you begin to ask your question again, but he then turns quickly to look at you, then back at the corpse. "Sorry, I was busy daydreaming. What we found. What we found..." Foster's voice trails off as he looks around the room. "Do you hear that banging sound?"
units.italian: Foster non risponde subito, così cominci a ripetere la domanda, ma poi si volta di scatto verso di te, e poi di nuovo verso il cadavere. "Scusa, stavo sognando a occhi aperti. Quello che abbiamo trovato. Quello che abbiamo trovato..." La voce di Foster si perde mentre si guarda intorno nella stanza. "Senti anche tu quel rumore di colpi?"

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Emerald Sword 3|	"What banging sound?"|1477|0
units.english: "What banging sound?"
units.italian: "Che rumore di colpi?"

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Emerald Sword 3|	"I don't hear anything."|1478|0
units.english: "I don't hear anything."
units.italian: "Io non sento niente."

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Emerald Sword 3|	"Strange. I've asked the others here but they don't hear anything either... Anyway, we've found many amazing things. This farm is just the tip of the iceberg. Given that the Emerald Sword had to be able to survive the long flight through interstellar space at sublight speeds, it's no surprise that the crew had to make the ship self-sustaining. I'm sure there's much we could learn technologically from this ship. But we've also found many... disturbing things..." his voice trails off again.|1479|0
units.english: "Strange. I've asked the others here but they don't hear anything either... Anyway, we've found many amazing things. This farm is just the tip of the iceberg. Given that the Emerald Sword had to be able to survive the long flight through interstellar space at sublight speeds, it's no surprise that the crew had to make the ship self-sustaining. I'm sure there's much we could learn technologically from this ship. But we've also found many... disturbing things..." his voice trails off again.
units.italian: "Strano. L'ho chiesto agli altri qui, ma nemmeno loro sentono nulla... Comunque, abbiamo trovato molte cose straordinarie. Questa fattoria è solo la punta dell'iceberg. Dato che la Spada di Smeraldo doveva essere in grado di sopravvivere al lungo volo nello spazio interstellare a velocità subluminale, non sorprende che l'equipaggio abbia dovuto rendere la nave autosufficiente. Sono sicuro che potremmo imparare molto, tecnologicamente, da questa nave. Ma abbiamo anche trovato molte... cose inquietanti..." la voce gli si perde di nuovo.

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Emerald Sword 3|	"These bodies tell stories, <last>. Terrible stories. The entrance into this area of the ship was welded shut. Almost all the corpses outside of this area were skeletons, while those inside, like this one, were mummified. My best guess is that at some point after arriving here, they realized that even with a facility like this they'd run out of food in due time." Foster kneels down to get closer to the corpse. "I'm having very vivid visions of it all, almost as if I'm there in the moment, but it's all happening so fast... They turned on each other in desperation. A small group decided to shut the rest off from the food supply, leaving them to starve. Then those in here lived off of what they had left until the life support systems gave out.|1480|0
units.english: "These bodies tell stories, <last>. Terrible stories. The entrance into this area of the ship was welded shut. Almost all the corpses outside of this area were skeletons, while those inside, like this one, were mummified. My best guess is that at some point after arriving here, they realized that even with a facility like this they'd run out of food in due time." Foster kneels down to get closer to the corpse. "I'm having very vivid visions of it all, almost as if I'm there in the moment, but it's all happening so fast... They turned on each other in desperation. A small group decided to shut the rest off from the food supply, leaving them to starve. Then those in here lived off of what they had left until the life support systems gave out.
units.italian: "Questi corpi raccontano storie, <last>. Storie terribili. L'ingresso a questa zona della nave era saldato. Quasi tutti i cadaveri fuori da questa zona erano scheletri, mentre quelli dentro, come questo, erano mummificati. La mia ipotesi migliore è che a un certo punto dopo l'arrivo si siano resi conto che, anche con un impianto come questo, il cibo sarebbe finito col tempo." Foster si inginocchia per avvicinarsi al cadavere. "Ho visioni molto vivide di tutto questo, quasi come se fossi lì nel momento, ma succede tutto così in fretta... Si sono rivoltati gli uni contro gli altri, nella disperazione. Un piccolo gruppo ha deciso di chiudere fuori gli altri dalla scorta di cibo, lasciandoli morire di fame. Poi quelli qui dentro sono andati avanti con quello che restava finché i sistemi di supporto vitale non hanno ceduto.

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Emerald Sword 3|	"In all my years, I've never felt as impacted by my work as I do now. I'm feeling very uncharacteristically... emotional at the sight of all this." Foster turns away from you and wipes a tear from his eyes.|1481|0
units.english: "In all my years, I've never felt as impacted by my work as I do now. I'm feeling very uncharacteristically... emotional at the sight of all this." Foster turns away from you and wipes a tear from his eyes.
units.italian: "In tutti i miei anni non mi sono mai sentito così toccato dal mio lavoro come adesso. Provo una sensazione molto... emotiva, del tutto inusuale per me, di fronte a tutto questo." Foster si volta dall'altra parte e si asciuga una lacrima.

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Emerald Sword 3|	"You have every right to be emotional. We've made an amazing but tragic discovery."|1483|0
units.english: "You have every right to be emotional. We've made an amazing but tragic discovery."
units.italian: "Hai tutto il diritto di essere emotivo. Abbiamo fatto una scoperta straordinaria e tragica."

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Emerald Sword 3|	"The Archon spoke to me when we arrived in the system. Maybe it's having an effect on you too."|1484|0
units.english: "The Archon spoke to me when we arrived in the system. Maybe it's having an effect on you too."
units.italian: "L'Archon mi ha parlato quando siamo arrivati nel sistema. Forse sta avendo un effetto anche su di te."

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Emerald Sword 3|	"Do you think it's because what we're doing might be wrong? We're basically raiding a tomb right now."|1486|0
units.english: "Do you think it's because what we're doing might be wrong? We're basically raiding a tomb right now."
units.italian: "Pensi che sia perché quello che stiamo facendo potrebbe essere sbagliato? In fondo stiamo saccheggiando una tomba."

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Emerald Sword 3|	"Yes. Yes we have," Foster says, sounding more upbeat than before. "Amazing, but tragic. But, amazing," he repeats, as if trying to reassure himself.|1489|0
units.english: "Yes. Yes we have," Foster says, sounding more upbeat than before. "Amazing, but tragic. But, amazing," he repeats, as if trying to reassure himself.
units.italian: "Sì. Sì, l'abbiamo fatto," dice Foster, con un tono più allegro di prima. "Straordinaria, ma tragica. Ma straordinaria," ripete, come per rassicurarsi.

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Emerald Sword 3|	Foster chuckles nervously at the mention of the Archon. "Perhaps," he says, then pauses. "No. I think the gravity of this situation speaks for itself."|1493|0
units.english: Foster chuckles nervously at the mention of the Archon. "Perhaps," he says, then pauses. "No. I think the gravity of this situation speaks for itself."
units.italian: Foster ridacchia nervosamente al nome dell'Archon. "Forse," dice, poi si ferma. "No. Credo che la gravità della situazione parli da sé."

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Emerald Sword 3|	"I had that same thought on the jump here," Foster says. "But we're in too deep to turn back now."|1497|0
units.english: "I had that same thought on the jump here," Foster says. "But we're in too deep to turn back now."
units.italian: "Ho pensato la stessa cosa durante il salto," dice Foster. "Ma siamo andati troppo avanti per tornare indietro."

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Emerald Sword 3|label|1499|0
units.english: foster end
units.italian: foster end

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Emerald Sword 3|	Foster stands back up and steps away from the corpse. "I should get back to exploring the rest of the ship. No use in staring at corpses all day."|1500|0
units.english: Foster stands back up and steps away from the corpse. "I should get back to exploring the rest of the ship. No use in staring at corpses all day."
units.italian: Foster si rialza e si allontana dal cadavere. "Dovrei tornare a esplorare il resto della nave. Non serve a nulla fissare cadaveri tutto il giorno."

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Emerald Sword 3|	You leave the area and see that the large door that was blocking the way into the area is laying against a wall. Foster mentioned that the door had been welded shut, so the crew must have removed it somehow to investigate the area. You notice a large dent in the middle of the door. You aren't sure if that's because of the crew getting into the facility, or from the ship's previous inhabitants attempting to break in.|1501|0
units.english: You leave the area and see that the large door that was blocking the way into the area is laying against a wall. Foster mentioned that the door had been welded shut, so the crew must have removed it somehow to investigate the area. You notice a large dent in the middle of the door. You aren't sure if that's because of the crew getting into the facility, or from the ship's previous inhabitants attempting to break in.
units.italian: Lasci la zona e vedi che il grande portello che bloccava l'ingresso è appoggiato a una parete. Foster aveva detto che la porta era stata saldata, quindi l'equipaggio deve averla rimossa in qualche modo per indagare nella zona. Noti un'ammaccatura profonda al centro della porta. Non sai se sia dovuta all'equipaggio che è entrato nell'impianto, o ai precedenti abitanti della nave che cercavano di sfondarla.

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Emerald Sword 3|	You find Eyama investigating the living quarters of the ship, which consists of long halls lined on either side by bunk rooms. Many of the doors are already opened, suggesting that Eyama has already been through many of them. She comes out of one of the bunk rooms after looking through it and notices you. "Captain <last>! What brings you here?" she asks.|1507|0
units.english: You find Eyama investigating the living quarters of the ship, which consists of long halls lined on either side by bunk rooms. Many of the doors are already opened, suggesting that Eyama has already been through many of them. She comes out of one of the bunk rooms after looking through it and notices you. "Captain <last>! What brings you here?" she asks.
units.italian: Trovi Eyama che sta esaminando gli alloggi della nave, costituiti da lunghi corridoi fiancheggiati da camerate. Molte porte sono già aperte, il che suggerisce che Eyama ne abbia già controllate molte. Esce da una delle camerate dopo averla ispezionata e ti nota. "Capitano <last>! Cosa ti porta qui?" chiede.

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Emerald Sword 3|	"I'm wondering if you've found anything interesting yet," you respond.|1508|0
units.english: "I'm wondering if you've found anything interesting yet," you respond.
units.italian: "Mi chiedevo se avessi già trovato qualcosa di interessante," rispondi.

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Emerald Sword 3|	"Oh, no. Nothing much," she says, sounding somewhat disappointed. "All I've found so far have been largely empty rooms. I would have thought that they would have kept personal items in their bunks, but it looks like they haven't. Or perhaps they were moved for some reason."|1509|0
units.english: "Oh, no. Nothing much," she says, sounding somewhat disappointed. "All I've found so far have been largely empty rooms. I would have thought that they would have kept personal items in their bunks, but it looks like they haven't. Or perhaps they were moved for some reason."
units.italian: "Oh, no. Niente di che," dice, con un tono un po' deluso. "Finora ho trovato solo stanze in gran parte vuote. Avrei pensato che tenessero oggetti personali nelle cuccette, ma sembra che non l'abbiano fatto. O forse sono stati spostati per qualche motivo."

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Emerald Sword 3|	Eyama moves to the next door in the hallway. Instead of another bunk room though, the door opens to a larger room. Judging by the proximity to the bunk rooms, you'd assume this to have been a lounge area or cafeteria of sorts, but its contents suggest otherwise. The walls are covered with Sheragi writing and paintings, and the floor is scattered with various strange looking objects.|1510|0
units.english: Eyama moves to the next door in the hallway. Instead of another bunk room though, the door opens to a larger room. Judging by the proximity to the bunk rooms, you'd assume this to have been a lounge area or cafeteria of sorts, but its contents suggest otherwise. The walls are covered with Sheragi writing and paintings, and the floor is scattered with various strange looking objects.
units.italian: Eyama passa alla porta successiva del corridoio. Invece di un'altra camerata, però, la porta dà su una stanza più grande. A giudicare dalla vicinanza alle camerate, la supporresti una sala comune o una specie di mensa, ma il contenuto suggerisce altro. Le pareti sono coperte di scritte e dipinti Sheragi, e il pavimento è disseminato di vari oggetti dall'aspetto strano.

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Emerald Sword 3|	"Is this..." Eyama says, trailing off as she approaches one of the writings on the wall.|1511|0
units.english: "Is this..." Eyama says, trailing off as she approaches one of the writings on the wall.
units.italian: "Questo è..." dice Eyama, perdendosi mentre si avvicina a una delle scritte sul muro.

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Emerald Sword 3|	"What is it?"|1513|0
units.english: "What is it?"
units.italian: "Che cos'è?"

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Emerald Sword 3|	Eyama runs her hand against the writing and begins speaking. The sounds match the guttural tongue with which she first greeted you. She pauses after each sound, as if reading single words or characters. "This is the Sheragi alphabet," she says with awe in her voice. Her attention then shifts to writing elsewhere. She reads it, then translates for you. "It says, 'Rekla have mercy on us.'" Next to the writing is a Sheragi handprint on the wall, one of many scattered throughout the large room. Eyama presses her hand to it, nearly covering it. "This is a young hand."|1515|0
units.english: Eyama runs her hand against the writing and begins speaking. The sounds match the guttural tongue with which she first greeted you. She pauses after each sound, as if reading single words or characters. "This is the Sheragi alphabet," she says with awe in her voice. Her attention then shifts to writing elsewhere. She reads it, then translates for you. "It says, 'Rekla have mercy on us.'" Next to the writing is a Sheragi handprint on the wall, one of many scattered throughout the large room. Eyama presses her hand to it, nearly covering it. "This is a young hand."
units.italian: Eyama passa la mano sulla scritta e comincia a parlare. I suoni corrispondono alla lingua gutturale con cui ti ha salutato all'inizio. Si ferma dopo ogni suono, come se leggesse singole parole o caratteri. "Questo è l'alfabeto Sheragi," dice con soggezione. Poi l'attenzione si sposta su altre scritte. Le legge, poi te le traduce. "Dice: 'Rekla abbia pietà di noi.'" Accanto alla scritta c'è un'impronta di mano Sheragi sul muro, una delle tante disseminate nella grande sala. Eyama vi appoggia la mano, quasi coprendola. "Questa è una mano giovane."

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Emerald Sword 3|	"Why is all this here?"|1517|0
units.english: "Why is all this here?"
units.italian: "Perché c'è tutto questo?"

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Emerald Sword 3|	"Who is Rekla?"|1519|0
units.english: "Who is Rekla?"
units.italian: "Chi è Rekla?"

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Emerald Sword 3|	"From what we know, Rekla was a divine warrior among the Sheragi. Sheragi legends stated that she united the warring Sheragi tribes and led them all to the stars.|1521|0
units.english: "From what we know, Rekla was a divine warrior among the Sheragi. Sheragi legends stated that she united the warring Sheragi tribes and led them all to the stars.
units.italian: "Da quello che sappiamo, Rekla era una guerriera divina tra gli Sheragi. Le leggende Sheragi dicevano che aveva unito le tribù Sheragi in guerra e le aveva guidate tutte verso le stelle.

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Emerald Sword 3|	"This ship has to have traveled between the stars for many of your years in order to reach this system without a hyperdrive. The engines are powerful, so it perhaps took them 120 years to arrive here. Many of the Sheragi would have survived the trip, but would be very old when they arrived. This would have made it difficult for them to colonize the planet."|1523|0
units.english: "This ship has to have traveled between the stars for many of your years in order to reach this system without a hyperdrive. The engines are powerful, so it perhaps took them 120 years to arrive here. Many of the Sheragi would have survived the trip, but would be very old when they arrived. This would have made it difficult for them to colonize the planet."
units.italian: "Questa nave deve aver viaggiato tra le stelle per molti dei vostri anni per raggiungere questo sistema senza un motore di salto. I motori sono potenti, quindi forse ci sono voluti 120 anni per arrivare qui. Molti degli Sheragi sarebbero sopravvissuti al viaggio, ma sarebbero stati molto vecchi all'arrivo. Il che avrebbe reso difficile colonizzare il pianeta."

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Emerald Sword 3|	"So they would have needed to reproduce on the way here?"|1525|0
units.english: "So they would have needed to reproduce on the way here?"
units.italian: "Quindi avrebbero dovuto riprodursi durante il tragitto?"

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Emerald Sword 3|	"Does that mean this was a daycare of sorts?"|1526|0
units.english: "Does that mean this was a daycare of sorts?"
units.italian: "Vuol dire che questa era una specie di scuola materna?"

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Emerald Sword 3|	"Yes. At least one, maybe two generations of Sheragi could have been born in that time."|1529|0
units.english: "Yes. At least one, maybe two generations of Sheragi could have been born in that time."
units.italian: "Sì. Almeno una, forse due generazioni di Sheragi potrebbero essere nate in quel periodo."

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Emerald Sword 3|	Eyama walks over to one of the objects on the ground and picks it up. "These are toys. So yes. This does seem to have been converted into a daycare."|1533|0
units.english: Eyama walks over to one of the objects on the ground and picks it up. "These are toys. So yes. This does seem to have been converted into a daycare."
units.italian: Eyama va verso uno degli oggetti a terra e lo raccoglie. "Questi sono giocattoli. Quindi sì. Sembra davvero che questa zona sia stata convertita in una scuola materna."

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Emerald Sword 3|	Eyama stands up and looks toward the walls. "And these wall writings were used to teach them. These handprints are theirs. There are hundreds of them. And some of these words are their final prayers." Eyama seems to go into a trance as she walks around the room glancing at the many writings on the wall.|1536|0
units.english: Eyama stands up and looks toward the walls. "And these wall writings were used to teach them. These handprints are theirs. There are hundreds of them. And some of these words are their final prayers." Eyama seems to go into a trance as she walks around the room glancing at the many writings on the wall.
units.italian: Eyama si alza e guarda verso le pareti. "E queste scritte sui muri servivano a insegnare a loro. Queste impronte di mano sono le loro. Ce ne sono centinaia. E alcune di queste parole sono le loro preghiere finali." Eyama sembra andare in trance mentre cammina per la stanza dando un'occhiata alle molte scritte sul muro.

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Emerald Sword 3|	As Eyama wanders the room, you begin looking at the objects on the ground. One of them catches your eye; a book of massive proportions, slightly over twice the length and width of your average human book, although you imagine it would be perfectly-sized for a young Sheragi. You try to open the book but find that the covers are locked together, and the lock won't budge.|1537|0
units.english: As Eyama wanders the room, you begin looking at the objects on the ground. One of them catches your eye; a book of massive proportions, slightly over twice the length and width of your average human book, although you imagine it would be perfectly-sized for a young Sheragi. You try to open the book but find that the covers are locked together, and the lock won't budge.
units.italian: Mentre Eyama vaga per la stanza, cominci a guardare gli oggetti a terra. Uno ti colpisce: un libro dalle proporzioni enormi, poco più del doppio in lunghezza e larghezza di un libro umano medio, anche se immagini che sarebbe perfetto per un giovane Sheragi. Provi ad aprire il libro ma scopri che le copertine sono chiuse insieme, e il lucchetto non cede.

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Emerald Sword 3|	"Eyama, check this out," you say, snapping her out of her trance.|1538|0
units.english: "Eyama, check this out," you say, snapping her out of her trance.
units.italian: "Eyama, guarda questo," dici, scuotendola dalla trance.

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Emerald Sword 3|	"Oh, a book?" she asks. She picks up the book and tries to open it herself. Without hesitating she reaches over to the lock and just pulls it right off before swinging open the massive cover.|1539|0
units.english: "Oh, a book?" she asks. She picks up the book and tries to open it herself. Without hesitating she reaches over to the lock and just pulls it right off before swinging open the massive cover.
units.italian: "Oh, un libro?" chiede. Raccoglie il libro e prova ad aprirlo. Senza esitare allunga la mano verso il lucchetto e lo stacca di netto, prima di spalancare l'enorme copertina.

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Emerald Sword 3|	"How did you unlock that?"|1541|0
units.english: "How did you unlock that?"
units.italian: "Come hai fatto ad aprirlo?"

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Emerald Sword 3|	"What does it say?"|1542|0
units.english: "What does it say?"
units.italian: "Cosa dice?"

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Emerald Sword 3|	"It was locked?" Eyama asks with a puzzled look on her face before immediately turning her attention back to the book.|1544|0
units.english: "It was locked?" Eyama asks with a puzzled look on her face before immediately turning her attention back to the book.
units.italian: "Era chiuso?" chiede Eyama con un'espressione perplessa, prima di riportare subito l'attenzione sul libro.

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Emerald Sword 3|	She skims the pages. "This is a diary. It seems to be written by an adolescent Sheragi who was born on the ship. They talk about how they've never seen a planet or star up close before, but the adults on board tell them stories of a promised land that they are traveling to. It seems that they were close when this was written, perhaps only a few weeks away from the system."|1547|0
units.english: She skims the pages. "This is a diary. It seems to be written by an adolescent Sheragi who was born on the ship. They talk about how they've never seen a planet or star up close before, but the adults on board tell them stories of a promised land that they are traveling to. It seems that they were close when this was written, perhaps only a few weeks away from the system."
units.italian: Sfoglia le pagine. "Questo è un diario. Sembra scritto da uno Sheragi adolescente nato sulla nave. Racconta di non aver mai visto un pianeta o una stella da vicino, ma gli adulti a bordo gli raccontano storie di una terra promessa verso cui stanno viaggiando. Sembra che fossero vicini quando è stato scritto, forse a solo qualche settimana dal sistema."

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Emerald Sword 3|	She flips through the pages, getting further into the diary. "When they arrived at the system, they stayed in orbit around the planet. The author doesn't know everything that was going on, but there appeared to have been arguments over whether to land."|1548|0
units.english: She flips through the pages, getting further into the diary. "When they arrived at the system, they stayed in orbit around the planet. The author doesn't know everything that was going on, but there appeared to have been arguments over whether to land."
units.italian: Gira le pagine, addentrandosi nel diario. "Quando sono arrivati nel sistema, sono rimasti in orbita intorno al pianeta. L'autore non sa tutto quello che succedeva, ma sembra che ci siano state discussioni se atterrare o no."

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Emerald Sword 3|	She then flips more pages. "Some of the Sheragi left to go to the planet, while others stayed behind. It doesn't sound like the split was amiable."|1549|0
units.english: She then flips more pages. "Some of the Sheragi left to go to the planet, while others stayed behind. It doesn't sound like the split was amiable."
units.italian: Poi gira altre pagine. "Alcuni degli Sheragi sono partiti per il pianeta, mentre altri sono rimasti indietro. Non sembra che la separazione sia stata amichevole."

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Emerald Sword 3|	She continues to flip through the pages as they eventually turn blank. She then goes back and stops on the last written page. "Part of the remaining crew locked themselves in the hydroponic farm wing of the ship, leaving the rest of the crew with limited amounts of food. 'I'm scared and I don't know what to do.'" Eyama stops reading and closes the book, looking teary eyed. "That was the last line."|1550|0
units.english: She continues to flip through the pages as they eventually turn blank. She then goes back and stops on the last written page. "Part of the remaining crew locked themselves in the hydroponic farm wing of the ship, leaving the rest of the crew with limited amounts of food. 'I'm scared and I don't know what to do.'" Eyama stops reading and closes the book, looking teary eyed. "That was the last line."
units.italian: Continua a sfogliare finché le pagine diventano bianche. Torna indietro e si ferma sull'ultima pagina scritta. "Parte dell'equipaggio rimasto si è chiusa nell'ala della fattoria idroponica della nave, lasciando al resto dell'equipaggio quantità limitate di cibo. 'Ho paura e non so cosa fare.'" Eyama smette di leggere e chiude il libro, con gli occhi lucidi. "Questa era l'ultima riga."

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Emerald Sword 3|	Eyama wipes a tear from her face. "A sad story, but there are plenty of sad stories in this place. No use in lingering on this one." Eyama puts the book under her arm and walks out into the hallway, going back to checking the living quarters.|1551|0
units.english: Eyama wipes a tear from her face. "A sad story, but there are plenty of sad stories in this place. No use in lingering on this one." Eyama puts the book under her arm and walks out into the hallway, going back to checking the living quarters.
units.italian: Eyama si asciuga una lacrima. "Una storia triste, ma qui ci sono molte storie tristi. Non serve a nulla soffermarsi su questa." Mette il libro sotto il braccio ed esce nel corridoio, tornando a controllare gli alloggi.

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Emerald Sword 3|	As you are looking for Rakei, you hear a low hum begin emanating through the ship, followed by the dim glow of the emergency lights being replaced by the bright main lights. You eventually find Rakei with her crew walking through the halls of the underbelly of the ship. "Greetings, Captain," she says. "Is there something you need?"|1557|0
units.english: As you are looking for Rakei, you hear a low hum begin emanating through the ship, followed by the dim glow of the emergency lights being replaced by the bright main lights. You eventually find Rakei with her crew walking through the halls of the underbelly of the ship. "Greetings, Captain," she says. "Is there something you need?"
units.italian: Mentre cerchi Rakei, senti un ronzio basso cominciare a diffondersi per la nave, seguito dal bagliore delle luci di emergenza sostituito dalla luce piena delle luci principali. Alla fine trovi Rakei con il suo gruppo che cammina nei corridoi della parte inferiore della nave. "Salve, capitano," dice. "Ti serve qualcosa?"

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Emerald Sword 3|	"Have you found anything interesting down here?" you ask.|1558|0
units.english: "Have you found anything interesting down here?" you ask.
units.italian: "Avete trovato qualcosa di interessante quaggiù?" chiedi.

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Emerald Sword 3|	"Nothing out of the ordinary," she responds. "We just finished getting the power back online. We had to swap out some parts that look like they broke of old age. Seems like the power generation was active until the end.|1559|0
units.english: "Nothing out of the ordinary," she responds. "We just finished getting the power back online. We had to swap out some parts that look like they broke of old age. Seems like the power generation was active until the end.
units.italian: "Niente di straordinario," risponde. "Abbiamo appena finito di rimettere in funzione l'energia. Abbiamo dovuto sostituire alcuni pezzi che sembrano essersi rotti per vecchiaia. Sembra che la generazione di energia fosse attiva fino alla fine.

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Emerald Sword 3|	"It turns out that the power generation and engines are all one unit, so I guess that's how they were able to make such powerful engines. We're heading to the life support systems now to make sure they're online so that you can safely disconnect your ship."|1560|0
units.english: "It turns out that the power generation and engines are all one unit, so I guess that's how they were able to make such powerful engines. We're heading to the life support systems now to make sure they're online so that you can safely disconnect your ship."
units.italian: "A quanto pare la generazione di energia e i motori sono un unico blocco, quindi credo che sia così che sono riusciti a fare motori così potenti. Ora andiamo ai sistemi di supporto vitale per assicurarci che siano in linea, così puoi scollegare la tua nave in sicurezza."

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Emerald Sword 3|	You follow her to the life support systems of the ship, a massive unit designed to scrub carbon dioxide out of the ship's atmosphere, keep the oxygen levels balanced, and warn about any potential leaks in the ship. Rakei finds the main control panel and begins tapping away at it. "Need to make sure this doesn't kill us when we turn it on." After a short while of working on the panel she simply flips a switch, turning it on.|1561|0
units.english: You follow her to the life support systems of the ship, a massive unit designed to scrub carbon dioxide out of the ship's atmosphere, keep the oxygen levels balanced, and warn about any potential leaks in the ship. Rakei finds the main control panel and begins tapping away at it. "Need to make sure this doesn't kill us when we turn it on." After a short while of working on the panel she simply flips a switch, turning it on.
units.italian: La segui ai sistemi di supporto vitale della nave, un'unità enorme progettata per filtrare l'anidride carbonica dall'atmosfera della nave, mantenere i livelli di ossigeno bilanciati e avvertire di eventuali perdite. Rakei trova il pannello di controllo principale e comincia a digitare. "Bisogna assicurarsi che non ci uccida quando lo accendiamo." Dopo un po' di lavoro sul pannello, si limita a tirare un interruttore e lo accende.

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Emerald Sword 3|	"Huh," she says. "That was a bit too easy."|1562|0
units.english: "Huh," she says. "That was a bit too easy."
units.italian: "Hm," dice. "È stato un po' troppo facile."

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Emerald Sword 3|	"What do you mean?" you ask.|1563|0
units.english: "What do you mean?" you ask.
units.italian: "Che vuoi dire?" chiedi.

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Emerald Sword 3|	"Well we needed to fix the power generation because of how it broke from use, but the life support systems are working just fine."|1564|0
units.english: "Well we needed to fix the power generation because of how it broke from use, but the life support systems are working just fine."
units.italian: "Beh, abbiamo dovuto riparare la generazione di energia perché si era rotta per l'uso, ma i sistemi di supporto vitale funzionano perfettamente."

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Emerald Sword 3|	"Do you think the power generation failed before the life support systems did?"|1566|0
units.english: "Do you think the power generation failed before the life support systems did?"
units.italian: "Pensi che la generazione di energia sia ceduta prima dei sistemi di supporto vitale?"

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Emerald Sword 3|	"Maybe someone turned the life support systems off."|1567|0
units.english: "Maybe someone turned the life support systems off."
units.italian: "Forse qualcuno ha spento i sistemi di supporto vitale."

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Emerald Sword 3|	"That could be the case, but life support systems are usually the first set of components that need to be repaired or replaced on any ship as it ages, so maybe someone turned them off before the power generation failed."|1569|0
units.english: "That could be the case, but life support systems are usually the first set of components that need to be repaired or replaced on any ship as it ages, so maybe someone turned them off before the power generation failed."
units.italian: "Potrebbe essere, ma di solito i sistemi di supporto vitale sono la prima serie di componenti da riparare o sostituire man mano che una nave invecchia, quindi forse qualcuno li ha spenti prima che la generazione di energia cedesse."

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Emerald Sword 3|	"That could be the case. Life support systems are usually the first set of components that need to be repaired or replaced on any ship as it ages, so someone turning them off is one way they could work when the power didn't."|1572|0
units.english: "That could be the case. Life support systems are usually the first set of components that need to be repaired or replaced on any ship as it ages, so someone turning them off is one way they could work when the power didn't."
units.italian: "Potrebbe essere. I sistemi di supporto vitale di solito sono la prima serie di componenti da riparare o sostituire man mano che una nave invecchia, quindi qualcuno che li ha spenti è un modo in cui hanno potuto funzionare quando l'energia no."

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Emerald Sword 3|	Rakei looks like her eyes are suddenly drawn to something across the room. You follow her gaze and spot an open doorway, different than the one you entered from. The doorway leads to a sealed airlock. Rakei accesses a panel next to the airlock to see that the other side is pressurized and opens it.|1574|0
units.english: Rakei looks like her eyes are suddenly drawn to something across the room. You follow her gaze and spot an open doorway, different than the one you entered from. The doorway leads to a sealed airlock. Rakei accesses a panel next to the airlock to see that the other side is pressurized and opens it.
units.italian: Rakei sembra avere gli occhi improvvisamente attratti da qualcosa dall'altra parte della stanza. Segui il suo sguardo e noti una porta aperta, diversa da quella da cui siete entrati. La porta conduce a una camera di equilibrio sigillata. Rakei accede a un pannello accanto alla camera per verificare che l'altro lato sia pressurizzato, e la apre.

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Emerald Sword 3|	On the other side of an airlock you find a large room with what looks like a runway going down the middle, leading to a shielded opening to the void of space. On either side of the room are three hangar bays. You spot that each of the hangars has a ship within it except for one.|1575|0
units.english: On the other side of an airlock you find a large room with what looks like a runway going down the middle, leading to a shielded opening to the void of space. On either side of the room are three hangar bays. You spot that each of the hangars has a ship within it except for one.
units.italian: Dall'altra parte della camera di equilibrio trovi una grande stanza con quella che sembra una pista che scende nel mezzo, verso un'apertura schermata sul vuoto dello spazio. Su entrambi i lati della stanza ci sono tre baie di hangar. Noti che ognuno degli hangar contiene una nave, tranne uno.

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Emerald Sword 3|	"Fighters," Rakei says as she approaches one of them and begins examining it. "These look like interesting pieces of technology. I wonder how the Sheragi were able to even fit into one." She runs her hand along the hull of the fighter and sees some Sheragi writing on the side. "'Onyx Chariot.' That's its name."|1576|0
units.english: "Fighters," Rakei says as she approaches one of them and begins examining it. "These look like interesting pieces of technology. I wonder how the Sheragi were able to even fit into one." She runs her hand along the hull of the fighter and sees some Sheragi writing on the side. "'Onyx Chariot.' That's its name."
units.italian: "Caccia," dice Rakei mentre si avvicina a uno di essi e comincia a esaminarlo. "Sembrano pezzi di tecnologia interessanti. Mi chiedo come facessero gli Sheragi a entrarci." Passa la mano lungo lo scafo del caccia e vede delle scritte Sheragi sul fianco. "'Carro d'Onice'. È il suo nome."

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Emerald Sword 3|	"You can read that?"|1578|0
units.english: "You can read that?"
units.italian: "Sai leggerlo?"

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Emerald Sword 3|	"I thought Eyama was the linguist."|1580|0
units.english: "I thought Eyama was the linguist."
units.italian: "Pensavo che la linguista fosse Eyama."

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Emerald Sword 3|	"She is. I guess she's rubbed off on me."|1581|0
units.english: "She is. I guess she's rubbed off on me."
units.italian: "Lo è. Credo che mi abbia contagiata."

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Emerald Sword 3|	"It looks like it."|1584|0
units.english: "It looks like it."
units.italian: "Direi di sì."

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Emerald Sword 3|	Rakei hops onto the top of the fighter, looking for a way in. She finds a hatch and opens it, looking shocked at what she sees. "Wait. I think these fighters are autonomous. I'm not seeing any signs of a life support system, or even a way that a Sheragi could pilot this. There's barely even enough room for a younger Sheragi to fit in here. If the Sheragi couldn't have piloted these then why is there one missing?"|1586|0
units.english: Rakei hops onto the top of the fighter, looking for a way in. She finds a hatch and opens it, looking shocked at what she sees. "Wait. I think these fighters are autonomous. I'm not seeing any signs of a life support system, or even a way that a Sheragi could pilot this. There's barely even enough room for a younger Sheragi to fit in here.
