If the Sheragi couldn't have piloted these then why is there one missing?"
units.italian: Rakei salta in cima al caccia, cercando un modo per entrare. Trova un portello e lo apre, restando scioccata da quello che vede. "Aspetta. Penso che questi caccia siano autonomi. Non vedo segni di un sistema di supporto vitale, né un modo in cui uno Sheragi potrebbe pilotarlo. C'è a malapena spazio perché ci stia uno Sheragi giovane. Se gli Sheragi non potevano pilotarli, perché ne manca uno?"

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Emerald Sword 3|	Rakei closes the hatch and hops down from the fighter. "We still need to get other systems working before the ship is fully functional, so we can take a look at these fighters later. And maybe we'll find the missing fighter on the planet."|1587|0
units.english: Rakei closes the hatch and hops down from the fighter. "We still need to get other systems working before the ship is fully functional, so we can take a look at these fighters later. And maybe we'll find the missing fighter on the planet."
units.italian: Rakei chiude il portello e salta giù dal caccia. "Dobbiamo ancora rimettere in funzione altri sistemi prima che la nave sia pienamente operativa, quindi potremo dare un'occhiata a questi caccia più avanti. E magari troveremo il caccia mancante sul pianeta."

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Emerald Sword 3|	You find Desyo in the cockpit of the ship, overseeing a crew attempting to take control of the ship's computer systems. Makeshift scaffolding has been put in place just so that the crew can reach the controls. "Hello there, Captain," Desyo greets you as you walk in through the massive doorway. "Is there anything I can help you with?"|1593|0
units.english: You find Desyo in the cockpit of the ship, overseeing a crew attempting to take control of the ship's computer systems. Makeshift scaffolding has been put in place just so that the crew can reach the controls. "Hello there, Captain," Desyo greets you as you walk in through the massive doorway. "Is there anything I can help you with?"
units.italian: Trovi Desyo nella cabina di pilotaggio della nave, mentre sovrintende a un equipaggio che cerca di prendere il controllo dei sistemi informatici. Sono stati montati ponteggi improvvisati solo perché l'equipaggio possa raggiungere i comandi. "Salve, capitano," ti saluta Desyo mentre entri dal portale enorme. "Posso aiutarti in qualcosa?"

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Emerald Sword 3|	"I'm just curious as to what you've found," you respond.|1594|0
units.english: "I'm just curious as to what you've found," you respond.
units.italian: "Sono solo curioso di sapere cosa hai trovato," rispondi.

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Emerald Sword 3|	"Not much yet. We've only just finished putting up these structures so that we can properly access the ship's controls. Now we're looking over them to find a main access point of sorts. From there, we can take control of the ship."|1595|0
units.english: "Not much yet. We've only just finished putting up these structures so that we can properly access the ship's controls. Now we're looking over them to find a main access point of sorts. From there, we can take control of the ship."
units.italian: "Non molto, per ora. Abbiamo appena finito di montare queste strutture per poter accedere ai comandi della nave. Ora li stiamo esaminando per trovare una specie di punto di accesso principale. Da lì potremo prendere il controllo della nave."

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Emerald Sword 3|	"Desyo, you might want to see this," one of the crew members shouts. You follow Desyo over to the crew member, who has found a compartment under one of the consoles. Inside, among a mess of Sheragi components, lays a black box that looks exactly like the one that brought you here, and in pristine condition compared to it as well.|1596|0
units.english: "Desyo, you might want to see this," one of the crew members shouts. You follow Desyo over to the crew member, who has found a compartment under one of the consoles. Inside, among a mess of Sheragi components, lays a black box that looks exactly like the one that brought you here, and in pristine condition compared to it as well.
units.italian: "Desyo, forse dovresti vedere questo," grida uno dei membri dell'equipaggio. Segui Desyo dal membro dell'equipaggio, che ha trovato un vano sotto una delle console. Dentro, in mezzo a un ammasso di componenti Sheragi, c'è una scatola nera che assomiglia esattamente a quella che ti ha portato qui, e anche in condizioni molto migliori rispetto a quella.

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Emerald Sword 3|	Desyo excitedly removes the black box from the compartment, detaching it from the ship's electronics and attaching it to a computer of her own. "There's no telling what information we'll be able to find with this! Having this ship's black box will tell us everything about it, from its journey in Zubeneschamali all the way to when the ship lost power!"|1597|0
units.english: Desyo excitedly removes the black box from the compartment, detaching it from the ship's electronics and attaching it to a computer of her own. "There's no telling what information we'll be able to find with this! Having this ship's black box will tell us everything about it, from its journey in Zubeneschamali all the way to when the ship lost power!"
units.italian: Desyo estrae con entusiasmo la scatola nera dal vano, la stacca dall'elettronica della nave e la collega a un computer suo. "Non si può dire quali informazioni riusciremo a trovare con questa! Avere la scatola nera di questa nave ci dirà tutto di lei, dal suo viaggio a Zubeneschamali fino al momento in cui la nave ha perso energia!"

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Emerald Sword 3|	"Do you think we could find another ship to explore?"|1599|0
units.english: "Do you think we could find another ship to explore?"
units.italian: "Pensi che potremmo trovare un'altra nave da esplorare?"

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Emerald Sword 3|	"Is it really a good idea to just plug that in like that?"|1600|0
units.english: "Is it really a good idea to just plug that in like that?"
units.italian: "È davvero una buona idea collegarla così?"

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Emerald Sword 3|	"I don't believe that this box would have any information that would lead us to another ship. But, there's only one way to find out," Desyo says as she begins decrypting the black box.|1603|0
units.english: "I don't believe that this box would have any information that would lead us to another ship. But, there's only one way to find out," Desyo says as she begins decrypting the black box.
units.italian: "Non credo che questa scatola contenga informazioni che ci portino a un'altra nave. Ma c'è solo un modo per scoprirlo," dice Desyo mentre comincia a decifrare la scatola nera.

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Emerald Sword 3|label|1606|0
units.english: bad idea
units.italian: bad idea

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Emerald Sword 3|	"If you're thinking that this could infect my computer with a virus as a countermeasure, I've already dealt with that. We had to develop a firewall to combat a virus that was in the other black box," Desyo says as she begins decrypting the black box.|1607|0
units.english: "If you're thinking that this could infect my computer with a virus as a countermeasure, I've already dealt with that. We had to develop a firewall to combat a virus that was in the other black box," Desyo says as she begins decrypting the black box.
units.italian: "Se pensi che potrebbe infettare il mio computer con un virus come contromisura, ci ho già pensato. Abbiamo dovuto sviluppare un firewall per combattere un virus che era nell'altra scatola nera," dice Desyo mentre comincia a decifrare la scatola nera.

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Emerald Sword 3|	As Desyo begins extracting information from the box, you begin hearing a strange noise akin to a tea kettle. The noise begins to increase in volume and you pinpoint that it is coming from the box itself, which is now emitting strange white particles and a wave of heat. Others have seemed to notice this as well and have already moved behind cover. "Odd. Never seen that happen before," Desyo says. Before you can move, somebody pulls you and Desyo away from the box. The box suddenly gives off a loud popping noise and parts fly everywhere in an explosion.|1610|0
units.english: As Desyo begins extracting information from the box, you begin hearing a strange noise akin to a tea kettle. The noise begins to increase in volume and you pinpoint that it is coming from the box itself, which is now emitting strange white particles and a wave of heat. Others have seemed to notice this as well and have already moved behind cover. "Odd. Never seen that happen before," Desyo says. Before you can move, somebody pulls you and Desyo away from the box. The box suddenly gives off a loud popping noise and parts fly everywhere in an explosion.
units.italian: Mentre Desyo comincia a estrarre informazioni dalla scatola, cominci a sentire uno strano rumore simile a un bollitore. Il rumore aumenta di volume e individui che viene dalla scatola stessa, che ora emette strane particelle bianche e un'ondata di calore. Anche gli altri se ne sono accorti e si sono già messi al riparo. "Strano. Non l'ho mai visto succedere," dice Desyo. Prima che tu possa muoverti, qualcuno tira te e Desyo via dalla scatola. La scatola emette improvvisamente un forte botto e i pezzi volano ovunque in un'esplosione.

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Emerald Sword 3|	"Is anyone hurt?"|1612|0
units.english: "Is anyone hurt?"
units.italian: "Qualcuno è ferito?"

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Emerald Sword 3|	"Did that happen with the last one?"|1613|0
units.english: "Did that happen with the last one?"
units.italian: "È successo anche con l'altra?"

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Emerald Sword 3|	Your question is met with a chorus of "No, I'm fine," "All good over here," and various other affirmations of safety from the crew.|1616|0
units.english: Your question is met with a chorus of "No, I'm fine," "All good over here," and various other affirmations of safety from the crew.
units.italian: Alla tua domanda risponde un coro di "No, sto bene", "Tutto a posto qui" e varie altre conferme di sicurezza da parte dell'equipaggio.

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Emerald Sword 3|	Desyo looks at you like you're some kind of alien. "No, nothing like the sort. Don't you think I would have expected that if it had?"|1620|0
units.english: Desyo looks at you like you're some kind of alien. "No, nothing like the sort. Don't you think I would have expected that if it had?"
units.italian: Desyo ti guarda come se fossi una specie di alieno. "No, niente del genere. Non credi che l'avrei previsto, se fosse successo?"

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Emerald Sword 3|label|1622|0
units.english: desyo end
units.italian: desyo end

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Emerald Sword 3|	Everyone comes out from behind their cover to look at the aftermath. Luckily, no one seems to have been hurt. Desyo walks over to the large scorch mark on the floor left behind by the explosion. "I have no idea what could have caused such an explosion to occur," she exclaims.|1623|0
units.english: Everyone comes out from behind their cover to look at the aftermath. Luckily, no one seems to have been hurt. Desyo walks over to the large scorch mark on the floor left behind by the explosion. "I have no idea what could have caused such an explosion to occur," she exclaims.
units.italian: Tutti escono dai loro ripari per guardare le conseguenze. Per fortuna nessuno sembra essersi fatto male. Desyo va verso il grande segno di bruciatura sul pavimento lasciato dall'esplosione. "Non ho idea di cosa possa aver causato un'esplosione del genere," esclama.

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Emerald Sword 3|	"How's your computer doing?" you ask.|1624|0
units.english: "How's your computer doing?" you ask.
units.italian: "Come sta il tuo computer?" chiedi.

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Emerald Sword 3|	Desyo finds the computer on the other side of the room with a severely cracked screen, but somehow still functional. "Sturdy piece of hardware, isn't it?" she jokes. She begins tapping away at the keys as she squints at the screen. "I can still make out some of what I was able to pull from the cube. It looks like... that cube had some information on a weapon. Some sort of... chemical weapon? It seems to include... mention of coordinates. But that's all I was able to get. Whatever coordinates they were are lost to time."|1625|0
units.english: Desyo finds the computer on the other side of the room with a severely cracked screen, but somehow still functional. "Sturdy piece of hardware, isn't it?" she jokes. She begins tapping away at the keys as she squints at the screen. "I can still make out some of what I was able to pull from the cube. It looks like... that cube had some information on a weapon. Some sort of... chemical weapon? It seems to include... mention of coordinates. But that's all I was able to get. Whatever coordinates they were are lost to time."
units.italian: Desyo trova il computer dall'altra parte della stanza con lo schermo gravemente incrinato, ma in qualche modo ancora funzionante. "Hardware robusto, eh?" scherza. Comincia a battere sui tasti strizzando gli occhi verso lo schermo. "Riesco ancora a distinguere parte di quello che ero riuscita a estrarre dal cubo. Sembra che... quel cubo contenesse informazioni su un'arma. Una specie di... arma chimica? Sembra includere... un riferimento a delle coordinate. Ma è tutto quello che sono riuscita a ottenere. Qualunque fossero quelle coordinate, sono perse nel tempo."

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Emerald Sword 3|	The crew are still standing around in shock as Desyo fiddles with her damaged computer. She looks up to see everyone staring at her. "Well, let's get back to work. We're not going to make any progress just standing around."|1626|0
units.english: The crew are still standing around in shock as Desyo fiddles with her damaged computer. She looks up to see everyone staring at her. "Well, let's get back to work. We're not going to make any progress just standing around."
units.italian: L'equipaggio è ancora lì intorno, sotto shock, mentre Desyo armeggia con il computer danneggiato. Alza lo sguardo e vede tutti che la fissano. "Beh, torniamo al lavoro. Non faremo progressi restando qui impalati."

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Emerald Sword 3|	You return to your ship, and after a few hours Foster contacts you saying that the ship is in operational condition. It'll need to be landed on the planet in this system so that the jump drive can be installed, though.|1629|0
units.english: You return to your ship, and after a few hours Foster contacts you saying that the ship is in operational condition. It'll need to be landed on the planet in this system so that the jump drive can be installed, though.
units.italian: Torni alla tua nave, e dopo qualche ora Foster ti contatta dicendo che la nave è in condizioni operative. Andrà però fatta atterrare sul pianeta di questo sistema perché si possa installare il motore di salto.

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: The Emerald Sword 3|dialog|1632|0
units.english: Upon landing on this strange world, you realize not everything is accounted for! Better make sure the Emerald Sword has been boarded, and no crew or cargo is on escorts out of the system.
units.italian: Atterrando su questo strano mondo, ti rendi conto che non tutto è al suo posto! Meglio assicurarsi che la Spada di Smeraldo sia presidiata, e che nessun membro dell'equipaggio o carico sia su scorte fuori dal sistema.

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: Epilogue|name|1638|0
units.english: The Emerald Sword
units.italian: La Spada di Smeraldo

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: Epilogue|description|1639|0
units.english: Return to Zug.
units.italian: Torna su Zug.

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: Epilogue|As you enter the atmosphere of the alien world, you begin running scans of the air quality to determine if it is safe to breathe. You quickly learn why it is that the Sheragi perished in space; the atmosphere has a high concentration of chlorine gas, fatal to all living creatures aside from those that seem to have miraculously evolved here. The environmental suits brought along "just in case" turn out to be very useful here. The atmosphere would be unhealthy to breathe for long periods of time, and very uncomfortable in the short term, if you didn't bring them.|1655|0
units.english: As you enter the atmosphere of the alien world, you begin running scans of the air quality to determine if it is safe to breathe. You quickly learn why it is that the Sheragi perished in space; the atmosphere has a high concentration of chlorine gas, fatal to all living creatures aside from those that seem to have miraculously evolved here. The environmental suits brought along "just in case" turn out to be very useful here. The atmosphere would be unhealthy to breathe for long periods of time, and very uncomfortable in the short term, if you didn't bring them.
units.italian: Mentre entri nell'atmosfera del mondo alieno, cominci a fare scansioni della qualità dell'aria per stabilire se sia sicuro respirarla. Scopri presto perché gli Sheragi perirono nello spazio: l'atmosfera ha un'alta concentrazione di cloro gassoso, letale per tutte le creature viventi tranne quelle che sembrano essersi evolute qui per miracolo. Le tute ambientali portate "per sicurezza" si rivelano molto utili qui. L'atmosfera sarebbe malsana da respirare a lungo, e molto scomoda nel breve periodo, se non le aveste portate.

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: Epilogue|	You spend some time searching for a suitable landing spot - one that is high enough to escape the highest concentrations of chlorine gas in the atmosphere, but flat enough to land on. Your scanners eventually spot a flat mesa high above the ground. It turns out the Sheragi found this exact same spot; as you come in for a landing it becomes apparent that there are ruins of a large settlement on the mesa.|1656|0
units.english: You spend some time searching for a suitable landing spot - one that is high enough to escape the highest concentrations of chlorine gas in the atmosphere, but flat enough to land on. Your scanners eventually spot a flat mesa high above the ground. It turns out the Sheragi found this exact same spot; as you come in for a landing it becomes apparent that there are ruins of a large settlement on the mesa.
units.italian: Passi un po' di tempo a cercare un punto di atterraggio adatto: abbastanza in alto da sfuggire alle concentrazioni più alte di cloro nell'atmosfera, ma abbastanza piatto da poterci atterrare. I tuoi scanner individuano alla fine una mesa piatta molto in alto rispetto al suolo. Scopri che gli Sheragi avevano trovato esattamente lo stesso posto: mentre ti avvicini per atterrare, diventa evidente che sulla mesa ci sono le rovine di un grande insediamento.

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: Epilogue|	Among the ruins you spot what looks like a small ship covered in foliage. "That must be the missing fighter," Rakei says.|1657|0
units.english: Among the ruins you spot what looks like a small ship covered in foliage. "That must be the missing fighter," Rakei says.
units.italian: Tra le rovine noti quella che sembra una piccola nave coperta di vegetazione. "Quello dev'essere il caccia mancante," dice Rakei.

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: Epilogue|	Seeing your confusion, she explains: "We found five fighters on the Emerald Sword, but there is room for six. We figured that the final one might be on the planet."|1660|0
units.english: Seeing your confusion, she explains: "We found five fighters on the Emerald Sword, but there is room for six. We figured that the final one might be on the planet."
units.italian: Vedendo la tua confusione, spiega: "Abbiamo trovato cinque caccia sulla Spada di Smeraldo, ma c'è spazio per sei. Abbiamo pensato che l'ultimo potesse essere sul pianeta."

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: Epilogue|	"Well, this is quite the turn of events," Foster says as he looks at the ruins.|1662|0
units.english: "Well, this is quite the turn of events," Foster says as he looks at the ruins.
units.italian: "Beh, è proprio un bel colpo di scena," dice Foster guardando le rovine.

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: Epilogue|	"You didn't expect to find anything here?"|1664|0
units.english: "You didn't expect to find anything here?"
units.italian: "Non ti aspettavi di trovare qualcosa qui?"

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: Epilogue|	"Do you think we'll find anyone left alive?"|1665|0
units.english: "Do you think we'll find anyone left alive?"
units.italian: "Pensi che troveremo qualcuno ancora vivo?"

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: Epilogue|	"Not after seeing what happened on the ship," he responds.|1667|0
units.english: "Not after seeing what happened on the ship," he responds.
units.italian: "Non dopo aver visto cosa è successo sulla nave," risponde.

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: Epilogue|	"After thousands of years? I'm not holding my breath," he responds.|1670|0
units.english: "After thousands of years? I'm not holding my breath," he responds.
units.italian: "Dopo migliaia di anni? Non trattengo il respiro," risponde.

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: Epilogue|	You land your ship next to the Emerald Sword and the crew gets to work transporting heavy equipment from your ship to the Emerald Sword to finish getting it functional and install the jump drive.|1672|0
units.english: You land your ship next to the Emerald Sword and the crew gets to work transporting heavy equipment from your ship to the Emerald Sword to finish getting it functional and install the jump drive.
units.italian: Posi la nave accanto alla Spada di Smeraldo e l'equipaggio si mette al lavoro per trasportare attrezzature pesanti dalla tua nave alla Spada di Smeraldo, per finire di rimetterla in funzione e installare il motore di salto.

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: Epilogue|	Foster and Eyama get into their environmental suits. "Want to join us in investigating the ruins, <first>?" Foster asks. "Rakei and Desyo will be staying here to finish work on the ship."|1673|0
units.english: Foster and Eyama get into their environmental suits. "Want to join us in investigating the ruins, <first>?" Foster asks. "Rakei and Desyo will be staying here to finish work on the ship."
units.italian: Foster ed Eyama si infilano nelle tute ambientali. "Vuoi unirti a noi a esaminare le rovine, <first>?" chiede Foster. "Rakei e Desyo resteranno qui a finire il lavoro sulla nave."

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: Epilogue|	"Sure, I'll come along."|1675|0
units.english: "Sure, I'll come along."
units.italian: "Certo, vengo anch'io."

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: Epilogue|	"No, I'd rather wait here."|1676|0
units.english: "No, I'd rather wait here."
units.italian: "No, preferisco aspettare qui."

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: Epilogue|	You head into the settlement with Foster and Eyama. Not much remains of the ruins, but there is still more than what one would expect to find after such a long time. The buildings were all connected to each other to avoid the exterior atmosphere. They were made of glass, scrap, and a kind of yellowish white plastic, the same plastic that the carapaces of animals here are made of. It's very fortunate that the young life in this planet seems to still be unable to decompose those materials, leaving the ruins only at the mercy of weather and geological processes. They appear to have been melted into shape and built into walls over time, giving the buildings a rounded, anachronistic look, like mud huts made of modern materials. All around the inside there are remains of curtains and rags hanging from the ceiling to the ground. Closer inspection reveals the rags to have traces of exotic chemicals, likely made to react with the chlorine in the air to keep the atmosphere inside breathable.|1678|0
units.english: You head into the settlement with Foster and Eyama. Not much remains of the ruins, but there is still more than what one would expect to find after such a long time. The buildings were all connected to each other to avoid the exterior atmosphere. They were made of glass, scrap, and a kind of yellowish white plastic, the same plastic that the carapaces of animals here are made of. It's very fortunate that the young life in this planet seems to still be unable to decompose those materials, leaving the ruins only at the mercy of weather and geological processes. They appear to have been melted into shape and built into walls over time, giving the buildings a rounded, anachronistic look, like mud huts made of modern materials. All around the inside there are remains of curtains and rags hanging from the ceiling to the ground. Closer inspection reveals the rags to have traces of exotic chemicals, likely made to react with the chlorine in the air to keep the atmosphere inside breathable.
units.italian: Ti inoltri nell'insediamento con Foster ed Eyama. Non resta molto delle rovine, ma c'è comunque più di quanto ci si aspetterebbe di trovare dopo tanto tempo. Gli edifici erano tutti collegati tra loro per evitare l'atmosfera esterna. Erano fatti di vetro, rottami e una specie di plastica bianco-giallastra, la stessa plastica di cui sono fatti i carapaci degli animali di qui. È molto fortunato che la vita giovane di questo pianeta sembri ancora incapace di decomporre quei materiali, lasciando le rovine in balia solo del clima e dei processi geologici. Sembrano essere state fuse e plasmate in muri nel tempo, il che dà agli edifici un aspetto arrotondato e anacronistico, come capanne di fango fatte di materiali moderni. Tutt'intorno, all'interno, ci sono resti di tende e stracci appesi dal soffitto al pavimento. Un esame più attento rivela che gli stracci hanno tracce di sostanze chimiche esotiche, probabilmente fatte per reagire con il cloro nell'aria e mantenere respirabile l'atmosfera interna.

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: Epilogue|	The smaller rooms you come across appear to be just family homes, with a simplistic, single room interior, while the larger ones had other purposes, like what appears to have been a classroom, an animal carapace storage room holding the exoskeletons of many different species, a communal kitchen with remains of a solar oven, and most strikingly, a hatchery with relatively small beds, nests, and makeshift toys strewn about. Most of the rooms are littered with skeletons and remains, from the largest hunter-gatherers to the smallest young ones, a grim scene suggesting that some unknown catastrophe ended their lives all at once. Even then, the Sheragi on the surface apparently survived for much longer than the ones in the Emerald Sword, perhaps for many generations. Had the ship landed, they might have survived to this day.|1679|0
units.english: The smaller rooms you come across appear to be just family homes, with a simplistic, single room interior, while the larger ones had other purposes, like what appears to have been a classroom, an animal carapace storage room holding the exoskeletons of many different species, a communal kitchen with remains of a solar oven, and most strikingly, a hatchery with relatively small beds, nests, and makeshift toys strewn about. Most of the rooms are littered with skeletons and remains, from the largest hunter-gatherers to the smallest young ones, a grim scene suggesting that some unknown catastrophe ended their lives all at once. Even then, the Sheragi on the surface apparently survived for much longer than the ones in the Emerald Sword, perhaps for many generations. Had the ship landed, they might have survived to this day.
units.italian: Le stanze più piccole che incontri sembrano semplici case famigliari, con un interno semplice a una sola stanza, mentre quelle più grandi avevano altri usi, come quella che sembra essere stata un'aula, un magazzino di carapaci animali che conserva esoscheletri di molte specie diverse, una cucina comune con i resti di un forno solare e, cosa più notevole, una cova con letti relativamente piccoli, nidi e giocattoli improvvisati sparsi in giro. La maggior parte delle stanze è disseminata di scheletri e resti, dai più grandi cacciatori-raccoglitori ai più piccoli dei giovani, una scena cupa che suggerisce che qualche catastrofe sconosciuta pose fine alle loro vite tutte in una volta. Anche così, gli Sheragi in superficie sopravvissero apparentemente molto più a lungo di quelli sulla Spada di Smeraldo, forse per molte generazioni. Se la nave fosse atterrata, potrebbero essere sopravvissuti fino a oggi.

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: Epilogue|	Foster documents and takes pictures of everything that he sees. Although you'd expect him to be excited to see all this, like he was when investigating the Sheragi ruins on Zug, his mood is extremely somber.|1680|0
units.english: Foster documents and takes pictures of everything that he sees. Although you'd expect him to be excited to see all this, like he was when investigating the Sheragi ruins on Zug, his mood is extremely somber.
units.italian: Foster documenta e fotografa tutto quello che vede. Anche se ti aspetteresti che sia entusiasta di vedere tutto questo, come lo era quando esaminava le rovine Sheragi su Zug, il suo umore è estremamente cupo.

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: Epilogue|	While in one of the rooms, Eyama spots a young Sheragi skeleton laying on the ground that looks like they were reaching out for something when they died. Eyama kneels down next to the skeleton and reaches out to touch its hand. "Don't," Foster says from across the room, stopping Eyama from moving. "We need to leave this place undisturbed. We've done enough already by taking the ship." Eyama gets up without speaking, but gives a look of understanding to Foster.|1681|0
units.english: While in one of the rooms, Eyama spots a young Sheragi skeleton laying on the ground that looks like they were reaching out for something when they died. Eyama kneels down next to the skeleton and reaches out to touch its hand. "Don't," Foster says from across the room, stopping Eyama from moving. "We need to leave this place undisturbed. We've done enough already by taking the ship." Eyama gets up without speaking, but gives a look of understanding to Foster.
units.italian: Mentre siete in una delle stanze, Eyama nota lo scheletro di un giovane Sheragi steso a terra, che sembra stesse allungando la mano verso qualcosa quando è morto. Eyama si inginocchia accanto allo scheletro e allunga la mano per toccargli la mano. "Non farlo," dice Foster dall'altra parte della stanza, fermando Eyama. "Dobbiamo lasciare questo posto indisturbato. Abbiamo già fatto abbastanza prendendo la nave." Eyama si alza senza parlare, ma lancia a Foster uno sguardo d'intesa.

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: Epilogue|	After spending enough time among the ruins, you return to the ships with Foster and Eyama.|1682|0
units.english: After spending enough time among the ruins, you return to the ships with Foster and Eyama.
units.italian: Dopo aver passato abbastanza tempo tra le rovine, torni alle navi con Foster ed Eyama.

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: Epilogue|	The final repairs on the Emerald Sword take up nearly an entire day, with the crew working in shifts to get the job done. Once the ship is patched up and all the systems are functional, the jump drive is installed. While the Emerald Sword was being worked on, Rakei was able to get a group to retrieve the final fighter and return it to the ship. All that is left to do now is to get the ship in orbit and return to <planet>.|1684|0
units.english: The final repairs on the Emerald Sword take up nearly an entire day, with the crew working in shifts to get the job done. Once the ship is patched up and all the systems are functional, the jump drive is installed. While the Emerald Sword was being worked on, Rakei was able to get a group to retrieve the final fighter and return it to the ship. All that is left to do now is to get the ship in orbit and return to <planet>.
units.italian: Le riparazioni finali sulla Spada di Smeraldo occupano quasi un'intera giornata, con l'equipaggio che lavora a turni per finire il lavoro. Una volta che la nave è rattoppata e tutti i sistemi sono funzionanti, si installa il motore di salto. Mentre si lavorava alla Spada di Smeraldo, Rakei è riuscita a mandare un gruppo a recuperare il caccia finale e a riportarlo alla nave. Ora non resta che portare la nave in orbita e tornare su <planet>.

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: Epilogue|dialog|1687|0
units.english: You have reached <planet>, but not all of the archaeology equipment made it back! Better depart and wait for your escorts to arrive in this star system.
units.italian: Hai raggiunto <planet>, ma non tutta l'attrezzatura archeologica è tornata! Meglio partire e aspettare che le tue scorte arrivino in questo sistema stellare.

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: Epilogue|log|1689|0
units.english: Obtained an ancient Sheragi warship whose name translates to the Emerald Sword. It was crewed by mutineers that fled from their civil war and escaped into interstellar space. Found orbiting a disconnected star, it is an impressively large ship, fit for the equally large Sheragi. The ship's main weapon is a fusion-pumped gamma-ray laser called the 'Dragonflame Cannon.' Despite the relatively primitive outfits, it's still a very capable war machine due to its size.
units.italian: Hai ottenuto un'antica nave da guerra Sheragi il cui nome si traduce in Spada di Smeraldo. Era equipaggiata da ammutinati che fuggirono dalla loro guerra civile e si rifugiarono nello spazio interstellare. Trovata in orbita intorno a una stella isolata, è una nave impressionantemente grande, adatta agli Sheragi, altrettanto grandi. La sua arma principale è un laser a raggi gamma a pompaggio di fusione chiamato 'Cannone Fiamma di Drago'. Nonostante gli allestimenti relativamente primitivi, resta una macchina da guerra molto capace grazie alle sue dimensioni.

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: Epilogue|Your exotic new ship draws a lot of attention from the dockworkers, partly because it is unique and never-before-seen, but probably even more so due to the unprecedentedly large cannon. Albert and the Hai archaeologists spend most of the day examining the ship in more detail and recovering the corpses, now that it's in a proper spaceport and they can access more complex equipment. Everything is completed in one particularly busy afternoon, and as night falls, the immense scale of the ship's interior allows more floors to be installed, giving you even more living space.|1691|0
units.english: Your exotic new ship draws a lot of attention from the dockworkers, partly because it is unique and never-before-seen, but probably even more so due to the unprecedentedly large cannon. Albert and the Hai archaeologists spend most of the day examining the ship in more detail and recovering the corpses, now that it's in a proper spaceport and they can access more complex equipment. Everything is completed in one particularly busy afternoon, and as night falls, the immense scale of the ship's interior allows more floors to be installed, giving you even more living space.
units.italian: La tua nuova ed esotica nave attira molta attenzione dai lavoratori del porto, in parte perché è unica e mai vista prima, ma probabilmente ancora di più per il cannone di dimensioni senza precedenti. Albert e le archeologhe Hai passano gran parte della giornata a esaminare la nave più in dettaglio e a recuperare i cadaveri, ora che è in uno spazioporto vero e possono accedere a strumenti più complessi. Tutto viene completato in un pomeriggio particolarmente intenso, e quando scende la notte le dimensioni immense dell'interno della nave permettono di installare altri piani, dandoti ancora più spazio abitabile.

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: Epilogue|	You go back to the same park as before with Albert and the three Hai in partial disguise, ice creams in hand and paws to commemorate the new acquisition.|1692|0
units.english: You go back to the same park as before with Albert and the three Hai in partial disguise, ice creams in hand and paws to commemorate the new acquisition.
units.italian: Torni nello stesso parco di prima con Albert e le tre Hai in parziale incognito, con gelati in mano e in zampa per commemorare la nuova acquisizione.

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: Epilogue|	"That is one impressive ship," you mention.|1693|0
units.english: "That is one impressive ship," you mention.
units.italian: "È una nave impressionante," osservi.

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: Epilogue|	"True," Desyo says. "I've never seen a cannon that big before."|1694|0
units.english: "True," Desyo says. "I've never seen a cannon that big before."
units.italian: "Vero," dice Desyo. "Non avevo mai visto un cannone così grande."

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: Epilogue|	"I wonder how it works."|1696|0
units.english: "I wonder how it works."
units.italian: "Mi chiedo come funzioni."

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: Epilogue|	"That's what she said."|1698|0
units.english: "That's what she said."
units.italian: "Questo l'ha detto lei."

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: Epilogue|	Desyo doesn't understand, but Eyama bursts into laughter. "Classic human joke. You see, it implies--"|1699|0
units.english: Desyo doesn't understand, but Eyama bursts into laughter. "Classic human joke. You see, it implies--"
units.italian: Desyo non capisce, ma Eyama scoppia a ridere. "Battuta classica umana. Vedi, implica..."

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: Epilogue|	"God, don't explain it," Albert interrupts. "That was terrible. She's right though, that isn't something you see every day. Do you have any idea how it works?"|1700|0
units.english: "God, don't explain it," Albert interrupts. "That was terrible. She's right though, that isn't something you see every day. Do you have any idea how it works?"
units.italian: "Dio, non spiegarla," la interrompe Albert. "È stata terribile. Però ha ragione, non è una cosa che si vede tutti i giorni. Hai idea di come funzioni?"

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: Epilogue|	Rakei, who is more knowledgeable in this area, responds. "It's a fusion-pumped gamma-ray laser, or GRASER for short. The device is simple in concept, but the cost involved and the proportion of everything makes it impractical to develop, not to mention that to use it would probably be considered a war crime in many civilizations, thus making R&D not worth it. It's essentially using a nuclear flash to power a laser beam that penetrates and melts everything. Fascinating, but I'm hoping you'll use it only for peacekeeping purposes."|1702|0
units.english: Rakei, who is more knowledgeable in this area, responds. "It's a fusion-pumped gamma-ray laser, or GRASER for short. The device is simple in concept, but the cost involved and the proportion of everything makes it impractical to develop, not to mention that to use it would probably be considered a war crime in many civilizations, thus making R&D not worth it. It's essentially using a nuclear flash to power a laser beam that penetrates and melts everything. Fascinating, but I'm hoping you'll use it only for peacekeeping purposes."
units.italian: Rakei, che è più preparata in materia, risponde. "È un laser a raggi gamma a pompaggio di fusione, o GRASER in breve. Il dispositivo è semplice come concetto, ma il costo e le proporzioni di tutto lo rendono impraticabile da sviluppare, senza contare che usarlo sarebbe probabilmente considerato un crimine di guerra in molte civiltà, il che rende la ricerca non conveniente. In sostanza usa un lampo nucleare per alimentare un raggio laser che penetra e fonde tutto. Affascinante, ma spero che lo userai solo per mantenere la pace."

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: Epilogue|	Eyama adds, "I've been calling it the Dragonflame Cannon. I think it's appropriate, even though it's technically not a flame in the chemical sense. The dragons of human legends could breathe fire, and although it's unlikely the Sheragi could actually do that, this cannon more than makes up for it."|1703|0
units.english: Eyama adds, "I've been calling it the Dragonflame Cannon. I think it's appropriate, even though it's technically not a flame in the chemical sense. The dragons of human legends could breathe fire, and although it's unlikely the Sheragi could actually do that, this cannon more than makes up for it."
units.italian: Eyama aggiunge: "Io lo chiamo Cannone Fiamma di Drago. Mi sembra appropriato, anche se tecnicamente non è una fiamma in senso chimico. I draghi delle leggende umane sapevano sputare fuoco, e anche se è improbabile che gli Sheragi sapessero davvero farlo, questo cannone compensa abbondantemente."

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: Epilogue|	"Do you think I could get in trouble by using it?"|1705|0
units.english: "Do you think I could get in trouble by using it?"
units.italian: "Pensi che potrei mettermi nei guai usandolo?"

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: Epilogue|	"It's not going to blow up my own ship, is it?"|1707|0
units.english: "It's not going to blow up my own ship, is it?"
units.italian: "Non farà saltare in aria la mia nave, vero?"

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: Epilogue|	Rakei laughs. "Don't worry, the Sheragi did their homework. They used simple materials, which means that the cannon can be maintained and repaired so that it continues to be structurally strong. Many of the components are active anyway, and they basically only exist for the short amount of time that the GRASER takes to fire. I only advise against firing it at point blank range."|1708|0
units.english: Rakei laughs. "Don't worry, the Sheragi did their homework. They used simple materials, which means that the cannon can be maintained and repaired so that it continues to be structurally strong. Many of the components are active anyway, and they basically only exist for the short amount of time that the GRASER takes to fire. I only advise against firing it at point blank range."
units.italian: Rakei ride. "Non preoccuparti, gli Sheragi hanno fatto i compiti. Usavano materiali semplici, il che significa che il cannone può essere mantenuto e riparato per restare strutturalmente solido. Comunque molti dei componenti sono attivi solo per il breve tempo che il GRASER impiega a sparare. Ti sconsiglio solo di usarlo a distanza ravvicinata."

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: Epilogue|	"I don't think you will, as long as you don't fire it into a planet. It doesn't cause unnecessary suffering like nerve gas, and it isn't as indiscriminate as a nuclear bomb. This is a focused beam. It's going to poke holes straight through any ship subject to its wrath."|1711|0
units.english: "I don't think you will, as long as you don't fire it into a planet. It doesn't cause unnecessary suffering like nerve gas, and it isn't as indiscriminate as a nuclear bomb. This is a focused beam. It's going to poke holes straight through any ship subject to its wrath."
units.italian: "Non credo che ti metterai nei guai, a patto che tu non spari verso un pianeta. Non causa sofferenze inutili come il gas nervino, e non è indiscriminato come una bomba nucleare. È un raggio concentrato. Farà buchi da parte a parte in qualsiasi nave che subisca la sua ira."

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: Epilogue|	"Then what's the catch?" you ask.|1713|0
units.english: "Then what's the catch?" you ask.
units.italian: "E allora qual è il trucco?" chiedi.

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: Epilogue|	"It eats a lot of power. I mean a lot. And it does that every shot. No single reactor will be capable of making it shoot as fast as it possibly could. Expect to invest a lot in batteries and reactors if you want to re-outfit that warship and still use the cannon."|1714|0
units.english: "It eats a lot of power. I mean a lot. And it does that every shot. No single reactor will be capable of making it shoot as fast as it possibly could. Expect to invest a lot in batteries and reactors if you want to re-outfit that warship and still use the cannon."
units.italian: "Consuma un sacco di energia. Un sacco. E lo fa a ogni colpo. Nessun singolo reattore sarà capace di farlo sparare alla massima velocità possibile. Aspettati di investire molto in batterie e reattori se vuoi riattrezzare quella nave da guerra e continuare a usare il cannone."

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: Epilogue|	Desyo adds, "Also, don't go thinking you're invincible now. The shield matrix in that ship is incredibly primitive. Almost nonexistent. The hull is strong, but don't rely on it too much. Human technology could probably do better if they tried. No offense."|1715|0
units.english: Desyo adds, "Also, don't go thinking you're invincible now. The shield matrix in that ship is incredibly primitive. Almost nonexistent. The hull is strong, but don't rely on it too much. Human technology could probably do better if they tried. No offense."
units.italian: Desyo aggiunge: "E non pensare di essere invincibile adesso. La matrice di scudi di quella nave è incredibilmente primitiva. Quasi inesistente. Lo scafo è robusto, ma non farci troppo affidamento. La tecnologia umana potrebbe fare di meglio, se ci provasse. Senza offesa."

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: Epilogue|	"So what are you going to do now?" you ask them.|1716|0
units.english: "So what are you going to do now?" you ask them.
units.italian: "E voi cosa farete adesso?" chiedi.

units.id: mission:Sheragi Archaeology: Epilogue|	Eyama responds. "We'll continue working with Albert.
